Stiftelsens ändamål är att 1. utdela pen: The purpose of the Foundation is to: 1. award pensions to needy individuals residing in the former counties of Älvsborg or Värmland, primarily the sick and disabled, with priority given to the so-called “pauvres honteux”; 2. in particularly distressing cases, award other forms of assistance; 3. award scholarships to certain officers at the Military Academy, 4. award scholarships to the upper secondary schools in Karlstad, Vänersborg, and Åmål, 5. award scholarships to students at Uppsala University enrolled in the Värmland Nation 6. maintain the stone erected in 1820 in memory of the visit by the then-king and crown prince to Västerråda, which is now located along County Road 166. Of the annual income allocated for the specified purposes, at least three-quarters shall be earmarked for the pensions and grants specified in items 1 and 2, and the remainder for other purposes. The income may not be used to cover needs that are met through public assistance.
Fondens avkastning skall användas till u: The returns on the fund shall be used to award scholarships to talented and diligent students who, after having earned a high school diploma or equivalent—preferably from Torsby High School—are studying at universities or colleges in Sweden or abroad, as well as to students at forestry, agricultural, and home economics schools. Scholarships shall primarily be awarded to individuals from the former municipality of Fryksände. Once the aforementioned purposes have been satisfactorily fulfilled, any remaining returns may be allocated to a humanitarian or charitable cause within the parish of Fryksände.
Att lämna bidrag till sådan utbildning a: To provide funding for such training of students at the Royal Naval Academy that is designed to supplement their understanding of naval warfare with general knowledge of foreign countries, for example during stays abroad for study or service, or in connection with naval visits to foreign ports.
Att främja ungdomars utbildning genom at: To promote youth education by providing grants to students in need for university studies and higher education.
Stiftelsen har till huvudsakligt ändamål: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to promote further education at Swedish or foreign universities or colleges for deaf or severely hearing-impaired young Swedish students residing in Sweden, without limiting eligibility to members of a specific family or families. This is to be achieved by awarding an annual scholarship to a young deaf student.
Att utdela stipendier till utbildade sve: To award scholarships to qualified Swedish nurses for further studies in the healthcare field.
Aktiernas avkastning, efter avdrag av Ed: The returns on the shares, after deduction of Edra’s expenses, shall be distributed annually as travel grants to one or more students at the Stockholm School of Economics. The Board of Directors of the Stockholm School of Economics shall be responsible for awarding the grants; however, the Board should consult with the head of the Notary Department at Stockholms Enskilda Bank.
Att lämna bidrag till sådan utbildning a: To provide funding for such training of students at the Naval Academy, designed to supplement their understanding of naval warfare with general knowledge of foreign countries, particularly in connection with naval visits to foreign ports or during other periods of service abroad.
Att genom utdelning av stipendier till e: To provide one or more students at the Stockholm School of Economics with the opportunity to pursue theoretical or practical studies abroad through the awarding of scholarships.
Att främja vid Kungl. Lantbrukshögskolan: To promote the studies and education of full-time students enrolled at the Royal Swedish College of Agriculture and the Swedish Agricultural Research Institute by awarding scholarships to such students. Scholarships may only be awarded to students who have been enrolled at the Royal Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and the Swedish Agricultural Research Institute as regular students for more than one year and who, at the time of the decision, are still enrolled at the university and—except in the case of travel grants — are pursuing studies there and, on the basis of talent, excellent academic achievement, diligence, and exemplary conduct, are deemed deserving of the award. In cases of equal merit in the aforementioned respects, preference shall be given to applicants who, upon request, demonstrate the greatest financial need.
Att som sin självständiga förmögenhet äg: To own and manage, as its independent assets, the property bequeathed to the foundation in the will of Selma and Fritz Kreisky, as well as any property that may in the future be transferred to or acquired by the foundation for the purpose of consolidating and preserving said property, and, in accordance with the provisions of the will, to promote scientific education by awarding scholarships to medical students at the University of Gothenburg (college) and chemistry students at the Faculty of Arts, at the University of Gothenburg (University), as well as, in other respects, where applicable, fulfilling the provisions of the will regarding financial assistance.
Hela avkastningen, sedan minst en tionde: The entire return, after at least one-tenth has been added to the principal, shall be distributed annually as a scholarship to a talented young man or woman who shows particular aptitude for studies in a specific field, who wishes to pursue training in a particular profession, or who needs assistance in purchasing a home in the countryside. Should the church council of the Gräsö parish deem that no application received warrants approval, the fund’s return, after at least one-tenth has been added to the principal, shall be used for some charitable purpose within the municipality of Gräsö, as determined by the church council of the Gräsö parish.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att befrämja: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote Swedish engineering in the fields of thermal energy technology and fluid technology. The Foundation shall fulfill this purpose by awarding scholarships to young engineers who wish to further their education in these subjects through continued studies at a Swedish or foreign institution of higher education or through travel abroad, as well as by providing support to young engineers for conducting technical and scientific research and for publishing the results of such research.
Av fondens tillgångar får endast den årl: Only the annual return on the fund’s assets may be used, in accordance with Agnes Stenhagen’s will dated September 9, 1951. For this reason, temporary or more permanent financial aid shall be provided from this return to students at the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm in the Department of Chemistry who, due to temporary illness or otherwise difficult financial circumstances, are in need of assistance during their time at the Institute. For similar reasons, grants may, in exceptional cases, also be awarded to civil engineers who have graduated from the Department of Chemistry and are in need of assistance.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att stödja o: The purpose of the Foundation is to support and promote research and projects aimed at improving the physical environment in Sweden and its surrounding areas. Support from the Environmental Fund may, for example, be provided in the form of: - grants for research and investigative projects - scholarships for studies and thesis projects - awards for individuals who have, through the mass media, provided commendable information about environmental problems and measures to improve the environment. Any natural person residing in Sweden is eligible to apply for support from the fund. Members of the Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers have priority for support from the fund. At least 80 percent of the annual return, after deduction of administrative costs, should be distributed as support. Should this target not be met in any given year due to a lack of qualified applications, the funds shall be carried forward and distributed the following year.
Räntan å denna fond användes till högst: The interest from this fund is to be used to award up to ten scholarships to students who, through their diligence and good character, show great promise. Priority for these scholarships shall be given to those who can demonstrate a family connection to my maternal grandfather, Captain Per Erik Norberg.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att - i enli: The purpose of the Foundation is—in accordance with His Majesty’s decision of June 30, 1960, regarding amended provisions for the Foundation—to promote the domestic education of young people from the city of Västerås and neighboring municipalities through scholarships or other forms of support. At least one-tenth of the annual return on the Foundation’s capital shall be added to the capital. After any operating expenses have been deducted, the remainder may, at the discretion of the board, be used for the purposes stated above. Scholarships or other financial aid shall be awarded in amounts determined by the board after assessing the student’s academic aptitude and financial need.
Att genom utgivande av stipendier främja: To promote the education of young art students, music students, and dancers who have demonstrated an aptitude for the art of dance, as well as actors and actresses who have demonstrated an aptitude for the art of acting, through the awarding of scholarships.
Fondens disponibla avkastning skall, sed: The fund’s available returns, after at least ten percent of them have been added to the principal each year, shall be distributed in the form of scholarships to graduating students at the Naval Academy and bonuses to junior regimental officers (the England Travel Fund).
Anders de Wahls jubileumsfond, som är en: The Anders de Wahl Anniversary Fund, a charitable foundation, is established for the purpose of awarding grants to performing artists in the dramatic arts to enable them to deepen their understanding of their art through study trips or other means, in accordance with the charter.
Stiftelsen har till huvudsakligt ändamål: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to provide Spanish students with education and training in Sweden through scholarships, grants, subsidies, or other appropriate means, as well as to provide Swedish students with education and training in Spain in a similar manner. This purpose also includes the general promotion of Swedish-Spanish relations to an extent that does not conflict with the primary purpose stated above.
...skall efter ansökan utdelas såsom sti: ...shall, upon application, be awarded as scholarships or financial aid to young students, regardless of gender, who, by virtue of their aptitude, diligence, and exemplary conduct, may be deemed deserving thereof, with due consideration given to the applicant’s financial circumstances. Studies shall primarily focus on agriculture and forestry and, secondarily, on other studies in the natural sciences, preferably with a focus on animals and nature as well as other rural industries. The scholarship recipient shall primarily be a resident and/or conduct their activities or have their origins within the area that formerly constituted Luggude parish. Secondarily, the scholarship recipient shall be a resident and/or have their origins in Skåne. The scholarships are intended to contribute toward covering the costs of pursuing studies at an educational institution.
Ändamålet är att disponeras av rektorsäm: The funds are to be allocated by the Office of the President at the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm for use as scholarships.
Nettoavkastningen av denna fond, skall ö: The net proceeds from this fund shall be remitted to the Board of the Royal Swedish Academy of Music. The scholarships shall be used either to provide opportunities for musically gifted students to study at the Academy of Music or to enable younger, unmarried individuals to pursue music studies abroad.
Ändamålet är att av den årliga avkastnin: The purpose is that one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, while the remainder of the return shall be paid to the Royal Swedish Academy of Music in Stockholm. The Royal Swedish Academy of Music shall award the amount received to a young tenor to help him give his debut concert. If, in any given year, the Royal Academy of Music is unable to distribute the return to assist someone, it shall instead award the return to a talented student.
Avkastningen skall användas till reseund: The proceeds shall be used to provide travel grants to Swedish citizens who intend to pursue studies in any field—though preferably in the sciences—at the locations best suited for such studies, regardless of whether those locations are in America or another part of the world.
Avkastningen av fondmedlen skall använda: The proceeds from the fund’s assets shall be used to provide scholarships to Swedish young people who are employed in industry or commerce, or who are planning a future in these fields, and who wish to further their education in business through study or an internship in the United States.

The proceeds from the fund’s assets shall be used to provide scholarships for Swedish young people who intend to pursue studies in the United States, primarily in the fields of engineering and economics.
Stiftelsens ändamål är \"the exchange of: The foundation's purpose is "the exchange of students between Sweden and the United States."
Avkastningen skall användas till reseund: The proceeds shall be used to provide travel grants to Swedish citizens who intend to pursue studies in the United States in any field, though preferably in the sciences.
Avkastningen skall användas till rese-un: The proceeds shall be used to provide travel grants for Swedish electrical engineers who intend to pursue studies in electrical engineering in the United States.
Av fondens avkastning skall årligen en t: One-tenth (1/10) of the fund’s annual return shall be added to the principal, and the remainder shall be used to award scholarships ranging from 5,000 to 50,000 kronor, depending on the funds available. The scholarships are intended to support stays abroad for at least six months for the purpose of higher education and training in one or more of the following fields: agriculture, economics and commerce, or engineering.
Avkastningen skall - sedan 1/10 lagts ti: The proceeds—after being added to the principal as of October 1—shall be distributed at the beginning of each year as a scholarship to one or more of Alice Goldschmid’s former students. Applicants must provide documentation confirming that they are successfully pursuing studies in violin performance. Students who have performed in public shall be given priority over others. Should no applicants as described above apply in any given year, the proceeds shall instead be awarded to one or more violin students at a music college in southern Sweden.
Den årliga avkastningen får sedan minst: At least one-tenth of the annual return, after it has been added to the principal, may be used to fund scholarships for theology students training to become priests. The scholarships shall be awarded to students who are in need of financial support and intend to serve within the Diocese of Linköping.
Den årliga avkastningen får, sedan minst: The annual return, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the principal, may be used to fund scholarships for university students from the Diocese of Linköping. The scholarships shall be awarded to diligent students in need of financial support.
Fondens årliga behållna avkastning skall: The Fund’s annual retained earnings shall be used for scholarships for students at the three technical institutions listed below, with half of the earnings allocated to the Technical University, one-quarter to the Örebro Technical Elementary School, and one-quarter to the Mining School in Filipstad.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att till frä: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote educational opportunities for students who are members of the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences Student Union by providing an annual grant to cover the costs of operating and maintaining the Student Union’s student center in Umeå.
Enligt följande 1. Av fondens årliga avk: As follows: 1. Of the fund’s annual return—after deduction of management expenses—at least one-tenth shall be added to the principal. 2. The remaining return shall be used to promote the objectives pursued by the Southern Agricultural Society of Älvsborg County, such as development, experimental, demonstration, and training activities. 3. Furthermore, the fund’s return shall be used for both cash contributions toward vacation stays and for vacation and study trips organized by the society for rural housewives, as well as for training courses for them. For this purpose, an amount corresponding to the annual return on one-sixth of the fund’s total assets may be allocated.
Disponibel avkastning skall användas til: Available returns shall be used for means-tested scholarships for young people registered as residents of the Municipality of Linköping who, after completing compulsory schooling, are pursuing further studies; however, under no circumstances may returns be used to cover needs that, by law, must be met with funds raised through taxation.
Den årliga avkastningen skall i form av: The annual return shall be used, in the form of scholarships, awards, and initiatives to promote well-being, for the benefit of students in the general maritime officer training programs at Kalmar University.
Ur denna fond skall utgå stipendier till: Scholarships from this fund shall be awarded to young medical students. To be eligible, applicants must have been students at Alfred Dalinskolan in Huskvarna. Applications for the scholarship must be submitted after the applicant has received notification of admission to a medical school.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att i öve: The purpose of the Foundation shall be, in accordance with Section 3 of the Act of June 6, 1941, on Inheritance and Gift Tax, to promote the education of young people through scholarships for students at the Valand School of Fine Arts, or for students who are pursuing further studies after leaving the aforementioned school, or for students who are pursuing equivalent studies in Gothenburg or western Sweden.
Avkastningen i fonden skall till minst 8: At least 80% of the fund’s returns shall be distributed to students who are successfully pursuing theological studies, preferably at institutions of higher education that offer instruction within the Diocese of Stockholm.
Att ge ekonomiska bidrag till vård- och: To provide financial assistance for medical and housing expenses to needy and infirm members—primarily women—of the Catholic parishes in Greater Stockholm. The annual current return may be used for such distributions, after at least one-tenth has been added to the capital. The Board of Directors shall determine which individuals are to receive financial assistance from the Josephina Home, taking into special consideration the nature of their need and incapacity, as well as the specific character of the Josephina Home. The Foundation’s endowment, which may not be reduced, shall be invested in a secure manner and managed for the long term. With regard to the portion of the foundation’s annual current return that remains after the deduction of the portion added to the capital, at least one-fifth and at most one-third shall be used for the Queen Dowager Josephina Scholarship under the following conditions: b) "Queen Dowager Josephina’s Scholarship Fund," intended to provide support to poor or less well-off, hardworking, and talented Swedish students who belong to the Roman Catholic faith and are pursuing academic studies at a university in Sweden or Norway. In accordance with the provisions set forth in the preceding paragraph, subsection b), the Board shall, from the proceeds of the “Queen Dowager Josephina Scholarship Fund,” award financial aid to students whom it deems most deserving, provided that such aid shall not exceed sixty-five thousand kronor per year for each recipient. The Board has the right to withdraw such support from a student if the person in question does not prove themselves worthy of it through diligence and conduct.
Stipendierna skall användras som stöd ti: The scholarships are intended to support individual students or groups of students who have demonstrated exceptional achievement in the fields of art, literature, theater, and music. The scholarships may also be used to fund group projects, study trips, and similar activities in accordance with the provisions outlined above.
Hälften av avkastningen efter förvaltnin: Half of the return after administrative expenses shall, as determined in more detail by the President of the Administrative Court of Appeal, be used for measures to promote the well-being of the court’s staff; in this context, the staff may include retired judges from the court and civil servants on leave of absence from the court when they participate in events organized for the court’s staff. The other half of the proceeds after administrative costs shall be used for scholarships for young lawyers (up to six months after appointment as an associate judge) who are serving at the Court or performing trial court service, as a contribution toward participation in the Nordic Lawyers’ Meetings. If such a meeting takes place in Sweden, the proceeds during the years immediately following the previous meeting shall instead be used for scholarships within the aforementioned group for studies, preferably within the scope of the Administrative Court of Appeal’s jurisdiction, in an EU country outside the Nordic region. If the proceeds have not otherwise been fully utilized for scholarships for participation in the Nordic Lawyers’ Meetings, the remainder may instead be used for scholarships for the purposes specified in the preceding sentence. Should the Nordic Lawyers’ Meetings cease, the current investment income, after administrative costs, shall be used in its entirety for scholarships for the aforementioned category of studies, preferably within the scope of the Administrative Court’s jurisdiction, in any EU country (whether within or outside the Nordic region). The same shall apply if the existence of this scholarship opportunity were to result in scholarships for participation in the Nordic Lawyers’ Meetings not being awarded to younger lawyers at the court to the same extent as such lawyers at comparable courts. With regard to studies in an EU country outside the Nordic region, scholarships may also be awarded for language studies. For the sake of clarity, it may be added that “within the scope of the Administrative Court of Appeal’s jurisdiction” should be interpreted broadly and thus not only refer to subject areas falling within the court’s purview, but also to studies concerning, for example, legislative drafting, the structure of the judicial system, or judicial training.
Tio (10) procent av stipendifondens årli: Ten (10) percent of the scholarship fund’s annual disposable income shall be transferred to the School Board of the Municipality of Flens to be used in accordance with the provisions of Section 4 of the will. Ten (10) percent of the scholarship fund’s annual disposable income shall be transferred to Blacksta Parish Church to be used in accordance with Section 5 of the will. Eighty (80) percent of the scholarship fund’s annual disposable income shall be used for the purpose of the scholarship fund. ("the education of some well-behaved boy in this parish, belonging to the working class, who in elementary school has distinguished himself for diligence and good comprehension, and who has shown a desire and aptitude to excel in studies and knowledge at institutions of higher learning, and who is selected by the school board in Blacksta. Should there be a boy in my family who demonstrates such qualities that he ought to and is able to study, he shall have priority.”)
Af den årliga räntan skall efter afdrag: From the annual interest, after deduction of the administrative contribution due to the House of Nobility, calculated on the basis of the fund’s balance, three equal scholarships or pensions shall be established. The scholarships shall be awarded to needy young men or women belonging to the noble family No. 102 Oxelhufwud to be received by them from the age of fourteen until the age of twenty-five, provided, however, that during the greater part of this time they pursue studies at a public or comparable educational institution. Should no eligible member of the Oxelhufwud family apply for these scholarships, pensions from the fund shall instead be paid to young women or widows who bear or have borne the Oxelhufwud name, who have reached the age of forty, and who are of modest means, with priority given to the eldest. If there is no one in the family who is eligible to receive scholarships or pensions, the interest shall be paid out as scholarships and awarded to other needy young men and women belonging to families ennobled before June 6, 1809, and introduced to the Swedish House of Nobility, with priority given to those who are descended from or related to the Oxehufwud family. With regard to age and studies, the provisions of paragraph b. shall also apply to these scholarships.
Den årliga räntan skall användas till en: The annual interest shall be used, at the discretion of the Board of the House of Nobility, to fund scholarships for those undergoing officer training in the Swedish Armed Forces, including advanced training, and secondarily for students at universities and colleges; provided that the recipients belong to a family registered with the House of Nobility.
Stipendiefondens ränteavkastning skall a: The interest income from the scholarship fund shall be used to provide scholarships for studies leading to a Bachelor of Laws degree for impoverished young men of noble birth who are studying at the University of the Realm with the aim of becoming civil servants. When the Board of the House of Nobility awards the scholarships, no lottery shall be held among multiple applicants; however, if among the eligible applicants there are young men from the von Hartmandorff, Grönhagen, or Ehrencron noble families, they shall, in the same order as the families are listed here, have priority over all other applicants. At least 1/10 of the annual return on the fund shall be added to the capital. Available returns may not be used for purposes to be met with public funds.
Räntan af detta kapital skall i stipendi: The interest on this capital shall be distributed annually in the form of scholarships to young men of noble birth who are studying at the universities of Uppsala and Lund.
Af disponibel avkastning bildas två stip: From the available proceeds, two scholarships and a pension are established, to be paid in equal amounts in round tens of kronor; the amount of the educational grants is determined each time for a period of five years. The scholarships are intended for needy young men and women of the noble and baronial families of Reuterskiöld and Nordenfalk. The scholarships are awarded to young men who, upon reaching the age of 18, are pursuing studies at a public, civilian, or military educational institution, as well as to young women between the ages of 15 and 25, regardless of whether they are pursuing studies or not. The scholarships may be enjoyed for three years, a period which may be extended by an additional two years upon application. The pension is awarded to young women of the aforementioned families and to widows who, by birth or marriage, belong to the same families. When reviewing applications for both scholarships and the pension, preference is given to applicants who are most closely related to the donor. If no qualified applicant from the aforementioned families applies, the scholarships and pension may, for a period of no more than five years, be awarded to a member of another family introduced to the House of Nobility, with priority given to those who can prove kinship with one of the aforementioned families.
Räntan lägges till kapitalet till dess h: The interest is added to the principal until it exceeds 1,500 kronor, at which point a scholarship of 1,500 kronor is established for impoverished young nobles who have passed the high school graduation exam and are continuing their studies at one of the universities, the Military Academy, or the Technical University, or are pursuing an advanced course in agricultural science; however, this scholarship may not be held by any individual for more than four years. Once the capital has been increased so that the interest exceeds an additional 1,500 kronor, a new scholarship of an equal amount shall be established, and so on in the future; all such scholarships shall be administered in the manner specified in the second paragraph. Young men of the Scheffer family, No. 1975, provided they conduct themselves well, shall have priority for the scholarships.
I tacksam erinran av den hjälp jag under: In grateful remembrance of the assistance I received during my student years through scholarships from the House of Nobility, I hereby bequeath to the House of Nobility the sum of ten thousand kronor, the interest on which is to be paid out as a scholarship for three consecutive years to a needy student of noble birth at a university or college.
Medlen användas till gratifikationer, li: The funds are used for bonuses, life annuities, financial assistance for those in need, help with clothing, one- or multi-year scholarships for pursuing studies or acquiring other skills, one- or multi-year travel grants for similar purposes, or in any other way that enables the recipient to acquire knowledge and skills; the management of the funds shall be arranged in such a way as to best promote the purpose intended by the donor for the fund, namely that its proceeds shall primarily benefit the donor’s beneficiaries and only thereafter other persons, that genuine need shall be met above all else, and that only good, noble, and humanitarian purposes may be promoted thereby.
Avkastningen skall tillkomma underteckna: The proceeds shall accrue to the undersigned F. von Krusenstjerna’s sisters, Mrs. Märta Aschan, née von Krusenstjerna, and Miss Anna von Krusenstjerna, in equal shares, for as long as both are alive; and upon the death of either, the survivor shall receive the entire sum. After both Märta Aschan and Anna von Krusenstjerna have passed away, the proceeds, after deduction of one-tenth to be added annually to the principal, shall be distributed to members of the House of Nobility and the nobility, with half allocated as one or more scholarships and the other half as one or more pensions. Scholarships shall be awarded to students at Swedish universities or colleges and may be held for three years, with the Board having the authority to extend the term three times, for one year at a time.
Ändamålet är att bistå unga sångstuderan: The purpose is to assist young vocal students who, without financial support, cannot be expected to begin or complete their education. To some extent, means testing should be conducted.
Stiftelsen skall årligen dela ut stipend: The Foundation shall award an annual scholarship to a graduate or currently enrolled student from either the Department of Social Work at the School of Social Work or the Department of Political Science (Public Administration track).
/../ vart eller vartannat år efter konsi: /../ awarded every year or every other year, as determined by the University Senate, to a chemistry student upon the recommendation of the director of the Department of Organic Chemistry.
[...] skall användas till stipendier å 3: [...] shall be used to provide scholarships of 32,000 kronor to low-income Swedish students at Stockholm University.
Varje år utdelas som stipendium till en: Every year, a scholarship is awarded to a female student in the humanities department; those studying art and literary history should be given priority. If there is an organized absolutist among them, she is a shoo-in.
...utbetalas vid slutet av varje läsår s: ...is awarded at the end of each academic year as a scholarship to students who have demonstrated a particular interest and aptitude for studies related to municipal administration and accounting. The scholarship is primarily intended for students who have graduated during the year. Decisions regarding the awarding of the scholarship are made by the Department Board of the Department of Urban Studies, which may also decide to divide the scholarship between two students and, if necessary, stipulate specific uses or other conditions regarding the use of the scholarship. Decisions regarding the awarding of the scholarship are made regardless of whether an application has been submitted.
Disponibel avkastning skall användas til: The available funds shall be used to provide a cultural scholarship to a talented young student residing in the municipality of Katrineholm who is engaged in an art form such as singing, music, sculpture, painting, or similar. The scholarship shall be awarded on the donor’s birthday, February 20, in a manner determined by the Cultural Committee.
Medicinska fakulteten vid Umeå universit: The Faculty of Medicine at Umeå University awards a scholarship to the author of the most outstanding master’s thesis over a three-year period. The first award will be presented in the fall of 1989.
Utdelande av stipendier till studerande: Awarding scholarships to students at Uppsala University and Linköping University, and supporting the care, upbringing, or education of school-age children living in the parish of Bankekind.
Stipendier kan sökas av och skall tillde: Scholarships are available to and shall be awarded to medical students at Umeå University who—either before or after earning their medical degree (or equivalent)—have demonstrated particular dedication and achieved high grades in the fields of cardiovascular medicine or urology.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att dels ber: The purpose of the foundation is, on the one hand, to award scholarships to high school students in the former counties of Gothenburg and Bohus and to students at universities and colleges in Sweden, and, on the other hand, to provide grants for scientific and educational activities.
Till stipendier för att skapa ekonomiska: For scholarships intended to provide financial opportunities for recipients to devote up to one semester, in addition to and outside of their regular course of study, to studies in psychiatry or psychology; or, if such studies are not available, to another valuable subject of the recipient’s choice. It would also be desirable, according to the will, if the scholarship recipient could, during this time, learn to translate the doctors’ Latin phrases into Swedish that is understandable to prospective patients.
Ändamålet är att räntan skall användas t: The purpose is for the interest to be used to fund travel grants for students belonging to the department at Uppsala University that corresponds to the Department of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.
Ändamålet är stipendium för studier wid: The purpose is to provide a scholarship for studies at the university or a study trip for a young person, preferably from the Westmanlands-Dala Nation (the word “nation” is crossed out), who is pursuing studies in economics at the aforementioned institution.
Avkastningen skall användas för något än: The proceeds shall be used for a purpose determined by Stockholm University, provided that this does not result in a reduction in the funding that would otherwise be provided to the university by the state, the City of Stockholm, or another public authority.
Utav denna fonds disponibla avkastning u: From the available proceeds of this fund, three scholarships of eight hundred kronor each are awarded to enrolled students at Stockholm University who are in need, have maintained an exemplary conduct, and have demonstrated talent and diligence in the study of a subject or group of subjects within the experimental natural sciences.

The amount available for such purposes in a given year may be awarded to a single student but shall not be divided among more than two students. When the fund has increased by 50% of its value at the time of the fund’s establishment, [...], if the board deems it appropriate, it shall be divided among three scholarship recipients. Scholarships may also be awarded to younger licentiates or recently promoted doctors whom the board wishes to provide an opportunity for continued studies. If any of Mrs. Carlgren’s children or Rikard Kjellberg were to pursue studies at the university, they would be equally entitled to receive the amount available for scholarships, provided that, while enrolled at the university, they conducted their studies in a manner deemed satisfactory by the board.
Av fondens årliga ränteavkastning lägges: Ten percent of the fund’s annual interest income is added to the principal. The remainder may be distributed as one or more scholarships—but no more than four—to students in the university’s Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, with preference given to those studying mathematics, mechanics, or astronomy.
Stiftelsens avkastning får utdelas i for: The foundation’s investment income may be distributed twice a year in the form of scholarships to deserving students
Förvaltning av fonden. Av fondens avkast: Management of the Fund. Each year, 10% of the Fund’s returns shall be added to the principal. The remainder shall be distributed, with one-tenth going to each parish previously eligible for the Fund, to be used for scholarships for young people who own—or whose parents own—agricultural property eligible for the Fund and who are pursuing studies beyond the elementary school level. The return may also be used for local heritage preservation, provided that no more than 10% of the return is used for the latter purpose.
Att dels ge stipendier för fördjupade st: To award scholarships for advanced studies in the classical languages to students who are expected to become competent clergy in the Church of Sweden, and to award scholarships for participation in courses and conferences for continuing education for clergy and other personnel with similar theological training who are active within the Church of Sweden. In a decision dated January 7, 2025, the Kammarkollegiet granted the foundation permission to use both capital and investment income for this purpose.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål dels att frä: The purpose of the foundation is, on the one hand, to promote the study of Judaica or other related subjects among young people, and, on the other hand, to support individuals who study or practice the visual or musical arts by using the foundation’s funds to provide grants for study trips or further education in Sweden or abroad in the form of scholarships.
Till flitig. ordentlig och medellös stud: For diligent, responsible, and financially disadvantaged students, with priority given to relatives. Scholarships for applicants outside the family are awarded to philosophy students who have been enrolled at the university for no more than three years.
Avkastningen av fonden skall, sedan mins: Once at least one-tenth of the fund has been added to the principal, the returns on the fund shall be distributed as scholarships to needy theology students at Uppsala University who belong to the Västmanland-Dala Nation or who were born or raised in Västmanland or Dalarna. The Cathedral Chapter has the authority to decide on the number of scholarships and their amounts; however, no more than three scholarships may be awarded annually. The scholarships are awarded by the Cathedral Chapter upon recommendation from the nation’s senior council. The same recipient may be awarded a scholarship on multiple occasions.
Utdela stipendier till musikintresserade: Award scholarships to students at Stockholm University and other higher education institutions who are interested in music and have a talent for singing, to support their further training as choral singers.
Utaf årliga afkastningen från denna fond: From the annual proceeds of this fund, His Majesty the King shall personally award a travel grant to one or more distinguished officers of the Army or Navy, including the Coastal Artillery, to pursue studies abroad in such military matters in which thorough insight is of particular importance for safeguarding the independence of our beloved fatherland and preserving it for future generations.
Medlen används för utdelning av stipendi: The funds are used to award scholarships—usually two—to deserving students who have completed an advanced course at the Military Academy.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att genom bidrag: The purpose of the Foundation is to support the activities of the Museum of the History of Medicine through grants for acquisitions, with a particular focus on objects and similar items that shed light on the development of nursing, and to provide financial support for the documentation of the development of nursing education and nursing in Gothenburg, the history of Gothenburg’s hospitals, and the development of health care in the city.
1. Till medellös, förtjänt studerande. E: 1. For deserving students with limited financial means. One scholarship per faculty/department. Cannot be awarded to anyone who has reached the age of 27 by the application deadline. 2. One or more travel grants for international travel for scientific purposes. Preference will be given to applicants who currently hold, or have held within the past three years, a scholarship as described in 1 above.
Avkastningen skall årligen efter ledigfö: The proceeds shall be distributed annually, following the announcement in March, to deserving students in the civil engineering program specializing in civil engineering at Luleå University of Applied Sciences.
Ändamålet är att främja ungdoms utbildni: The purpose is to promote the education of young people by awarding one or more scholarships annually to students at the Stockholm School of Economics. However, no more than three students may receive a scholarship at any given time. The same scholarship recipient may be awarded a scholarship on multiple occasions.
Ett eller flera resestipendier till stud: One or more travel grants are available to students at Uppsala University for stays in Norway, Denmark, Finland, or Iceland to pursue studies there for at least one semester that promote knowledge of the national conditions, or to study subjects not offered at universities and colleges in Sweden. The applicant’s financial situation will be taken into account.
Samfondens årliga avkastning skall. seda: The annual return on the pooled fund shall, after at least 10 percent has been added to the principal, be used to benefit students in the elementary teacher education programs through scholarships and initiatives to promote well-being.
Till medellös teol.-, jur.-, med.- och f: For low-income students of theology, law, medicine, and the humanities, as well as one student of mathematics, with priority given to relatives. A travel grant is awarded from the fund every four years.
Till skicklig studerande, som i brist på: To deserving students who, due to a lack of sufficient funds, may need this financial aid.
Till manlig studerande av Östgöta nation: To a male student of the Östgöta Nation who has demonstrated academic aptitude. If no qualified applicant from the Östgöta Nation has applied, the scholarship may be awarded to a male student from another nation. Preference is given to applicants who intend to use the scholarship to cover the costs of a specific academic research project or the printing costs of an academic work.
Avkastningen av fonden - sedan minst tio: The returns on the fund—after at least ten percent of the gross returns have been added to the principal—may be used, on the one hand, as scholarships for prosecutors and trainee prosecutors at the Court of Appeals for studies designed to further their judicial training, and, on the other hand, as grants to provide financial assistance to prosecutors and trainee prosecutors at the Court of Appeals when needed, in both cases, provided that, in the event of equal eligibility, noble officials shall have priority in receiving benefits from the fund.
Fondens ändamål är att genom fondavkastn: The purpose of the fund is to use its investment returns to promote the internationalization of education within the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at Linköping University by awarding scholarships to one or more Swedish students in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences who intend to study at a college or university abroad for at least one semester. Grants may also be awarded to faculty members in the undergraduate program at the Faculty of Philosophy to cover costs associated with a stay at a foreign institution of higher education.
Till behövande studerande. Företräde för: For students in need. Priority is given to students with the surname Bergström from the family of the same name to which the industrial inspector Ejnar Oliver Bergström belonged, as well as to students with the surname Kraft from the family of the same name to which the donor, the industrial inspector’s widow Carolina Bergström, belonged. Scholarships for applicants who have proven their kinship are awarded to students at all universities and colleges in the country.
Den årliga avkastningen skall såsom stip: The annual income shall be distributed as scholarships to female students enrolled in the physical education teacher training program at the Swedish School of Sport and Health Sciences; in addition, a portion of the income may be allocated to travel grants for female teachers.
Den årliga avkastningen, sedan minst en: The annual return, after at least one-tenth has been added to the principal, may, upon a decision by the Board of Directors, be used to fund scholarships for students at the Swedish School of Sport and Health Sciences.
Till den mest behövande av flitiga och l: To the most deserving of the diligent and promising medical students of the Västgöta Nation. Preference, regardless of nation, is given to applicants who are training to become physicians and have expressed interest to the Swedish Church Mission regarding future service within the mission, and who are also deemed suitable missionary candidates by the mission. The Faculty of Medicine appoints the scholarship recipient unless the applicant registers as a missionary candidate, in which case the Director of Missions awards the scholarship, which may also be granted to students at Lund University and the Karolinska Institute, though one of the scholarships is reserved for a student at Uppsala University.
Ett eller flera stipendier till manlig s: One or more scholarships for male students who are Swedish citizens and of Swedish descent on both their father’s and mother’s sides. He must be from one of the following regions of Sweden: Småland, Öland, Östergötland (with the exception of Norrköping and its surrounding area), Västergötland (with the exception of the part belonging to Gothenburg County), Närke, Västmanland, Södermanland, and Uppland (with the exception of Stockholm and its surrounding area). Applicants from Stockholm may be descendants of the old Schmidt family of Maria, originally from Stralsund. The scholarship recipient must “currently be in need of medical or sanatorium care, though not terminally ill, with hope that he may regain his health.” Preference is given to needy relatives who receive the scholarship for the entire duration of their stay at the university.
För vetenskapliga undersökningar av natu: For scientific research on the natural conditions in Dalarna, primarily in the fields of geology, including paleontology and hydrogeology. Scholarships are awarded every two years by the Office of the President, upon the recommendation of a special committee, to Ph.D. candidates or students affiliated with the Västmanland-Dala Nation, or to those who can prove their origin in Dalarna.
Till jur., statsvetensk. eller histories: For students of law, political science, or history, or for anyone wishing to engage in teaching, with preference given first to certain relatives and second to students of the Stockholm or Östgöta Nations. In the event of a tie among equally qualified applicants, financial need shall be taken into account in the selection process.
Till flitig och för goda seder känd stud: To a diligent student of the Kalmar Nation, known for his good character.
Av den årliga bruttoavkastningen lägges: Ten percent of the annual gross return shall be added to the fund’s capital. The remainder, after deduction of the bank’s custodial fee, shall be used annually to award scholarships to one or more medical students at the University of Gothenburg who have demonstrated academic aptitude, satisfactorily completed their studies, and are in need of financial support for their studies.
Ändamålet är att av den därefter återstå: The purpose is that, as determined by the Gothenburg Board of Education, the remaining annual return shall be used to provide scholarships to deserving students in or from Gothenburg who wish to pursue studies in the graphic arts. One-fourth (1/4) may be allocated for the purchase of equipment and materials for instruction in the graphic arts.
Fondens ändamål skall vara att utdela st: The purpose of the Fund shall be to award scholarships to assist with the costs of education at the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Gothenburg for less well-off, Swedish-born, talented, and diligent students. For this purpose, once the fund, together with retained returns, amounts to one hundred thousand (100,000) kronor, two-tenths of the retained annual returns (2/10) of the retained annual return shall be added to the principal, and the remaining eight-tenths (8/10) shall be made available by the bank to the Faculty of Medicine to be distributed, at its discretion, as study grants of approximately 1,500 kronor each for the aforementioned purpose.
Avkastningen skall användas, förutom ege: The proceeds shall be used, in addition to maintaining the property in good condition, to provide scholarships of an appropriate amount to at least two and no more than ten sons or daughters of farmers residing in Fjäre parish; the scholarship recipients shall be young men and women, between the ages of 18 and 25, who are known to be of good character and interested in agriculture. Scholarships may be awarded to the same person for a maximum of five consecutive years and are intended to, in one way or another, better prepare the young people for their future livelihoods, such as through contributions toward attending agricultural school, home economics courses, etc., or as travel grants, special studies, etc.
Fonden har till ändamål att ekonomiskt s: The purpose of the fund is to provide financial support and encouragement to female students at the Department of Literature at Stockholm University who have demonstrated artistic talent in poetry or who have otherwise made an outstanding contribution to the study of French literary history or film criticism. Grants from the fund are to be used for studies in France.
Afkomsten å det sålunda tillökade stipen: The proceeds from the scholarship fund thus increased are used to provide annual scholarships of six hundred (600) kronor to as many students as the interest allows; these scholarships are awarded, after review by the university board, to students who are of limited means, have been enrolled at the university for at least two years, and have distinguished themselves during that time for diligence and exemplary conduct in all respects; provided, however, that the scholarships in question may not be held by the same person for a period exceeding three years.
Den disponobla avkastningen skall årlige: The available proceeds shall be used annually to award travel grants to art students at the Department of Art History and to students at the Department of Ancient Culture and Society. The proceeds shall be divided equally between the departments.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the fund’s returns to provide scholarships to prospective nurses studying at the Department of Health Sciences at Kristianstad University. One scholarship will be awarded each semester.
Stiftelsens har till ändamål att, utan b: The purpose of the Foundation is, without limitation to specific individuals, to promote scientific research and provide support for the development of teaching and education in technical fields. These objectives shall primarily be promoted by the Foundation awarding grants (scholarships) to students at both the university and high school levels whose studies are deemed to be particularly successful or whose theses are deemed to have special technical/scientific value. Support may also be provided through research grants and contributions to technical and scientific publications.
Räntan skall användas för att bereda Röd: The interest shall be used to provide grants for recreational activities to nurses and students trained at the Red Cross College, and shall be distributed once a year on my birthday, June 22.
Fondens årliga avkastningen skall av kol: At the end of the academic year, the Board shall award the Fund’s annual return to a deserving high school graduate who has declared their intention to study either architecture (at the Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg, or at another technical university that may be established in the future) or medicine (at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm, at the medical faculty in Uppsala or Lund, or at another medical school that may be established in the future). In this regard, a high school graduate intending to study architecture shall have priority, provided that the applicant has otherwise demonstrated merit for the scholarship. If there are multiple applicants at any given time, and qualifications are otherwise equal, consideration shall be given to the applicant’s need for financial support. The scholarship amount shall be awarded to the recipient upon confirmed enrollment at the respective college or university.
Räntan av kapitalet skall av styrelsen å: The interest on the capital shall be used annually by the Board to award scholarships to talented and ambitious students in the graduating class. These scholarships are intended to assist with continued theoretical or practical studies in Sweden or abroad. The scholarship may be awarded in full to a single student or divided among several students, at the Board’s discretion. The scholarship recipient shall, in a manner determined by the Board, submit some form of report on the use of the funds. The awarding of scholarships shall be based on applications from students in the graduating class. In the event that no applications are received, the interest for that year shall be added to the capital.
Ändamålet är att av den årliga avkastnin: The purpose is that, after at least one-tenth of the annual return has been added to the principal, 20 percent shall be used to provide grants to patients at the Lung and Allergy Clinic at Huddinge Hospital, and 80 percent shall be used to provide grants to patients at the Stockholm University Geriatric Clinic.
Avkastningen skall användas för beredand: The proceeds shall be used to provide housing or housing assistance to students at Uppsala University, primarily those who are or have been enrolled in the Faculty of Theology. Scholarships may also be awarded to students at the Fjellstedt School in Uppsala for the aforementioned or other purposes.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att genom: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote artistic education for students at the following institutions at the University of Gothenburg by awarding scholarships to talented and successful students: the School of Music and Drama and HDK-Valand
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av avkastning: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to award cash housing grants to students at the University of Gothenburg, Chalmers University of Technology, the School of Economics, and any future institutions of higher education established in Gothenburg.
Att ge ungdom, som påbörjat studier inom: To provide young people who have begun studies in the arts with opportunities to further their education, for example through study abroad programs.
En femtedel av avkastningen vid vederbör: One-fifth of the return at the end of the relevant fiscal year shall be added to the principal, and the remainder, in amounts of at least five hundred /500/ kronor annually, shall be distributed as scholarships to medical students at the institute who, after two years of such studies, have proven themselves worthy of such support and are in need of financial assistance for their continued studies. A scholarship may amount to a maximum of three thousand /3,000/ kronor and may be awarded to the same person for up to four /4/ consecutive years, but not thereafter.
Kvarlåtenskapen skall tillfalla Sahlgren: The estate shall be bequeathed to Sahlgrenska Hospital in Gothenburg to be used, at the discretion of its board, for scholarships for medical students.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utge stipendi: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to one or more musically gifted young people in the municipality of Helsingborg, to be used for studies in classical music. One-tenth of the fund’s annual return shall be allocated to the principal.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at the Faculty of Economics at Lund University who have demonstrated an interest in and aptitude for economic studies, with priority given to those who have shown a particular interest in subjects related to the savings bank system.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den disponibl: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns as one or more scholarships to students at Chalmers University of Technology or to engineers who have graduated from the university.
Avkastningen av fonden skall fördelas i: The proceeds from the fund shall be distributed in the form of scholarships of 1,000 kronor each, awarded to students at the institute who are in need of financial support to continue their studies and who, through diligence and academic achievement, have proven themselves worthy of encouragement.
Årligen ska utdela rese- och studiestipe: Each year, the foundation shall award travel and study grants totaling at least 24,000 SEK, with annual adjustments based on the consumer price index. The grants are primarily awarded to students studying painting in the Fine Arts program at the University of Gothenburg.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att genom ut: The purpose of the foundation is to encourage study abroad by awarding scholarships. Of the foundation’s annual returns, 30% shall be allocated to scholarships for teachers and other staff, and 50% shall be allocated to scholarships for students who are members of the student union at Blekinge International School of Health (BIH).
Stiftelsen skall ha som ändamål att främ: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote education and studies at the upper secondary and post-secondary levels, or their equivalents, for young people who reside or study in the municipalities of Uddevalla and Trollhättan, with particular attention given to young people who reside or study in Ljungskile and the surrounding area. This purpose shall be fulfilled primarily through the awarding of scholarships to individual students for studies abroad, during which academic studies are combined with language studies. Scholarships may, secondarily, be awarded for equivalent studies in Sweden. The purpose may also be fulfilled through grants to specific joint educational projects for the aforementioned young people.
1. Till studerande av Smålands nation ti: 1. For students in the Faculty of Humanities affiliated with the Småland Nation. Priority shall be given primarily to the applicant’s academic achievements and need for financial aid. Preference is given to those pursuing studies in classical archaeology or the classical languages. The Småland Nation’s inspector and senior council appoint the scholarship recipient. May be held for three years. The scholarship is suspended every fourth year, and in the fifth year, the accumulated scholarship funds are distributed as 2. A travel grant for students, regardless of nation affiliation, for studies abroad in classical archaeology.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den disponibl: The purpose of the Foundation is that the available income shall primarily be used to provide scholarships to diligent and talented Swedish students at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg who, in order to complete their studies, are in need of financial support and have earned it, as well as for purposes that promote the interests of the university.

The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns to students at Chalmers University of Technology in the Department of Civil Engineering, preferably to students who are working on their thesis or a project in the field of construction materials.

The purpose of the foundation is to use the available returns to award scholarships for study abroad to Swedish-born students at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg, preferably to those engaged in the practical application of electricity.
The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns to deserving students in need at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg.

The purpose of the Foundation is to distribute the available returns annually as scholarships to students of limited means who demonstrate good character and a aptitude for their studies at Chalmers University of Technology. If there are compelling reasons to discontinue the distribution of scholarships, the returns shall be used to purchase equipment for the university.
The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns as scholarships to low-income students at Chalmers University of Technology.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ge Chalmers t: The purpose of the Foundation is to enable Chalmers University of Technology to support associations affiliated with the university and, when necessary, to provide financial assistance to ensure that the university’s ceremonies are conducted in a festive manner befitting the institution. The university’s Local Board is authorized to use the funds for purposes other than those specified above; however, the aforementioned purposes shall take precedence.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den disponibl: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns as scholarships to students at Chalmers University of Technology who are majoring in a field related to municipal engineering (traffic, streets, roads, sewers, water supply, bridges, ports, and urban planning) and who are deemed to have earned such support.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to fund scholarships for deserving students at Chalmers University of Technology.

The purpose of the foundation is to use the returns from the fund to provide scholarships that enable students at the Department of Electrical Engineering and Power Electronics at Chalmers University of Technology to undertake various study trips.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den disponibl: The purpose of the Foundation is to use the available returns to provide qualified applicants with opportunities for further education in chemistry or chemical engineering. The scholarship is intended to facilitate study trips, the results of which are expected to benefit the Swedish chemical industry. The scholarship shall primarily be awarded to a civil engineer who has graduated from Chalmers University of Technology or the Royal Institute of Technology and who has worked successfully for at least three years in the branch of industry in which he wishes to further his studies; however, it may also be awarded to other applicants who have demonstrated merit through their academic qualifications and practical experience.
The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns as scholarships, primarily for study trips abroad for students at Chalmers University of Technology.
Stipendiefonden har till ändamål att ber: The purpose of the scholarship fund is to provide deserving naval officers who have completed the staff or technical courses in the naval branch at the Royal Military Academy with opportunities to study languages at foreign educational institutions. The scholarships are awarded at the conclusion of the program to deserving students by the Commandant of the Royal Military Academy, following consultation with the Chief of the Navy.
Fonden används till belönande af för men: The fund is used to reward inventions or works that are of particular importance and benefit to the enlightenment, progress, and brotherhood of humanity. As a guide to assessing what the donor intends by this, the following may be mentioned: inventions comparable to the rotary press, the telegraph, the telephone, photography, the propeller, the sewing machine, Bessemer steel production, and the diphtheria serum, as well as ingenious civil engineering works such as the Suez Canal, the tunnels through the Alps, the Firth of Forth Bridge, and the like. Inventions eligible for the award must be fully realized and, based on experience, found to be useful in practice for their intended purposes. This award shall consist of a gold medal. The remainder of the available annual proceeds, after the cost of the medal has been deducted where applicable, shall be used for one or more scholarships for practical engineering studies abroad.
Disponibel afkastning skall användas til: The available funds shall be used to support zoological studies; such support may be granted only to native Swedish men, preferably those born in Kronoberg County.
Disponibel avkastning utdelas som ett st: The available proceeds are awarded as a scholarship to support a young student pursuing studies in chemistry at a university or college. The scholarship is awarded for a maximum of five years, subject to annual review. The recipient must be a native-born Swede.
Fondens ändamål är dels att åt söner, me: The purpose of the Fund is, on the one hand, to award scholarships to the sons—and also to the daughters—of the Swedish members and regular officials of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences for studies at institutions of higher education, and, on the other hand, to provide an annuity to the donor’s descendants as long as such descendants exist. The term “officials” here refers not only to the Academy’s own officials, but also to the directors and officials appointed by the Academy at the institutions placed under its supervision and care.
Disponibel avkastning utdelas årligen so: The available funds are distributed annually as grants to young students for travel within Sweden for the purpose of studying lower invertebrates, whether fossilized or living.
Disponibel avkastning uppdelas i stipend: The available funds are allocated to scholarships, which are awarded annually as grants for academic studies or continuing practical training in Sweden or abroad.
1. Till vid rikets univ. studerande släk: 1. To students at universities throughout the kingdom who are relatives of Lieutenant Colonel W. A. Nisser or War Councilor S. C. Nisser, with preference given to students at Uppsala University. Scholarships are awarded primarily to those who claim the closest kinship, and secondarily as merit-based scholarships. In the event of equal merit, financial need shall be the deciding factor. 2. To needy, diligent students of the Västm.-Dala Nation.
Fondens behållna avkastning skall lika f: The fund’s retained earnings shall be distributed equally among the following three institutions: a) The Tioöres Association in Karlshamn, to be used, in accordance with a decision by the association’s board, to promote the care of elderly people in need. Should the Tioöres Association in Karlshamn be dissolved or otherwise cease its activities, the portion of the fund’s returns intended for the association shall instead be used for other charitable purposes in Karlshamn, and in such a case, Göteborgs Bank shall be responsible for arranging this and shall commission a suitable institution in Karlshamn to administer the distribution of the returns. b) The Blekinge Nation in Lund, to be used for travel grants for studies in France or England for students who, regardless of faculty, are enrolled in the Nation and are still studying in Lund. c) The Faculty of Medicine at the University of Gothenburg, to be used for grants for studies in France or England. The scholarships may only be awarded to licensed physicians. The income from the fund shall be made available to the three institutions at intervals determined by the Notarial Department, and no more frequently than when the available return amounts to such a sum that the one-third thereof allocated to the Faculty of Medicine is sufficient for at least one scholarship of at least 1,000 kronor or the higher amount that the Notarial Department, taking into account the value of money, deems reasonable to constitute the scholarship amount. The distribution of the aforementioned grants and scholarships by the three institutions shall take place on my mother’s birthday, November 1, each year.
Resestipendier för botaniska studier utd: Travel grants for botanical studies are awarded every five years by the Biology Section upon the recommendation of a committee composed of representatives from botany, zoology, and pharmacognosy, with the most senior professor in the botanical disciplines serving as chair.
Ett eller flera stipendier till studeran: One or more scholarships for students who have demonstrated "outstanding progress in the study of history."
Fondens ändamål är att genom utdelning a: The purpose of the fund is to provide instruction and training in the field of military operations and to promote studies in the field of military science by awarding scholarships to deserving students from the armed forces who are enrolled in the Swedish National Defence College’s courses in Higher Military Education.
Disponibel avkastning skall utdelas som: The available proceeds shall be distributed as grants to suitable clergy within the diocese, to enable them to pursue theological studies at foreign universities or churches.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stödja intern: The purpose of the Foundation is to support the internationalization of education at Lund University through individual and/or group travel grants, with priority given to students in the social sciences and technical fields. Should the University, due to external world events or circumstances, be unable in any given year to award travel grants or otherwise allocate returns in accordance with the Foundation’s purpose, the Savings Bank’s Board of Directors shall decide on the use of funds for a similar purpose.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att tillhandahåll: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide premises for the Lund University Course Activities Foundation and to provide financial support for said activities.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual investment income as a scholarship to a graduate with a Master of Science in Engineering from the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg who has earned the highest grade in mathematics.

The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the proceeds in the form of scholarships to low-income students, with at least half of the scholarship amount to be awarded to individuals pursuing theological studies.
The purpose of the foundation is that the annual returns be used to award scholarships to two male theology students from Blekinge studying at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den disponibl: The purpose of the foundation is to use the available returns to fund scholarships for theology students belonging to the Gothenburg and Västgöta nations in Uppsala and Lund, as well as the Halland nation in Lund.
Den årliga avkastningen skall i samband: The annual proceeds shall be awarded, in conjunction with the Academy’s annual ceremony, as a scholarship to a student currently enrolled at the Academy of Fine Arts or a recent graduate of the Academy who has demonstrated promising academic performance.
Av fondens medel skall, sedan avdrag för: From the Fund’s assets, after deducting administrative expenses, one or more scholarships shall be awarded to students with disabilities or students in need who are enrolled at the Royal Institute of Art in Stockholm and have demonstrated promising academic performance, with particular attention given to academic performance in the field of drawing.
Avkastningen skall årligen användas som: The proceeds shall be used annually to provide travel grants to young Swedish citizens who, having been commended for exemplary conduct and good character, are found to possess outstanding talent for painting, sculpture, or architecture, and who, after preparatory studies in their home country, also wish to gain a more complete education and, if possible, the highest level of training in the fine arts through travel and study in foreign countries. Equality regarding the size and number of scholarships over a longer period shall apply to the three categories.
Fondens avkastning skall, sedan 10 - 15: After 10–15% has been added to the fund’s capital, the remainder of the fund’s returns shall be used primarily for the beautification and maintenance of Ryda Church and its cemetery. The entire annual return shall not go entirely to Ryda Church; rather, payments shall be made for the following purposes: a/ Maintenance and care of our family grave at Ryda Cemetery, grave site no. 77, the Karlsson brothers’ family grave. Planting of spring and summer flowers in the existing flower box and placement of a winter wreath. If necessary, a professional grave maintenance company shall be hired to realign the headstone should it become misaligned or similar issues arise. Reapplication of gold leaf to the inscription shall be performed when such a need arises. b/ Funds shall be paid annually to the Tengene Parish for the maintenance of my grandfather August Karlsson’s family grave at Tengene Cemetery. c/ The parish hall in Håkantorp is allocated an annual grant of up to 10,000 SEK for maintenance and operating costs, at the discretion of the church council. d/ A summer trip is organized for those who have reached retirement age and live in Ryda parish. The trip may include a full-day bus excursion to one or more interesting locations, and a good meal is provided for those who participate. e/ During the Christmas season, a small bouquet of flowers is given to each resident at Rydahemmet. f/ Funds may also be allocated for the organization of an annual song and music service at Ryda Church. For this service, a well-known soloist may be engaged, preferably an opera singer, and a skilled violinist or cellist may also be appropriate to add variety to this annual musical service. g/ Upon review by the church council, the Ryda Church Choir may receive an annual grant of up to 1,000 SEK. h/ An annual scholarship of 7,500 SEK may, subject to the board’s approval, be awarded to young college students studying voice and music from the Ryda parish. It is my wish that funds be allocated to keep the church’s existing facade lighting on during the dark season. Please also acquire a few larger stone planters for summer flowers and place them in suitable locations around the church. Feel free to consult an expert advisor and ensure the floral display is abundant, to the delight of visitors to Ryda Church and the cemetery.
Fondens årliga avkastning skall läggas t: The Fund’s annual return shall be added to the principal until the annual return on the principal has grown to an amount that can provide genuine assistance. It is up to the Nation to determine when the return may be used for scholarship purposes, which, however, may not occur until—subject to the provision below regarding allocation to the principal—the return can provide a scholarship of at least 500 kronor. Once it has been determined that the annual return may be used for scholarship purposes, one-fifth thereof shall first be allocated to the capital. Priority for receiving a scholarship shall be given to students at Uppsala University who are direct descendants of my husband or my parents and who are in need of financial aid for their studies. If there are no applicants for the scholarship with such priority, the scholarship shall be awarded to a needy student belonging to the Småland Nation in Uppsala. The scholarship is awarded for a period of three years, with a possible one-year extension.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja underv: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote the teaching and study of the French language. This purpose shall be fulfilled primarily through the awarding of travel grants for studies at a French university to: a) students at a Swedish university who have earned 40 credits or the equivalent in the French language; b) licensed nurses with a good command of the French language. For applicants in this group, documented active participation in sports shall be considered a merit. Scholarships may only be awarded to applicants who have not reached the age of 30. II students with a diploma from a school teaching according to the International Baccalaureate program in Eastern Europe with well-documented knowledge of French. Upon fulfillment of the purpose, an even distribution between Groups I and II shall be sought. Scholarships for individuals in Group II shall be awarded for a period of twenty (20) years following the foundation’s establishment. Thereafter, scholarships shall be awarded exclusively to individuals who meet the requirements under I a) and I b), with distribution among them at the foundation’s discretion.
Stipendiet, som utgöres av tvenne års sa: The scholarship, which consists of two years’ worth of interest earned on the scholarship fund, is intended to be awarded for the pursuit of studies in bacteriology or hygiene abroad for a period of at least three months.
Av avkastningen skall årligen 1/20 lägga: One-twentieth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, while the remaining return shall be used to fund scholarships for medical students at Karolinska Institutet or the universities of Uppsala and Lund who have pursued their studies with diligence and achieved good results, who are expected to benefit greatly from further education, and who, for financial reasons, have difficulty completing their studies.
Utdelas vartannat år av medicinska fakul: Awarded every two years by the Faculty of Medicine, upon the recommendation of the Stip Inspector and the Chair of the Department of Internal Medicine, for travel within or outside Sweden for studies of a practical or theoretical nature related to internal medicine.
Till studerande av Smålands nation, varv: To students of the Småland Nation, with greater emphasis placed on skill and talent than on the need for financial aid.
