Till kvinnlig jur.stud. vid Uppsala, Lun: For female law students at Uppsala, Lund, or Stockholm University. Preference will be given to those working on a doctoral dissertation, and if two scholarships from the fund are available, they are eligible to receive both.
Som studiehjälp till synnerligen förtjän: As a scholarship for a particularly deserving student of the Värmland Nation.
Till medellös, flitig studerande av Stoc: To a financially disadvantaged, diligent student of the Stockholm Nation, with preference given to those who have passed the high school diploma or its equivalent at the New Elementary School in Stockholm, and primarily to applicants who have studied in the classical track. The following are awarded: 1. To law students, with preference given to those intending to train as judges; 2. To applicants studying the humanities (classical languages, history, modern languages, literary history, and geography), with preference given to the various subject groups and subjects within them in the order listed above.
Ett eller flera stipendier till 1. Stude: One or more scholarships for 1. Students at Uppsala University or 2. Other students or professionals who intend to acquire specialized knowledge in orthopedic technology or related orthopedic surgery.
Till studerande som efter högsta examen: For students who, after completing their highest degree at the Faculty of Arts and Sciences, remain at the university to pursue graduate studies. The term “highest degree” refers to a licentiate degree, with the exception of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, where a doctoral degree is required, and the Faculties of Theology and Law, where a scholarship may be awarded to a student who has only completed a bachelor’s degree if a qualifying licentiate degree is not available. A scholarship may not be awarded to anyone who, more than three years prior to the application deadline, has completed a licentiate degree in the subject in which he or she intends to continue his or her academic studies.
Dels till arvoden m m till särskilt inbj: Partly for honoraria and other expenses for specially invited lecturers, and partly for travel grants for theology students to study religious and church life.
Stipendium utdelas till den som i Uppsal: The scholarship is awarded to anyone who has earned a Bachelor of Theologyor a licentiate degree in theology at Uppsala University, where one of the subjects includes Old or New Testament exegesis, or to those who have passed a doctoral examination at Uppsala University qualifying them for biblical studies in the Middle East, for travel to “Palestine and neighboring countries” to conduct archaeological, historical, linguistic, geographical, or topographical studies of biblical interest.
Att medelst stipendier möjliggöra för st: To provide scholarships enabling students at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at Uppsala University to undertake study trips within Europe for educational purposes. A maximum of twenty scholarships shall be awarded annually. One-fifth (1/5) of the income from the donation shall be added to the principal annually.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that, upon the recommendation of the Student Union, the proceeds shall be allocated as scholarships to students at Lund University who are pursuing studies in the humanities.
Ett eller två resestipendier skall utdel: One or two travel grants will be awarded to students in the painting and sculpture departments of the art college, with priority given to students in their final year.
Årlig avkastning utdelas till yngre vete: The annual award is presented to young scholars at Uppsala University who, through their scholarly writings, have distinguished themselves most meritoriously and show the greatest promise for continued scholarly authorship at the university. Consideration may also be given to work that is not yet completed but has been reviewed and highly commended by the relevant faculty or department, and which is expected to be of genuine and outstanding value.
Ett eller flera stipendier till jur.stud: One or more scholarships for law students "who have demonstrated academic aptitude" and are members of the Västmanland-Dala Nation.
Till resestipendier för studerande tillh: For travel grants for students enrolled in the Faculty of Medicine. These grants are intended for medical students planning study trips abroad.
Till studerande, som med nit och skickli: For students who study Egyptology or Semitic languages with diligence and skill, but not for those who study Hebrew to obtain priestly qualifications. Preference will be given to applicants whose studies and work deal with the philosophical ideas of the ancient Egyptians or to those who have engaged in the preservation of ancient Egyptian associations of ideas. Both scholarships may, if there are particularly deserving applicants, be awarded to students of Egyptology.
1. Till medellös studerande med framståe: 1. For financially disadvantaged students with outstanding academic ability. Awarded alternately among the faculties of Theology, Law, Medicine, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 2. Travel grants for students for domestic or international study trips. Awarded every four years within the faculty that, in that year, has a designated allocation within the fund.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the Foundation is to ensure that the proceeds are at the free disposal of the Faculty of Medicine at Lund University for scientific purposes for which government funding is not available and for which grants from other university funds cannot be expected.
Till sökande som går sista året i gymnas: For applicants in their final year of high school who write 200 lines of Latin poetry per semester and commit to beginning studies in Latin at Uppsala University upon completion of high school. Preference is given to applicants from high schools in Linköping or Kalmar. If there are no applicants meeting the above criteria, the scholarship will be awarded to students at Uppsala University who are studying Latin, with preference given to those specifically studying Latin poetry and to those belonging to the Östgöta or Kalmar student nations.
Att utge understöd till två änkor efter: To provide financial support to two widows of individuals who served at the university.
Ett eller flera stipendier till estniska: One or more scholarships for Estonian students from the University of Tartu to study at Uppsala University, preferably in the Faculty of Science and Technology.
Att gagna den rena evangeliska kyrkan i: To benefit the Evangelical Church in Sweden by making contributions to the board of the Student Residence (Norrbyska Studenthemmet) in order to help prepare capable ministers for the Swedish Church, in accordance with the bylaws governing this residence.
Till ett eller flera resestipendier (för: For one or more travel grants (for domestic or international travel) for university library staff.
Att årliga räntan användes för inköp och: That the annual interest be used for the purchase and organization of fungal collections or for other purposes that promote the study of fungi, provided, however, that this does not result in a reduction of the Department’s existing funding from Uppsala University. This amendment is effective as of August 9, 2006.
Att belöna eller möjliggöra vetenskaplig: To fund or facilitate scholarly research on adult education, with a focus on the origins and development of Swedish adult education. First and foremost, the fund covers the costs of organizing Carl Cederblad’s posthumous papers so that they can be transferred to the University Library in Uppsala. The fund’s capital may also be used to provide grants for the conduct of major research projects or for their publication.
Att dela ut stipendier för högre skol- o: To award scholarships for secondary and university studies to financially disadvantaged young people with a talent for learning. Scholarships shall be awarded to young people who have grown up in Blekinge. However, the board shall give priority to at least five young people who have grown up in the municipality of Lyckeby before making decisions regarding awards to other eligible candidates.
Att bereda pensionsunderstöd vid Uppsala: To provide pension assistance at Uppsala University.
Till studerande, som är infödda svenskar: This scholarship is intended for students who are native Swedes and members of the Church of Sweden, with priority given to those who have a relative eligible for one of the scholarships. Priority is then given, first to those from the province of Södermanland, and second to those from the dioceses of Västerås or Karlstad. Priority is also given to those whose studies include earth sciences.
Åtta stipendier fördelade i fyra klasser: Eight scholarships, divided into four categories, are awarded to deserving, hardworking students at Uppsala University as follows: Four scholarships for theology students; two of the recipients must be born in Stockholm and two in Ångermanland. Two scholarships: one for a student born in Östergötland and one for a student born in Västergötland. One scholarship is awarded to applicants studying languages and the other to applicants studying archaeology, history, or economic history. Two scholarships regardless of field of study; one scholarship to an applicant born in Uppland and one to an applicant born in Stockholm.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att resterande rä: The purpose of the foundation is that the remaining interest income shall be distributed every two or three years, depending on the size of the return (if no distribution takes place, the interest is added to the principal), to a student of art history who is writing a dissertation, to be used for printing costs or possibly also distributed for work-related purposes related to the same dissertation or for study trips abroad related to the same dissertation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds primarily to fund music instruction for particularly musically gifted but technically less skilled band members, to otherwise support the participation of younger band members in the band’s activities, to expand the music library, and to acquire materials that promote the students’ general musical education.

The purpose of the foundation is that the proceeds be used to support musical activities associated with the university, for example in the form of scholarships for students who participate in the activities of the university orchestra or for students pursuing studies in musicology (should a professorship or professorships in musicology subjects be established at Lund University in the future).
Stiftelsens årliga avkastningen, sedan e: The Foundation’s annual return, after one-tenth of it has been added to the principal, may be used to provide scholarships to deserving students in need. Students enrolled in the elementary school teacher education program at the university are eligible to apply for scholarships from the fund.
Fondens medel skall årligen ställas till: The Fund’s assets shall be made available annually for scholarships for students of botany at the University of Gothenburg.
Sedan en tiondel av den årliga avkastnin: After one-tenth of the annual income has been added to the fund’s capital, the remainder shall be used for scholarships for descendants of Chrisofer and Tora Myhre’s siblings who are enrolled at the universities of Uppsala or Lund, at the Karolinska Institute, or at the universities of Gothenburg or Stockholm. If no application is received from such a descendant, the return shall be used for scholarships for students at the University of Gothenburg.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att en tiondel av: The purpose of the foundation is that one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, and the remainder shall be distributed as two travel grants. The grants are intended for study trips to Italy, Greece, or France; in the case of France, specifically for studies in Romanesque and Gothic architecture and art related to the classical monuments of southern France. The scholarships are awarded to those who are continuing their studies in either classical archaeology and ancient history or art history and art theory, with the stipulation that, the first time they are awarded, the scholarships shall be granted to those who are primarily studying classical archaeology and ancient history, and the second time to those who primarily study art history and art theory. If no eligible applicants have applied, the scholarship may be awarded without application to a particularly deserving young scholar who has chosen as a major and earned a degree in Latin philology and literature or Italian philology and literature from the major periods up to the mid-19th century.
Avkastningen skall en gång varje år till: The proceeds shall be awarded once a year to a financially disadvantaged, well-behaved, and talented student in the Faculty of Humanities as a grant to support their studies at Uppsala University or another university. Among several equally qualified applicants for a grant from the fund, students from Medelpad shall be given preference.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to fund travel grants for students of Romance languages. The grant is to be awarded to a candidate holding a Licentiate of Philosophy or a Master of Philosophy degree at an advanced level who, in order to complete a doctoral or licentiate thesis, needs to spend some time in France (or, alternatively, in another Romance-speaking country).
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stipendier få: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships annually, every other year to a maximum of three students at Lund University for studies at the University of Oslo, and every other year to a maximum of three students at the University of Oslo for studies at Lund University.
Avkastningen av fonden skall i första ha: The income from the fund shall primarily benefit needy, talented, and diligent students at the University of Gothenburg in the form of scholarships. In addition, the Board may use the income from the fund for other purposes that benefit the University and its students.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga av: The purpose of the Foundation is that the annual return shall be used for the following: 1) to organize conferences addressing current theological issues, particularly those concerning the relationship between religion and cultural life, 2) to cover the costs of lectures by theologians from abroad or from other Swedish universities, 3) to support travel, thereby providing deserving theologians with the opportunity to study or engage with theological activities in other countries, 4) for other purposes that may be considered related to those mentioned.
Stiftelsens avkastning skall i första ha: The proceeds from the foundation’s assets shall primarily be used in accordance with the provisions of the will: "The purpose of the Foundation shall be to own and manage the aforementioned property (Bön 1:39–41), and from the proceeds of this estate, after first paying out in full two legacies prescribed by the donor to her relatives totaling 12,000 kronor, to provide grants for the following purposes prescribed by the donor: 1. Provide financial assistance to students from Skillingmark who are in need of it. Such financial aid may be provided for both theoretical and practical studies and may pertain to any profession. 2. Make small annual contributions to the church’s mission. 3. Make similar contributions to Swedish seamen’s welfare. 4. The foundation may contribute small amounts toward the maintenance of the local heritage farm, which was separated from its property. 5. If funds are available beyond what is required for the aforementioned purposes, the foundation may provide grants, including for study assistance other than that prescribed in point 1, through the Fjellstedt Foundation and other foundations or schools. It shall be the responsibility of the foundation to maintain the donor’s grave.” Amendment of the purpose pursuant to the decision of the Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency on November 13, 1980: Alternatively, if it proves difficult to find grant recipients in accordance with the provisions of the will, the income may be used for an annual grant of no more than 15,000 kronor per year to the Skillingmark parish for activities among youth, etc. At least 1/10 of the annual income shall be added to the capital.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to divide the annual interest into two equal scholarships, which are awarded to deserving and promising students at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av fondens av: The purpose of the foundation is to allocate one-tenth of the fund’s returns to the principal. The remainder of the fund’s returns is distributed—in full—annually in January of the following year to university students who demonstrate aptitude for their studies, diligence, and exemplary conduct. The scholarship is awarded primarily to descendants of myself and my wife and, secondarily, to students who were born or raised in the districts of Oxie, Skytts, or Vemmenhög.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is for the Faculty of Theology to distribute the annual income as a scholarship to a theology student attending the university who comes from a low-income family, a clergy family, or a farming family in Skåne or Småland, and who has distinguished himself through diligence and good conduct and has demonstrated progress in his theological studies.

The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to provide financial support to young people who, despite having a talent for academic study, diligence, and good character, lack the necessary funds to continue their education. Scholarships shall be awarded to two students, one from the Östgöta Nation and one from the Småland Nation, at Uppsala or Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan av fon: The purpose of the foundation is to award the interest from the fund to three theology students from the Gothenburg Nation who are known for their diligence and dedication, and who were also born within the Diocese of Gothenburg.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that one-tenth of the annual return shall be used to increase the fund, and nine-tenths shall be distributed annually, without application to the university rector, as scholarships to four needy and diligent students at Lund University, one from the Faculty of Theology, one from the Faculty of Law, the medical, and the philosophy faculties, with equal amounts awarded to each of these.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att en tiondel av: The purpose of the foundation is to set aside one-tenth of the fund’s interest income annually to increase the capital. The remainder of the annual interest is distributed each year to female students at Lund University who have demonstrated a genuine passion and exceptional aptitude for the humanities.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the Foundation is that the annual interest shall be used to provide financial support in the form of scholarships to young men enrolled at the university and pursuing an academic degree who are in need of such support and who, through their diligence, conduct, and aptitude for rigorous study, have proven themselves worthy of such assistance from the university.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att en femtedel (: The purpose of the foundation is that one-fifth (1/5) of the annual interest income shall be set aside for the growth of the principal, while the remainder of the interest may be distributed by the university’s Faculty of Law, in amounts determined by the faculty, to students enrolled in the faculty who have earned the right to financial aid, with priority given to law students from the Småland Nation, provided they are otherwise deemed worthy of such aid.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that one-tenth of the annual interest shall be added to the principal. From the remainder, at least two scholarships of at least one thousand two hundred (1,200) kronor shall be awarded annually to well-behaved students of limited means at Lund University who belong to the Gothenburg Nation and were born in the County of Gothenburg and Bohus.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the income, to the extent that it amounts to no more than 5 percent, shall be divided into four equal parts, one of which shall be awarded as a scholarship to a student enrolled at the university in each of the four faculties: the Faculty of Theology, the Faculty of Law, the Faculty of Medicine, and the Faculty of Philosophy. The scholarships should be awarded to financially disadvantaged, promising students who have not yet graduated from the faculty in which the scholarship is sought. Any excess returns shall be used for a travel grant for a junior academic instructor.
Av fondens avkastning skall minst en tio: At least one-tenth of the fund’s returns shall be added to the principal, and the remainder shall be distributed as scholarships to talented, diligent, and financially needy students at the University of Gothenburg. The conditions for receiving the scholarship are that, at the end of the application period, the applicant must have been a member of the Göta Student Union for at least one year and that, at that time, no more than five years—excluding any time spent performing military service—have elapsed since the applicant completed high school. Every four years, the Student Union’s Board of Directors may, if it deems it appropriate and the Inspector gives his approval, decide to use one year’s available interest income for some other purpose deemed important and desirable by the Göta Student Union.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga av: The purpose of the foundation is that the annual return be divided into four equal parts, one of which shall be allocated to each of the university’s four faculties: the Faculty of Theology, the Faculty of Law, the Faculty of Medicine, and the Faculty of Philosophy. Each faculty is authorized to distribute these funds in a specific manner as scholarships to virtuous, diligent, and promising male students.
Fondens medel skall användas till stipen: The fund’s resources shall be used to provide scholarships to string instrument students at the Academy of Music in Gothenburg who are fully dedicated to serious music, to enable them to pursue further higher education, for example abroad
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the returns on the fund shall, on an annual basis and at a time deemed appropriate, be distributed by the Faculty of Law to one or more candidates for a Bachelor of Laws degree who are pursuing studies at Lund University toward the award of a Licentiate of Laws degree or a Doctor of Laws degree.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The Foundation’s purpose is to allocate 10% of the annual return to the endowment. Of the remainder, 200 kronor is distributed to members of Smålands Nation as a bonus, and the rest is distributed as scholarships. The scholarships are to be used for research, study trips, thesis projects, term papers, or continuing education.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att återstående a: The purpose of the foundation is to allocate the remaining proceeds to students in the education sector in the fields of cultureand information professions, as well as students in the language, history, and social science teacher training programs, with the exception of the religious studies program, with priority given to students in the sector and programs affiliated with the Sydskånska Nationen.
Den årliga avkastningen skall utdelas ti: The annual proceeds shall be distributed as two equal scholarships to two students at the University of Gothenburg who have distinguished themselves through diligence and talent and are in need of such financial support.
Fondens medlen skall tilldelas två mindr: The funds of the endowment shall be awarded to two financially disadvantaged students at the University of Gothenburg who have demonstrated a marked interest and aptitude for the study of art and literary history and who have otherwise proven themselves worthy of such a scholarship
Räntan å fonden må af förvaltaren efter: The interest on the fund may be used by the trustee, after consultation with the Faculty Council, partly for scholarships for students at the University of Gothenburg and partly for grants to lecturers employed by the university.
Medlen skall utdelas såsom stipendium åt: The funds shall be awarded as a scholarship to a student at the University of Gothenburg who has attended classes there for at least two semesters and has distinguished himself or herself through talent, diligence, and exemplary conduct.
Göteborgs Högskola erhåller till fond fö: Gothenburg University will receive funds for seven scholarships of 10,000 kronor each, adjusted annually according to the CPI, with the remainder allocated to a 40,000-kronor bonus from the Teachers’ Council for its students.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att dela ut stipe: The foundation's purpose is to award scholarships to students in all programs at the College of Education and the College of Music.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The foundation's purpose is to award scholarships to students in all programs at the College of Education and the College of Music.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the proceeds among less well-off students at the Malmö Academy of Music, primarily to those who do not receive a salary or honorarium, with the funds distributed annually.
Till åtanke vid utdelning av stipendiern: When awarding the scholarships, after one-third of the proceeds has been added to the principal, all Swedish students who are enrolled at the Royal Carolinian University in Lund are eligible, regardless of which province of the kingdom they come from, all Swedish students who are enrolled at the Royal Carolinian University in Lund, provided they combine a natural aptitude for study with diligence and honorable conduct and are in need of such support.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the proceeds annually to one or two students from the Skånska Nation and one or two from the Småländska Nation, ensuring that scholarship amounts of equal value are always awarded to recipients from both nations.

The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual returns as scholarships to deserving students at the university whose studies are aimed at training for the journalism profession; the intent of the scholarship is to provide the recipients with the opportunity to gain practical experience in the domestic and international newspaper press.
Stiftelsens ändamål är stipendier för st: The foundation's purpose is to provide scholarships to students in all fields of study, with the exception of students majoring in religious studies.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the Foundation is for the Department of Food Technology and Food Engineering to distribute the proceeds every three years to students in these fields to support their continued studies in Sweden or abroad in food engineering—preferably in dairy product technology—or in subject areas where knowledge is essential to the development of such technology.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual interest as a scholarship to a student of the Blekingska Nation at Lund University who, in addition to being in need of financial support, distinguishes himself through diligence and good character, and has been enrolled in the nation since the semester preceding the one in which the scholarship is applied for.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is to use the annual interest to award scholarships of 500 kronor each year to students of the Smålands Nation at Lund University who, in addition to being in need of financial assistance and demonstrating diligence and good character, have been enrolled in the nation for at least six semesters.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan på kap: The purpose of the foundation is to allocate the interest on the capital to three equal scholarships, which are to be awarded to three students at Lund University who are of modest means and known for their good character and diligence—two from the Faculty of Theology and one from the Faculty of Law.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the proceeds shall be made available to the Faculty of Medicine at Lund University, which, upon the recommendation of professors of general pathological anatomy there, shall once a year award the interest in question as an incentive to a student who, during the year, has successfully devoted himself or herself to the study of the said subjects.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att sedan tio pro: The purpose of the Foundation is that, after 10 percent of the annual interest has been set aside to strengthen the fund, the remainder of the interest, together with any unallocated portion of the previous year’s interest, be distributed to young researchers affiliated with Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den behållna: The purpose of the foundation is to use the retained annual returns to fund a scholarship for students in the Faculty of Medicine at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att genom stipend: The purpose of the foundation is to support third- and fourth-year students in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering at Lund University through scholarships and grants. Support is primarily intended to cover the costs of study trips.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga av: The purpose of the foundation is to use the annual returns to provide scholarships to students in need at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är stipendier för st: The foundation's purpose is to provide scholarships to students in all fields of study, with the exception of the healthcare sector and the religious studies program.
Samfondens årliga avkastning skall, seda: The Fund’s annual return shall, after at least ten percent of it has been added to the principal, be used for the benefit of students in the teaching professions sector at the University of Falun/Borlänge. The fund’s return shall primarily be used for one of the following purposes, namely housing assistance for students deemed to be in particular need thereof; grants for study trips within or outside the country for which no public funding has been provided; grants for excursions and study visits not organized by the university but deemed important by a group of students; grants to student groups for the pursuit of certain non-profit or cultural activities; and other measures of such a nature that they may reasonably be expected to bring long-term enjoyment or happiness to the students. The proceeds may not be used for purposes that are to be funded by assessed fees. When distributing the proceeds, consideration should be given to the original terms of the donation to the extent deemed appropriate.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avse stipendi: The purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships at one of the universities in Uppsala or Lund, or at the Karolinska Institute; the use of terms referring primarily to male students, such as “young man,” “son,” or similar, shall not preclude the awarding of scholarships to female students as well.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan skall: The purpose of the foundation is to award the scholarship to a deserving student who is pursuing legal studies at the university with enthusiasm and aptitude, and who demonstrates diligence and good character.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual interest in the form of scholarships of at least 250 kronor to needy students of the Skånska Nationen at Lund University who have distinguished themselves through diligence and good conduct and who have been enrolled in the Skånska Nationen for at least one semester prior to the semester for which the scholarship is sought.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the proceeds annually to fund study trips for licentiate candidates and licentiates in the Humanities Division of the Faculty of Philosophy, with priority given to studies in the Germanic and Nordic language areas.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that one-fourth of the annual return shall be added to the principal. From the remaining return, two scholarships may be awarded annually to students of limited means who were born in Skåne.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the fund’s returns equally between a medical student and a theology student at Lund University who reside in the municipality of Hässleholm and have demonstrated good academic performance.
The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual returns as scholarships to female students at the university who are in need of and deserving of financial support.
Avkastningen skall årligen utdelas till: The proceeds shall be distributed annually to young people in the Aspeboda parish who intend to pursue studies at universities or colleges.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest be divided into six equal parts, which are to be awarded as scholarships to students at Lund University, with priority given first to the donor’s relatives and second to theology students from the Skåne or Blekinge Nations.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that one-tenth (1/10) of the annual interest shall be allocated to the principal. The remaining interest is distributed as scholarships to students at the faculties of theology or philosophy in Lund who a) were born to parents belonging to the Diocese of Gothenburg or belong to the same diocese themselves and are enrolled in the Gothenburg Nation b) declare their intention to enter the service of the aforementioned diocese after graduation or to be employed as a teacher at the University; c) are in need of financial support, diligent in their studies, and of irreproachable character; d) have devoted special attention to the original languages of the Holy Scriptures, whereby a good command of the Latin language may also be considered a recommendation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual interest equally among two financially disadvantaged students in the Faculty of Theology who devote themselves to the study of theology with particular diligence and interest.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ett stipendiu: The purpose of the Foundation is to award a scholarship, for a period of no more than three years, to a student enrolled at one of the Skåne student nations at Lund University who is successfully pursuing studies in literary history, maintains a reputation for integrity, and is in need of financial support.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual interest as scholarships to medical students, particularly those specializing in surgery.
Stiftelsen skall ha till ändamål att utd: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students pursuing business studies at the college and university levels in Gothenburg.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual interest as a scholarship to a student at the university who has distinguished himself or herself through diligence and good character, is in need of financial support, and has demonstrated an interest in and aptitude for the study of law.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is to award two scholarships from the annual returns: one for students in the Faculty of Theology and one for students in the Faculty of Medicine. However, it is hereby stipulated in advance that female students at the university shall never be eligible for either scholarship.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att sedan 1/4 av: The purpose of the Foundation is that, after one-fourth of the annual income has been added to the principal to maintain it, the interest on at least forty thousand kronor shall be distributed every four years as a reward to the author of the best doctoral dissertation in the Nordic languages, which has been published and defended at Lund University during the past four years by one of its students, who has received their essential academic training there. Should no such dissertation have been published during the four-year period, or should any published dissertation be deemed unworthy of the award, it may be awarded to the author of a dissertation published during the preceding period that is deserving of it and has not previously received this award. The remaining interest may be used for scholarships for needy and academically gifted students at the advanced level at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest be used to fund six equal scholarships, which are to be awarded to well-behaved and needy students at the university who are members of the Västgöta Nation, with priority given to relatives of the testator.
The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest, after appropriate deductions to build up the fund, shall be distributed as scholarships to deserving students in need at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the investment income as scholarships to students from the Diocese of Lund, with priority given to the donor’s relatives.
Fonden skall ha till ändamål att utdela: The purpose of the fund is to award annual personal scholarships to well-behaved students, preferably those from low-income families, who have distinguished themselves through talent, ambition, and good character, with preference given to those born in Örebro County who are enrolled in an educational institution within the county.
Att giva en utgående elev, som därav är: To provide a graduating student who is in need and has completed their course with particularly high marks in animal husbandry with the opportunity to further their expertise in this field, either through a study trip within the country or abroad, or through studies at a research institute.
Att tilldelas en eller flera veterinärst: To award one or more veterinary students scholarships, primarily to students who have completed the non-clinical portion of their training. Travel grants may be awarded.
Att utdela stipendier till ordinarie stu: To award scholarships to full-time students in the main program at the Royal Swedish University of Forest Sciences.
Stipendier åt förtjänta elever: Inom föl: Scholarships for deserving students: In the following categories: undergraduate students, agronomy and horticulture students, and landscape architecture students.
Afkastningen skall utgå såsom stipendium: The proceeds shall be awarded as a scholarship to a person who, as a student, has completed the final year of study at the Royal Institute of Technology and who wishes to conduct, primarily at the Royal Institute of Technology, independent research and studies aimed at advancing the Swedish mining industry. However, faculty members at the Royal Institute of Technology may not be appointed as scholarship recipients.
Avkastningen skall användas för bidrag t: The proceeds shall be used to provide grants to students in departments K, B, or L, "as an incentive for outstanding mathematical studies."
Disponibel avkastning skall utgå som sti: The available proceeds shall be awarded as a scholarship to one or more students at the university who have received a grade in the advanced course in the subject of water motors and pumps.
Forskningsstipendium kan tilldelas civil: Research grants may be awarded to civil engineers from KTH’s chemistry program. In the first instance, grants shall be awarded for research work in the field of explosives technology or related areas of chemical engineering that are of significance to the explosives industry. In the second instance, grants may be awarded for research in related areas of chemical engineering. Thirdly, grants may be awarded for research in related fields at the university. Student grants may be awarded to students in KTH’s chemistry program who, in their thesis, address a topic within the subject areas listed above.
Till elev i driftsledarkursen eller lant: To a student in the farm management course or agricultural school who is enrolled in a program of at least one year’s duration and who has demonstrated good character, outstanding academic ability, a frugal lifestyle, and good progress in acquiring knowledge and practical skills, and who is in need of financial assistance.
Att lämna understöd åt behövande studera: To provide financial aid to students in need at the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences.
Till ett eller flera stipendier till där: One or more scholarships to be awarded by the university to deserving graduating students upon completion of their degree; however, no student should receive a scholarship more than once.
Att vid avgångsexamen utdela ett resesti: To award, upon graduation, a travel grant to a graduating student of the Department of Agriculture at the Alnarp Institute who, through diligence, good conduct, and knowledge, has earned such encouragement and has also demonstrated the maturity that he is deemed capable of fully benefiting from a longer study trip for the sake of his own development and the modern agriculture of his homeland.
Till resestipendium inom de nordiska län: For a travel grant within the Nordic countries for forestry students interested in forest classification and forest management. Preference will be given to applicants born in Västergötland.
Den årliga avkastningen får, sedan minst: After at least one-tenth has been added to the capital, the annual return may, upon a decision by the Office of the President in consultation with the management team, be used to award scholarships to deserving students at the University of the Arts.
Stipendium på 1000 kronor tilldelas stud: A scholarship of 1,000 kronor is awarded to students who have been enrolled at the University of Agricultural Sciences for at least one year, are still studying there, and are known for their diligence, skill, and good moral character. Those born in Uppland have priority for the scholarship.
Att åt framtida skogsmän lämna ekonomisk: To provide financial support to future foresters during their years of study at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att lämna un: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide grants for the preparation of instruction or training for students at the Royal College of Music.
Stipendier till i Dalsland eller Bleking: Scholarships are available to students who were born and raised in Dalsland or Blekinge and are currently enrolled at Ultuna University of Agricultural Sciences; one grant is available.
Till stipendium åt en från skogshögskola: For a scholarship to be awarded to a graduate of the Forestry College who wishes to acquire knowledge of languages or business administration, priority shall be given to the student deemed to have the greatest potential to benefit from such knowledge, regardless of his personal financial circumstances.
Stipendier som bidrag till täckande av k: Scholarships to help cover the costs of individual study trips abroad related to forestry.
Stipendium till skötsam veterinärstudera: A scholarship for a diligent veterinary student with good grades at the veterinary college, with preference given to those who have demonstrated a particular interest in and knowledge of equine care and treatment.
Stipendium till skötsam studerande, som: Scholarship for a diligent student who is enrolled in one of the 2nd through 4th years and has demonstrated exceptional academic ability and earned good grades during their studies at the university.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the proceeds be used for the beautification of Brunnby Church and for the upbringing and education of young music students from the Brunnby parish. It is my wish that approximately four-fifths of the grants awarded by the fund be used for the beautification of the church, and that approximately one-fifth be used for the fund’s other purposes. The fund’s administrator shall not, without exceptional reasons, distribute more than the fund’s accrued return for the year, together with any amounts set aside from previous years’ returns.
Från den årliga avkastningen skall avdra: The necessary administrative expenses shall be deducted from the annual return, after which the remaining return shall be distributed annually as scholarships to young women who are pursuing studies or other education in a location other than their hometown. If, in any given year, there are no suitable applicants to receive scholarships corresponding to the entire net return, the excess amount shall be added to the capital. Should it, on the other hand, be deemed desirable in any given year to award scholarships in amounts exceeding the net return for the year, the fund’s capital may also be utilized to a certain extent, provided that the net return together with the reduction in capital for the year does not exceed a total of 10,000 kronor.
Att årligen lämna studiehjälp till någon: To award annual scholarships to one or more academically gifted young women in Kalmar County, with priority given to young women in Gullabo Parish, Kalmar County. The scholarships are to be used for studies intended to lead to a degree in a specific profession, whether theoretical or practical.
Den årliga avkastningen får, av skolans: The school board may, upon the recommendation of the faculty, award the annual return as a scholarship to one or more deserving students.
Disponibel avkastning skall användas för: The available proceeds shall be used to award scholarships to students at the University of Technology.
Den årliga räntan skall utdelas till en: The annual interest shall be awarded to one or more financially disadvantaged students at the Royal Institute of Technology who, in the judgment of the Board, have earned it through good grades, diligence, and good conduct.
Avkastningen skall användas till studies: The proceeds shall be used to fund scholarships for students at the Technical University; and these scholarships shall be awarded each semester to male students, and, should female students subsequently gain admission there, also to female students who, through diligence and talent, have earned them.
Årsavkastningen skall efter ansökan utde: The annual proceeds shall, following an application, be distributed in the form of one or more scholarships to students of Swedish citizenship who have graduated from the Royal Institute of Technology, for the purpose of carrying out specific scientific work, as specified in the application, that is of significance to engineering science or industry, with preference given to work in the field of chemistry.
För stipendier, att kallas Axel Sahlins: For scholarships, to be known as the Axel Sahlins Scholarship, the interest from which shall be used to fund one or up to three annual scholarships, to be awarded to students in their third or fourth year of the Materials Design program at the University. A scholarship may be awarded to the same student no more than twice.
Avkastningen av fonden må disponeras för: The fund's returns may be used to award scholarships to students at the Department of Architecture at the Royal Institute of Technology.
Avkastningen skall såsom stipendium tlll: The proceeds shall be awarded as a scholarship to one or more students at the University of Technology.
Ränteavkastningen skall användas till st: The interest income shall be used to provide financial aid to low-income students from Värmland and the following locations in Skaraborg County: Skara, Falköping, Stenum Parish, Bjerka Parish, and Bjurum Parish.
Ändamålet är att lämna bidrag till stude: The purpose is to provide grants to students in the Department of Electrical Engineering to enable them to undertake internships abroad—primarily in England, Germany, and France—during the summer break.
Bereda stipendier åt studerande vid K. T: To provide scholarships for students at the Royal Institute of Technology. The scholarships are awarded to students at the Institute who have demonstrated diligence and success in their studies and who are of modest means. Selection is made from among students who have advanced to the third year, and students who have once been selected may retain the scholarship for three years, thus even after graduation, provided that they continue to be deserving of assistance and encouragement. From the interest income, one scholarship of 1,500 kr. and one of 1,000 kr. are awarded annually. The scholarship amounts are adjusted annually according to the consumer price index. The remainder is reserved to ensure that, in the event of falling interest rates, the scholarships can be maintained at the aforementioned amounts, and in the event of a decline in the value of money, an increase in the same, particularly the smaller scholarship. Any scholarship that has not been awarded or has been withdrawn may be reserved for future years. Of the fund’s returns, at least one-tenth of the annual return may be added to the principal.
Sedan årligen minst 20% av avkastningen: Once at least 20% of the annual return has been added to the principal, the remaining available funds shall be used to provide scholarships to graduate students in zoological cell biology. In the event of equal qualifications, applicants of Polish origin shall be given preference.
Att såsom stipendium, hvarje halfår till: A scholarship is to be awarded every six months to three young students at the University who lack the means to support themselves and who demonstrate diligence in their studies and exemplary conduct. No individual may hold the scholarship for more than one year.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja utbild: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote education for women by awarding one or more scholarships annually to female employees of Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken for studies in economics and/or languages, either in Sweden or abroad.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att ekonomis: The foundation's purpose is to provide financial support to meet the needs of Linköping students for facilities to carry out their student union activities, and it was established by the Linköping United Student Unions (LIFS).
Disponibel avkastning skall hållas till: Any surplus funds shall be made available to the Geological Department’s faculty council for use in providing travel grants to students and for library purposes.
Till studerande vid Upplands nation, som: To students at Upplands Nation who, based on their academic ability, length of study, and financial need, are deemed most deserving. Scholarship recipients must have been born in Uppsala County, Fjärdhundra, or the portion of Stockholm County located within the province of Uppland. This scholarship may not be combined with any other scholarship.
Stiftelsens kapital skall den 21 septemb: On September 21 of each year, starting from the year the funds were donated, the Foundation’s capital shall be awarded as a grant to one or more engineering graduates of the University.
Till medellös, flitig studerande av Värm: To a financially disadvantaged, diligent student of the Värmland Nation, with preference given to theology students whose parents have either resided or currently reside in the city of Karlstad. Should no student from Karlstad be deemed deserving of the scholarship, it may be awarded for "one or another" semester to another well-known student from Värmland.
Till flitig studerande av Kalmar nation: To diligent students of the Kalmar Nation, primarily from the city of Kalmar and secondarily from other parts of Kalmar County. Scholarship recipients are appointed by the Nation’s inspector, the chief curator, and a member appointed by the Nation’s members for one-year terms; the scholarship may be held for a maximum of six years in total.
Avkastningen må utgå såsom ett eller hög: The returns may be distributed as one or up to five scholarships to financially disadvantaged full-time students in their fourth year of the Materials Design program. If, in any given year, all or part of the fund’s returns are deemed not to be distributed, that amount shall either be added to the principal or set aside for distribution in the following year.
Ett stipendium till manlig filosofi stud: One scholarship for a male philosophy student and one scholarship, alternatively, for a male student of theology, law, or medicine from the Östgöta Nation. For the scholarship for theology, law, and medicine students, certain preferences apply: to theology students who supplement their theological education with studies in the humanities; to law students who supplement their education with studies in philosophy, history, or political science; and to medicine students with knowledge of French, German, and Latin.
Att utdela stipendier som reseunderstöd: To award scholarships in the form of travel grants to young men graduating from the university who intend to pursue a career in industry.
Till förmån för elevers understöd eller: For the purpose of student financial aid or the purchase of educational materials. In its decision dated March 9, 2010, ref. no. 430-13188-09, the Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency has decided that the regulations may be amended so that students in the material design program are included in the eligible recipient group.
Förfallande räntor skola årligen utdelas: Interest accrued shall be distributed annually to students in the fourth year of the Department of Civil Engineering who are majoring in bridge construction or structural engineering in accordance with the 1927 curriculum, or as a travel grant for studies in the aforementioned fields to students who have graduated from the said department within a couple of years of completing their degree. The scholarship may, at the discretion of the Board, be set at five hundred to six hundred kronor per year to cover the cost of or reward studies in the fourth department of the school, and one thousand to twelve hundred kronor for a study trip after graduation. The scholarship amounts are adjusted annually according to the consumer price index. In selecting scholarship recipients, consideration shall be given to the applicant’s aptitude and diligence, as well as, where applicable, their financial circumstances. If any portion of the interest for a given year is not distributed, it may be paid out as a scholarship in the following year. Of the fund’s annual return, at least one-tenth may be added to the principal.
\"hvaraf ränteavkastningen bör såsom sti: "The interest income from this fund, which should be distributed annually by the University's Faculty as scholarships ranging from a maximum of 600 kronor to a minimum of 400 kronor—adjusted for inflation using the consumer price index—shall be awarded to students of comparatively modest means."
Stiftelsens huvudsakliga ändamål är att: The Foundation’s primary purpose is to provide grants to recipients in the Gothenburg area—without restriction to any particular family, specific families, or designated individuals—for the preparation of educational programs or post-secondary education.
Ändamålet med stiftelsen är att årligen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the fund’s annual interest to students at the university, giving priority to the donor’s relatives.
Tre fjärdedelar av fondens avkastning ut: Three-quarters of the fund’s returns are distributed annually, as decided by the Departmental Council for Civil Engineering, to graduating students in the Department of Civil Engineering who have distinguished themselves through academic achievement and practical aptitude, and who have demonstrated diligence and honorable conduct. Completing, within the standard timeframe, a meritorious thesis related to research conducted in the hydraulic engineering laboratory shall be considered a significant merit for receiving the scholarship. The remainder of the fund’s returns is invested. The scholarship may, if deemed appropriate, be divided among two or more students.
Den årliga behållna afkastningen af fond: The annual retained earnings of the fund shall be used to provide financial support to one or more students who have graduated or are about to graduate from the university, who have distinguished themselves through good character, integrity, diligence, and knowledge, and who have expressed a desire to broaden their horizons through study abroad or practical work in a foreign country.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att avkastni: The purpose of the Foundation is to use the investment income to award one or more scholarships at the end of the academic year. At least one of the scholarships must be awarded to a student who is about to complete their studies at Katedralskolan and must be intended for a trip. If more than one scholarship is awarded, the one(s) intended for travel shall be the largest scholarship(es). The recipient(s) of the scholarship must have demonstrated aptitude and interest in their studies and be in need of financial support. They do not need to be the top students in their class in terms of grades.
Att dela ut stipendier till någon förtjä: To award scholarships to one deserving student in each of the university’s nine departments. Only students who are in genuine need of financial aid are eligible. Newly raised funds shall be distributed equally among the various funds unless the donor specifies otherwise.
Minst en tiondel av den årliga avkastnin: At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal. Under no circumstances may the available return be used for purposes that are to be funded by levied contributions. The available return shall be used for scholarships for college students who have previously attended upper secondary school in Karlskrona.

At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the capital. Under no circumstances may the available return be used for purposes that are to be funded by levied funds. The available return shall be used for scholarships for college students who have previously attended upper secondary school in Karlskrona. Amended July 8, 2016. Return provision removed.
Till behövande och flitiga studerande av: To needy and diligent students of the Norrland Nation "who are not already receiving such support," with priority given to relatives studying at Uppsala or Lund University, regardless of which nation they belong to.
Avkastningen skall årligen såsom stipend: The proceeds shall be awarded annually as scholarships to one or more deserving students at the University.
Disponibel avkastning skall tilldelas tr: The available funds shall be awarded to three, or at most four, of the school’s students who have distinguished themselves through diligence and technical aptitude, have demonstrated exemplary conduct in all respects, and are in such financial circumstances that they, more than other students, are in need of financial support to pursue their studies.
Disponibel avkastning bör enligt Högskol: In accordance with a decision by the College Board, the available funds shall be distributed annually in the form of no more than five (5) scholarships to students at the College who have distinguished themselves through diligence and good conduct and are in need of financial support. In the event of otherwise equal qualifications, preference for receiving a scholarship shall be given to students whose father is employed as a worker or clerk by Separator AB or has held such employment for at least ten (10) years.
Återstoden af afkastningen skall af styr: The remainder of the proceeds shall be distributed annually by the Board in the form of travel grants to one or more young engineers who have graduated from the Royal Institute of Technology, primarily from the civil engineering program, secondarily from the civil engineering program with a specialization in building construction or civil engineering design, and thirdly from the civil engineering program (other specializations), [---]
Stiftelsens ändamål är att genom stipend: The foundation's purpose is to support the study of Icelandic language, literature, and culture through scholarships.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ge bidrag til: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide grants to staff members of the Linköping Diocesan Board’s office for study trips or meetings relevant to their work. Any portion of the net return for a given year that is not used for this purpose may be set aside for use in future years.
Av stiftelsens behållna avkastning får 9: Of the foundation’s retained earnings, 90% may be distributed each year, primarily to members of the student union who have distinguished themselves within the union as good comrades, and secondarily as scholarships to members of the student union to assist with their studies. 10% of the earnings shall be added to the capital.
Stiftelsens huvudsakliga ändamål skall v: The primary purpose of the Foundation shall be to promote academic education by awarding scholarships for studies in human resources management at a foreign university or other foreign institution of higher education. Scholarship recipients must be either Swedish citizens or foreign nationals who have resided in Sweden for at least two years and are still residing there.
Den disponibla avkastningen skall såsom: The available proceeds shall be distributed annually as one or more scholarships to the nursing staff at Nockeby Vårdhem, Backskåran 9 in Bromma, and/or at the Society’s retirement home Nockebyhus, Nockeby Backe 8 in Bromma, to support the staff’s continuing education through participation in courses, study trips, or similar activities.
Till studerande av Göteborgs nation. Utd: To students of the Gothenburg Nation. Awarded annually during the fall semester by the Nation’s Inspector upon the recommendation of the Nation’s Senior Council.
Till i första hand hela studietiden vid: This scholarship is primarily intended for male descendants of War Councilor I. D. Thim or Court Secretary J. F. Cederblad who are enrolled at Uppsala University for the duration of their studies. If no applicant claims such kinship, the scholarship is awarded for one year to a student who, after completing a university degree or its equivalent, is engaged in independent scholarly work. The recipient is appointed by the Vice-Chancellor.
Ett eller två stipendier i ämnet farmako: One or two scholarships in the field of pharmacognosy will be awarded to students in the pharmacy program who have demonstrated exceptional knowledge of and a strong interest in the subject, and who have also conducted a publishable study in the field during the calendar year in question.
Avkastningen skall gå, såsom bidrag, til: The proceeds shall be allocated, in the form of a grant, to the educational activities conducted by the Foundation for Course Activities at Stockholm University.
Av fondens avkastning skall årligen en f: One-fourth of the fund’s annual return shall be added to the principal. The remainder of the return shall be allocated, subject to accountability, by the director of the Department of Hydraulic Engineering: partly for those aspects of the Hydraulic Engineering Laboratory’s operations for which municipal funds or other university funds are insufficient or cannot be allocated; partly for the laboratory’s expansion and development; and - subject to approval by the Departmental Council for Civil Engineering - as travel grants to the director or his laboratory assistants for study trips to foreign hydraulic engineering laboratories or for travel to conferences and meetings held for the advancement of hydraulic engineering research.
Återstående del av avkastningen skall an: The remaining portion of the proceeds shall be used to fund scholarships for one or more graduating students from Himmelstalund School in Norrköping who have demonstrated excellent conduct and shown exceptional diligence both in their studies and in their practical work, and who have also demonstrated outstanding knowledge of the horticultural profession.
Avkastningen skall användas till stipend: The proceeds shall be used to fund scholarships either for theoretical or practical studies in horticulture abroad, or for the completion of a full course of study at the Alnarp Institute or another state-run Swedish institution of higher education in horticulture.
Avkastningen skall som regel vart tredje: As a general rule, the proceeds shall be used every three years to award a travel grant for the study of agricultural buildings, either in Sweden or abroad. The grant shall primarily be awarded to architects or engineers with a special interest in the design of such buildings, taking into account both the use of newer building materials and the aesthetic impact of the farm’s appearance, as well as the integration of farm buildings into the landscape. The scholarship may also be awarded to students at technical universities for travel related to the completion of a thesis in the aforementioned subject area.
Disponibel avkastning skall utdelas som: Any available funds shall be awarded as scholarships to one or, in exceptional cases, several applicants for studies in Sweden or abroad on topics deemed to be of significance for developments in the field of mechanization.
Avkastningen skall användas \"till stipe: The proceeds shall be used "for scholarships for students at the University of Agricultural Sciences pursuing degrees in agronomy or horticulture."
Diponibel avkastning skall varje år utde: The available proceeds shall be distributed annually as a grant to a deserving electrical engineer who has graduated from the Royal Institute of Technology, who either intends to pursue further studies at the university in an applied electrical engineering subject to earn a Licentiate of Technology degree, or intends to work on a doctoral dissertation in electrical engineering, or wishes to engage in specialized studies in electrical engineering at a foreign university or research institute. In exceptional cases, a scholarship may be awarded in whole or in part to a particularly gifted student in the Department of Electrical Engineering who, following a highly significant electrical engineering thesis, has substantially exceeded the normally intended time frame.
Sedan minst 1/5 av fondens avkastning la: Once at least one-fifth of the fund’s returns have been added to the principal, the remaining returns shall be distributed as scholarships. Scholarships shall be awarded in an amount of at least four hundred kronor per year. If the fund’s returns permit, multiple scholarships may be awarded each year, provided, however, that the amount of each scholarship is not set lower than an amount that, taking into account changes in the value of money, can be considered equivalent to four hundred kronor at the present time. Scholarships from the fund shall facilitate the recipient’s education at a university, technical, military, or other educational institution in Sweden or abroad, for admission to which a secondary school diploma or high school diploma or an entrance examination equivalent to either of these is required, as well as at the Naval Academy, the Academy of Fine Arts, the Academy of Music, or another Swedish or foreign educational institution comparable to any of these.
Till studerande av Upplands nation; ett: To students of the Upplands Nation: one scholarship for a theology student and one for a chemistry or economics student. Preference will be given to relatives.
Fondens hela avkastning skall årligen ut: The fund’s entire annual return shall be distributed in the form of two scholarships of differing amounts to female students at the institute who, on the basis of their diligence and conduct, are deemed deserving thereof and who have completed a “Bachelor of Medicine degree or equivalent” but not a “Medical Doctor degree or equivalent.”However, if special circumstances warrant it, the faculty may award one of the scholarships to a female student who has completed such a substantial portion of the coursework required for a Bachelor of Medicine degree or equivalent that it can be assumed she has approximately one year remaining before graduation.
Den årliga avkastningen, sedan minst en: The annual return, after at least one-tenth has been added to the principal, may be used for the benefit of visually impaired adults, for example, for recreational activities, outings and study trips, entertainment and social activities, contributions toward courses, awards and scholarships, and the purchase of equipment and other items.
Stiftelsen skall tillgodose sitt ändamål: The Foundation shall fulfill its purpose by awarding a scholarship once a year to one or more students who have made significant contributions to the university or its student unions.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that at least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the capital. The proceeds shall be used for: scholarships for one or more students who have demonstrated good academic performance in business and economics subjects, good camaraderie, and commendable diligence. The scholarship shall be intended “as assistance in continuing theoretical or practical business education, e.g., through studies at a business school or through employment at a domestic or foreign office.”
Dela ut stipendium till elev som med fra: Award a scholarship to a student who is successfully pursuing theological studies, preferably at institutions of higher education that offer courses within the Diocese of Stockholm.
Att utdela stipendium till studerande so: To award scholarships to students who have demonstrated exemplary conduct, diligence, and academic achievement.
Att utdela stipendium till studerande in: To award scholarships to students in the forestry or forest science programs who have demonstrated diligence, interest, and aptitude for their profession.
Att utdela resestipendium till studerand: To award travel grants to students in the forestry or forest science programs.
Till förmån för elever vid institutionen: For the benefit of students at the Department of Home Economics, e.g., for recreational activities, field trips and study tours, entertainment and social activities, contributions toward courses, awards and scholarships, and the purchase of materials or other items for the department.
Att lämna bidrag till bergmästaren och ö: To provide grants to the mining inspector and other staff at the Mining Authority, primarily for professional development through courses and study trips, as well as for initiatives to promote a positive work environment.
Avkastningen av fonden skall inom ämnet: The proceeds from the fund shall be used every other year to purchase academic literature for higher education in the field of geography, and every other year to provide travel grants. The books purchased shall be added to the Erling Andersson Donation Library. Half of the proceeds are distributed annually on April 23; the remainder is added to the fund.
Avkastningen av fondens medel skall gå t: The returns on the fund’s assets shall be used to provide scholarships to students at HDK-Valand and the Academy of Music and Drama. The foundation’s board shall consist of the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Gothenburg or a person appointed by the Vice-Chancellor, the two deans of the aforementioned institutions, and one or two additional members.
Avkastningen av stiftelsens medel skall: The returns on the foundation’s assets shall be distributed annually to at least two students at the Östergötland School of Health and Social Care, Health and Medical Care Department in Linköping.
Till manlig studerande med företräde för: For male students, with preference given to those studying botany or zoology. The scholarship is awarded by the president upon the recommendation of the Biology Section’s scholarship committee and may be held for three years.
Till medellös studerande av Upplands nat: For financially disadvantaged students of the Upplands Nation, with priority given regardless of the nation to which a relative belongs. The scholarship is awarded by the rector upon the recommendation of the nation’s scholarship committee. It may be held for five years.
Till i första hand släkting till donator: Primarily to a relative of the donor. If no relative is found, the scholarship will be awarded to a student of the Västmanland-Dala Nation by the president.
Stipendium till elev vid förskollärarpro: Scholarship awarded to a student in the Preschool Teacher Education Program, Department of Teacher Education, "who has demonstrated idealism, compassion, a sense of reality, and pedagogical skill."
Till prägling av \"Robert Báránys jubile: For the minting of the "Robert Bárány Anniversary Medal," which is awarded every five years by the Faculty of Medicine at Uppsala University.
Till obemedlad och välartad finsk studer: For a financially disadvantaged and well-behaved Finnish student at Uppsala University, with preference given to applicants studying to become priests. If no such applicant applies, the scholarship may be awarded to an eligible Swedish student.
Förmögenheten är tillgänglig för utdelni: The assets are available for distribution. Both the income and the principal shall, following a decision by the Rödakorshemmet Foundation, be used to fund scholarships and study trips for nurses trained at the Red Cross Nursing School, which became the Red Cross College in 1998.
Av den årliga avkastningen av fonden ska: At least one-tenth of the fund’s annual return shall be added to the principal. The portion of the fund’s return available for distribution shall be used to benefit students in the horticulture program at Nordviksskolan for study trips, field trips, and guest lectures that otherwise could not have taken place. The return may not be used for purposes that are covered by government grants, that the school board is normally responsible for, or that are otherwise to be covered by public funds.
Avkastningen ska användas till att dela: The proceeds shall be used to award scholarships. Scholarship recipients must be journalists working in the daily press, radio, or television who wish to study a subject or conduct research that will broaden their professional knowledge. Preference is given to studies abroad focusing on future developments in the mass media.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga av: The purpose of the foundation is for Lund University to award the annual return on the fund as a scholarship to one or more students at Lund University who have demonstrated merit for continued studies, are diligent, and are in a situation where they require financial assistance.
Av den årliga avkastningen skall - enlig: In accordance with the donor’s instructions, as much of the annual return as possible shall be used each year to award one or more scholarships to a member (or members) of the Publicist Club who, through study trips abroad, wish to further their professional education or undertake research important to their profession.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att två stipendie: The purpose of the foundation is to award two scholarships to students at Lund University who are members of Lunds Nation and have been enrolled in the nation for at least one semester.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to award the proceeds every five years as a travel grant to theology students who wish to pursue studies at a Protestant university in Luther’s homeland. The grant is paid at the start of the trip, which should cover at least one semester of study at the German university. To be eligible to apply for this scholarship, the applicant must have consistently demonstrated good conduct, have earned a bachelor’s degree in theology with good grades, and be continuing their studies toward a higher theological degree.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att premie skall: The purpose of the foundation is to award grants to students at Lund University as a reward for demonstrating a high level of proficiency in basic mathematics courses.
Stiftelsens ändamål är stipendium för st: The purpose of the foundation is to provide scholarships to students at Lund University who are members of Malmö Nation and have been enrolled in the nation for at least one semester.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att disponibel av: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the available returns as scholarships to deserving students at Lund University, with preference given to applicants who are members of the Hammarskiöld family.
Stiftelsens ändamål är till studerande v: The foundation’s purpose is to support students in the law program. The funds may be set aside so that the accumulated amount can be awarded as a travel grant to universities in Copenhagen or Oslo for further studies in law.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the proceeds to relatives who are students at Lund University. Secondarily, the funds are to be distributed to students in the medical program, with priority given to students affiliated with the Helsingborg-Landskrona Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är till stipendier,: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships—one in the amount of three hundred kronor and the other in the amount of two hundred kronor—to deserving students of modest means at Kalmar Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är fyra stipendier t: The purpose of the foundation is to award four scholarships to students at Lund University who are members of Västgöta Nation and have been enrolled for at least two semesters.
Av avkastningen tilldelas medlem i Publi: A portion of the proceeds is used to award scholarships to members of the Publicists' Club for studies aimed at expanding their professional skills.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att detta resesti: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide this travel grant, which is available to students in all faculties, to support students at Lund University in pursuing studies at one of Paris’s higher education institutions.
Ur fonden skall utgå två eller flera hem: The fund shall provide two or more residential scholarships, as well as one or more travel scholarships. Residential scholarships are awarded for two years to students who were born in Stockholm or Småland and who have been enrolled at Uppsala University for at least two years. Recipients of travel scholarships may be granted an extension of the scholarship period for a maximum of one year. Travel grants are awarded annually for a stay at a foreign university for at least one semester. Recipients of travel grants may be granted an extension of the grant period for a maximum of one year.
