Travel grants are awarded to students who have been enrolled at Uppsala University for at least five years and who were born in Stockholm or Småland. Should no eligible applicant apply for a travel grant that has been declared vacant, the grant may, after it has been re-advertised as vacant, be awarded to a deserving student at the university regardless of his place of birth; however, in such a case, if there are several equally qualified applicants, the one born in Stockholm or in Småland shall be given preference.
Bidraget kommer att användas för att fin: The grant will be used to fund study visits to Japan for young Swedish college students, with priority given to those who have the opportunity to complete their thesis projects at Japanese companies. Eligible fields of study include engineering, economics, and the natural sciences.
Disponibel avkastning skall användas för: Available funds shall be used to cover expenses that the principal is not normally responsible for, such as: - costs associated with events organized by the clinic to provide information about its activities, including those for which speakers have been invited; - contributions toward the costs of translating and printing essays, dissertations, and similar works; - study trips - contributions toward the purchase of materials and equipment for special purposes.
Fondens ändamål skall vara att genom årl: The purpose of the fund is to promote the publication of works on ancient history in internationally distributed series by awarding annual grants to one or more recipients; these works must be authored by faculty members and/or former students of the Department of Ancient Culture and Society at Stockholm University, or by individuals affiliated with the department.
Bidrag kunna lämnas vid rådhusrätten ans: Grants may be awarded to legal officers employed by the municipal court for participation in Nordic legal conferences, municipal judges’ meetings, or similar events, or for study trips.
Sedan minst tio procent av fondens avkas: Once at least ten percent of the fund’s returns have been added to the principal, the remaining returns shall be used to provide scholarships to students who have demonstrated a particular interest and aptitude for the study of chemistry, physics, or biology, regardless of their proficiency in other subjects. The amount of the scholarship shall be determined each year by the school’s principal, provided that the scholarship shall not be awarded in an amount less than SEK 500. Any remaining portion of the fund’s return shall be allocated to the promotion of education within the aforementioned subject groups, particularly through the completion—to the extent that funds for this purpose cannot be otherwise secured—of the experimental equipment of the institutions in question.
Att ekonomiskt stödja anställda vid Munk: To provide financial support to employees of Munkedal AB by covering costs associated with training in areas of significance to the company. Should Munkedal AB cease to exist or be merged into another company, other companies within the Tre Bruk Group shall take Munkedal AB’s place. In the event that the group no longer exists, the funds shall be used for scholarships for students at the Trollhättan University of Technology who are studying subjects related to the paper industry.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att genom stipend: The purpose of the foundation is to provide scholarships to students at Umeå University to help them study Icelandic language and culture.
Att möjliggöra studieresor till U.S.A. f: To facilitate study trips to the United States for civil engineers trained at the University in the field of telecommunications.
Räntan skall årligen av Vitterhetsakadem: The scholarship shall be awarded annually by the Academy of Letters to a female student or junior staff member working within the Academy’s field of activity. The scholarship should not be awarded to the same person for more than five consecutive years.

The interest shall be awarded annually by the Academy of Letters to a male student or junior official working within the Academy’s field of activity. The scholarship should not be awarded to the same person for more than five consecutive years.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att lämna: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide financial assistance to young people so that they may further their education in music and academic science subjects. Eligible to receive financial aid are young people who have family ties to Orsa and who, given their own and their family’s financial situation, are deemed to be in need of financial support to complete their education.
Stiftelsens avkastning skall användas ti: The foundation’s returns shall be used to fund an annual scholarship for medical students. The scholarship shall be at least 500 SEK. Medical students at Karolinska Institutet are eligible to receive the scholarship.
Sedan årliga räntan en femtedel (1/5) av: Since one-fifth (1/5) of the annual interest is set aside to strengthen the fund, the remaining four-fifths (4/5) shall be allocated to travel grants for study abroad of at least 3,000 kronor each; however, if deemed desirable, a maximum of two study grants of 1,500 kronor each may be awarded. Recipients of travel grants must have completed their studies at the University. However, the recipient must, in addition to strong theoretical aptitude, above all demonstrate genuine practical competence. With regard to travel grants, it is my wish that these be set at a level sufficient to enable the grantee to support themselves without paid employment. For stays in non-European countries, and particularly in those where the cost of living is high or travel is especially expensive, the grant should be awarded in a higher amount. Travel scholarship recipients should spend at least 12 months abroad. Study scholarships should be used to enable talented individuals already active in the workforce to attend the School of Economics while resigning from their current positions.
Stipendium åt från Kungl. Tekniska Högsk: A scholarship for a graduate of the Royal Institute of Technology who intends to pursue studies at the institute to earn a Doctor of Technology degree, to be used both to support these studies and to cover the costs of printing the doctoral dissertation. Furthermore, the fund may award travel grants for study or recreation to staff employed at the university’s administration office, accounting office, or library.
[...) Stipendier åt studerande vid progr: [...) Scholarships for students in the Materials Design program.
Den årliga afkastningen skall utdelas i: The annual proceeds shall be distributed in the form of two equal scholarships to two students at the university who have distinguished themselves through diligence and talent and are in need of such financial support, with preference given to students from Gothenburg.
Skall utgå såsom stipendium till en fört: This scholarship is to be awarded to a deserving student of Swedish nationality enrolled in the third or fourth year of the Department of Mining Science at the Royal Institute of Technology who is in need of financial support to pursue their studies. In a decision dated March 9, 2010, the Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency approved the following amendments to the foundation’s regulations: The words “Department of Mining Science” are changed to “Program in Materials Design,” the words “a deserving student” are changed to “one or at most two deserving students,” and the words “in their third or fourth year” are changed to “in their third year or higher.”
årligen utdelas såsom stipendium till el: is awarded annually as a scholarship to a student or students at the University who have distinguished themselves through diligence and good conduct and who are in need of financial assistance.
Stipendier åt studerande af elektrotekni: Scholarships for students of electrical engineering; and the company stipulates, as a condition for the awarding of the scholarship, that the aforementioned funds may be received by the recipient, as a scholarship, not only during the period of study at the university but also thereafter, for as long as may be deemed necessary to gain experience through travel or other means.
[...] skall efter min död årligen utdela: [...] shall, after my death, be awarded annually as a scholarship to a hardworking and well-behaved young student at the University who is enrolled in the Materials Design program.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att genom avkastn: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide financial support, in the form of scholarships, to deserving and needy students at Lund University who are members of Västgöta Nation and have been enrolled in the nation for at least two semesters.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the proceeds shall be used to fund five special scholarships for students at Uppsala University and five special scholarships for students at Norrköping Higher Elementary School (now de Geersgymnasiet), that the estimated value of 25 barrels of rye and 25 barrels of barley annually be transferred to the Norrköping Municipal Council to be used for the Norrköping Municipality’s joint fund for teacher training, that ten barrels of grain be paid out [for necessary school supplies and prize books for the children at Östra Eneby Parish Elementary School and for the communion children of the same parish, as well as for the occasional useful book for the parish library there]. The remainder of the proceeds shall be used to provide and promote, for well-behaved and needy youth belonging to the municipality of Norrköping, the vocational training and personal development that corresponds to their gifts and aptitudes and which is not the responsibility of the legal child and youth welfare agencies to fund. Vocational training should generally be provided by utilizing existing public and private institutions or through agreements with professionals. However, special training courses may be organized as needed if the foundation’s assets permit. The Foundation shall exercise oversight to ensure that the young people whose education is funded by the Foundation, hereinafter referred to as the scholarship recipients, utilize the scholarships and grants received in accordance with the Foundation’s purpose, to promote their upbringing in a Christian spirit toward good character. To the extent that the Foundation’s assets permit, the Foundation may, when deemed appropriate, provide financial support to youth associations or clubs with the aim of meeting both the educational needs and physical development of young people through gymnastics and sports, as well as promoting their character development. The full purpose of the foundation is set forth in the will of Anders Alreik and Hanna Lovisa Alreik dated June 15, 1863, as well as in the decisions of the Kammarkollegiet dated October 12, 1979 (ref. no. 24-975-79) and October 31, 2003 (ref. no. 430-5440-03).
Fondens ändamål skall vara att med såväl: The purpose of the fund is to use both its capital and its returns to promote higher music education for young people from the municipality of Vaggeryd who lack the financial means to pursue such education. The focus should be on providing annual scholarships for higher music education to 1–2 young people who demonstrate an interest in and aptitude for music studies. However, scholarships may not be awarded for a period longer than three years for any individual.
Att lämna stipendier till unga, lovande: To award scholarships to young, promising, and talented students of music and vocal performance who are or have been registered as residents, primarily in the parishes of Älmeboda or Södra Sandsjö, and secondarily in the other parishes of the Tingsryd deanery.
Den årliga avkastningen skall användas t: The annual proceeds shall be used to provide financial support to male theology students at the nation’s universities who have been accepted as candidates for the priesthood in the Diocese of Växjö. Applicants must have been born or be registered as members of a parish within Kronoberg County.
Att i första hand ge stipendier till stu: To primarily award scholarships to students in the veterinary program for the completion of their thesis.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att dela: The purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships to students who make commendable contributions to Luleå University of Technology and/or the Norrbotten region. The Foundation shall fulfill this purpose by awarding scholarships annually to one or two graduating students at Luleå University of Technology who are active in student organizations.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan som st: The purpose of the foundation is to award the interest as a scholarship to a young person studying at Lund University.
Att utdela stipendium till förtjänt unge: To award a scholarship to a deserving young scholar at Uppsala University who has earned a doctoral degree in the field of mathematics, specifically—regardless of the order of the listed subjects—pure and applied mathematics, mathematical statistics, and technical data processing (“numerical mathematics”) for continued scientific studies in the field of mathematics.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships that promote Nordic student exchange and to support mentoring programs and social interaction among Nordic students at Lund University.

The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships primarily to medical students. Scholarships may also be awarded to individuals who intend to pursue specialized studies in a particular subject at another university, either in Sweden or abroad.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att utge: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to female students.
Utdelas såsom studiestipendier till någo: These funds are awarded as scholarships to female students of theology or philosophy. Should any of my relatives require a scholarship to support their studies, they shall, upon application, be the first in line to receive such a scholarship.
Användas till ett stipendium för kvinnli: To be used for a scholarship for female medical students at any of the country’s universities, the Karolinska Institute, or another equivalent educational institution within the country, to be awarded per calendar year and paid out in two equal installments during each academic term in accordance with the provisions of § 11 of the association’s regulations for scholarship awards. Eligible to receive this scholarship is a Swedish woman who, enrolled at one of the aforementioned educational institutions, demonstrates that she is engaged in medical studies and can produce good grades for these studies, with preference given to those who have specialized in the study of eye diseases. Among such eligible applicants, preference shall be given to Miss Nilsson’s blood relatives.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stödja musikv: The foundation’s purpose is to support musical activities in Mora and to award scholarships to young people, primarily violin students, to enable them to pursue higher education in music. Young people from Mora and the surrounding area will be given priority.
Möjliggöra studieresor till Sverige för: Enable study trips to Sweden for Finnish youth.
Avkastningen från fonden, sedan ett infl: The returns from the fund, after an amount sufficient to cover inflation has been added to the principal, shall primarily be distributed annually to music students within the aforementioned subject area. Secondarily, funds may be used to organize concerts, provided that one of the testator’s works is performed.
Den årliga avkastningen därav skall såso: The annual proceeds therefrom shall be awarded as a scholarship to a student at the Royal College of Music, preferably to a student in the violin class.
Avkastningen skall årligen utdelas såsom: The proceeds shall be distributed annually as scholarships to music students, primarily singers and pianists.
Avkastningen utdelas såsom stipendier åt: The proceeds are distributed as scholarships to students or former students of the Academy of Music, or to other students who have demonstrated outstanding talent in piano, violinor singing, and preferably to those who are less well-off; and these latter students shall, with regard to the possibility of being awarded scholarships, be fully equal to students or former students at the Academy of Music. However, scholarships may not be awarded to students who are not Swedish citizens.
Av årliga avkastningen, en tiondel skall: One-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The remainder of the fund’s return shall, after review by the Academy’s Board, be distributed as a scholarship to one or more talented and motivated students at the Academy who are training to become woodwind players and who require financial support for their continued studies. The foundation’s capital may not be drawn upon.
Fondens ändamål är att genom stipendier,: The purpose of the fund is to provide, through scholarships awarded annually, opportunities for further education—including abroad—to particularly talented Swedish music students who have completed their basic training and whose goal is to become soloists or teachers, preferably in voice or piano. Scholarships may also be applied for by talented instrumentalists if there are special reasons for doing so. A condition for receiving the scholarship is that the studies be conducted within the framework of classical music. The maximum amount may be awarded annually. Scholarships may also be awarded to particularly talented music students in conducting classes, as well as cello, violin, and flute students who intend to train as soloists or teachers.
30% skall tillfalla Svenska Stiftelsen f: 30% shall be allocated to the Swedish Salvation Army Foundation, Box 5090, 102 42 Stockholm, to constitute the "Elsa and Arne Jarlefors Fund." It is our wish that the annual returns be used for work with the deaf and visually impaired in Sweden. Funds may be used for summer camps and/or various forms of encouragement, as well as to support the education of counselors for the deaf and visually impaired.
Stiftelsen har till uppgift att 2 gånger: The foundation’s mission is to award scholarships twice a year, in May and November, to students pursuing technical studies in the municipality of Järfälla. To be eligible, applicants must be Swedish citizens with at least two generations of Swedish ancestry.
Avkastningen av fonden skall årligen sås: The fund’s returns shall be awarded annually as a scholarship to a deserving piano student for continued studies abroad; as a rule, the scholarship shall be awarded to the same student for a maximum period of two years.
Stiftelsens huvudsyfte ska vara främjand: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to support the studies and development of promising young acting students. The Foundation shall pursue this purpose by awarding, if possible, one or more scholarships annually. To be eligible for funding from the Foundation, the student must be talented and focused on character acting of a dramatic or comedic nature. The student must also have a connection to Malmö Theatre Academy, or the educational program that may replace it. For the interior design of a space commemorating Lars Passgård’s acting career in the new theater at the former Mazzetti factory in Malmö, an amount not exceeding one-quarter of the donation may be utilized.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att främj: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote education and contribute to greater understanding between different cultures by awarding scholarships for post-secondary education, which are administered by Skandinaviska Institutet AB or another organization approved by the Foundation, and to increase opportunities for students to study in a country other than their country of residence. Furthermore, the Foundation shall work to ensure that information regarding study opportunities is easily accessible, primarily through the Foundation’s website, and shall prioritize the individual’s ability to make independent study choices. The Foundation shall also work to foster greater understanding and contact between students and prospective employers.
Att främja begåvad, flitig, mindre bemed: To support talented, hardworking, and financially disadvantaged students of exceptional merit who have been members of the Södermanlands-Nerikes Nation for at least four semesters.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att allmänt: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote Swedish-Russian relations in general. To this end, the Foundation shall primarily award grants and scholarships to young Russian citizens for study and education in Sweden.
Fondens avkastning skall användas till r: The proceeds from the fund shall be used to provide travel grants for talented Swedish piano students at the conservatory.
Fondens avkastning skall användas till s: The proceeds from the fund shall be used to provide scholarships for Swedish piano students who are training to become pianists or piano teachers, with priority given to students who are trained and work according to the principles I have followed in my teaching career.
Årliga avkastningen utdelas i form av et: The annual proceeds are awarded in the form of one or more scholarships to the top students in the violin class at the Royal Academy of Music in Stockholm. The scholarships are intended solely for students at the Academy.
Nettoavkastningen skall såsom ett stipen: The net proceeds shall be awarded as a scholarship either to a student pursuing studies in composition at the Royal Conservatory of Music, or to a student who intends to pursue such studies abroad. The scholarship recipient must be a Swedish citizen, not older than 30 at the time of application, in need of financial support for their education, and possess talent for composition. Preference for the scholarship is given to the son or daughter of a person who is or has been a chamber musician with the Royal Court Orchestra in Stockholm.
Beredande av ett antal stipendier om min: Establishment of a number of scholarships of at least 2,000 Swedish kronor per year to be awarded to talented, financially disadvantaged students at the academy. The same person may receive a scholarship for up to three years.
Understöd tilldelas Svensk född, ogift m: Grants are awarded to Swedish-born, unmarried men or women, not under twenty nor over thirty years of age, who are recognized for their commendable and moral conduct and are found to possess exceptional talent, in one case for music and in the other for painting, sculpture, or architecture, and who, following preparatory studies in their home country, also intend to obtain, through travel and residence in foreign countries, a more complete education and, if possible, the highest level of training for the practice of one of these branches of the fine arts.
Av den årliga avkastningen skall minst 1: At least 10 percent of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The portion of the scholarship fund’s return available for distribution shall be used for students enrolled in the agricultural program or the new three-year natural resources program as: - a reward or encouragement for students who have demonstrated good knowledge in a specific subject, good camaraderie, or commendable diligence - scholarships for continued education - assistance for students for studies or study trips within or outside the country. The returns may not be used for purposes that are to be covered by levied funds.
Till flitig, medellös studerande av Väst: To a diligent, financially disadvantaged student of the Västgöta Nation; one scholarship for a theology student and one scholarship for a medical student, preferably from Borås. The scholarship may be received from the age of 20 to the age of 25 and is awarded by the rector upon the recommendation of the nation’s inspector.
Att utdela stipendier till lovande eleve: To award scholarships to promising students in violin and voice at the Royal College of Music in Stockholm.
Stiftelsens avkastning skall till 3/5-de: Three-fifths of the Foundation’s annual income shall be allocated to scholarships for deserving and promising students at the Royal The remaining two-fifths shall be distributed annually as scholarships to composers who have distinguished themselves in the field of chamber music.
Att lämna bidrag till sophiasystrar och: To provide grants to Sophia Sisters and students in the nursing program at Sophiahemmet University who are in need of financial support or, following an illness, require rehabilitation or a period of rest. 1. Ändamålet för stiftelsen är att skapa: 1. The purpose of the foundation is to establish and maintain a permanent foundation, and through it to enable both laypeople and yogis to engage in, develop, and practice Buddhist religion, philosophy, and culture in countries not traditionally considered Buddhist, in accordance with the traditional Diamond Way Buddhist transmission of the Karma Kagyu lineage. 2. The Foundation shall be dedicated solely and exclusively to non-profit purposes in accordance with the tax legislation for non-profit organizations in Sweden. 3. The purpose of the foundation, in accordance with § 2, is to promote projects that serve the teaching, study, and practice of the lay and yogic paths within the Karma Kagyu lineage’s transmission of the Diamond Way, both domestically and abroad. Above all, this will be realized in the following ways (but in achieving these goals, the foundation will not limit itself solely to the means specified here): a. Supporting individuals who: i. teach the practice and theory of the Karma Kagyu lineage (teachers); ii. and/or engage in extended meditation retreats—laypeople and yogis as well as monks and nuns, the latter from traditionally Buddhist countries; and/or iii. translate authentic Buddhist texts. b. Allocating sponsorship funds to individuals studying the Tibetan language and/or Buddhism at an institution of higher education; c. The acquisition, construction, renovation, maintenance, and all forms of support for real property intended to serve as housing for laypeople and/or yogis and for communal study and practice (Buddhist centers), support for real property for retreats, and also support for Buddhist monasteries and spiritually significant sites in traditionally Buddhist countries; d. the promotion of Buddhist art, including architecture and construction-based art; e. the promotion of Tibetan medicine; f. the promotion of charitable, socially beneficial, and educational institutions to the extent permitted by Swedish law; g. the promotion of projects that serve Buddhist practices for the care of the dying, as well as the creation and maintenance of Buddhist cemeteries.

Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att lämna: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide financial aid to students for studies at an educational institution after they have completed their elementary school education. Students who are eligible for financial aid are those who were born and raised in the municipality of Mora and who, given their own and their family’s financial situation, are in need of financial support to complete their education.
Att stimulera till forsatta studier och: To encourage continued education and maintain high academic performance in higher education. The fund’s assets shall be used to award 50,000 kronor annually to each of the two female and two male students with the highest final grades in the graduating class. This amount shall be adjusted annually by an amount corresponding to the change in the consumer price index.
Ändamålet med stiftelsen är att bereda t: The purpose of the foundation is to provide two scholarship recipients from India per academic year with the opportunity to pursue advanced-level studies at KTH. Applicants must hold at least a four-year bachelor’s degree from a technical university or equivalent institution in their home country. Applicants from the Mumbai Metropolitan Area or Pune will be given priority. The foundation can only award the scholarship after a place at KTH has been guaranteed. The scholarships are to be used to cover tuition fees, housing, and living expenses in Sweden for one academic year. Each scholarship shall initially amount to 250,000 SEK per year (2012). The scholarship amount shall thereafter be adjusted to changes in the consumer price index and adjusted for any increases in tuition fees. Scholarship recipients are admitted in accordance with KTH’s admission regulations. The selection process takes into account the applicant’s home university, academic merits, letters of recommendation, references, thesis work, and relevant work experience. After completing the first academic year, the same scholarship recipient may apply for an additional year of the scholarship, but for no longer than a total of two years.
Användas på samma sätt som de medel, vil: To be used in the same manner as the funds allocated to the Ebba Richter Scholarship for law students at the Stockholm Nation at Uppsala University.
Kungl. Musikhögskolan skall i första han: The Royal College of Music shall, in the first instance, use the proceeds to purchase a complete set—as far as possible—of sheet music for Franz Berwald’s chamber music works. The sheet music shall be distributed as prizes to deserving students in the Royal College of Music’s ensemble performance class. Should any amount remain from the annual proceeds after the purchase of the prescribed sheet music, it shall be up to the Royal College of Music to decide whether this shall be added to the capital, used for the purchase of gramophone recordings of Franz Berwald’s works, or for the acquisition of sheet music for his musical works other than those specified above. Purchased gramophone records or sheet music shall be distributed as prizes in the manner prescribed above.
Att utdela ett stipendium per läsår till: To award one scholarship per academic year to a student or students enrolled in the Department of Art History who have written a paper in the field of glass art (as a first priority), design (as a second priority), or other art history (as a third priority). The scholarship amount shall be one base amount.
[...] ett af dessa Stipendier att alltid: [...] that one of these scholarships be permanently allocated to the Södermanland and Nerike Nation, which is composed of students at the Academy.
Fondens syfte ska vara att främja utbild: The purpose of the fund is to support the education of young violin students at the Stockholm College of Music. Each year, one-tenth of the returns shall be added to the principal, and after the expenses of the equipment department have been deducted, the remainder shall be awarded to a student at the school.
Ur fonden skall årligen utdelas ett stip: Each year, a scholarship of 1,000 Swedish kronor shall be awarded from the fund to a diploma student in the organ class at the Stockholm College of Music. If the return on the fund does not amount to 1,000 Swedish kronor, no scholarship will be awarded that year.
Fondens avkastning skall - efter styrels: The Fund’s returns shall—at the discretion of the Board—be distributed annually to highly qualified female, or, in the absence of such, male music students, preferably in voice, whether they are enrolled students or not [...]. The grants may appropriately be awarded as travel grants. A portion of the fund’s returns shall be added to the principal annually, as determined by the Board.
[...] kapitalet skall bibehållas orubbat: [...] the principal shall remain intact, and the income from the fund, in amounts of 2,500 kronor, shall be awarded as scholarships to students who, upon completion of their education at the Academy, are deemed suitable for and deserving of support for further musical studies, preferably abroad, with the same person receiving a scholarship for more than two years only in exceptional cases and never more than three times.
Avkastningen av fonden skall antingen so: The proceeds from the fund shall either be awarded as a gift to a student or students in the organ and piano classes at the Academy of Music, or be distributed as a travel grant to a deserving student upon graduation from the Academy.
Den årliga avkastningen sedan tio (10) p: The annual return, after 10 percent of it has been capitalized, shall be used to fund an appropriate number of scholarships for music students, primarily in classical and modern music. All music students—with preference given to applicants from Helsingborg and the surrounding area—shall be eligible to receive scholarships to help cover the costs of their studies, both within and outside Sweden.
Avkastningen av fonden skall användas ti: The proceeds from the fund shall be used for scholarships or awards for students at music conservatories, preferably for those studying voice. In individual years, however, the interest may be used for other purposes to promote Swedish music.
Den årliga räntan bör användas till gåfv: The annual interest should be used to award a grant to a solo vocal student at the Royal Swedish Academy of Music’s Conservatory who has demonstrated and continues to demonstrate a strong merit for such support and is also in need of financial assistance. In the event that no such qualified student is available in a given semester, the interest shall accrue to the Academy’s general scholarship fund until the original purpose can be fulfilled. [..] The interest on the principal may be received over the course of three years by the student who, during this time, studies continuously at the Conservatory. Should their studies be interrupted due to illness, it is up to the committee to decide whether and to what extent the grant may continue to be received. In exceptional cases, if all committee members agree, the grant may be extended to a fourth year, specifically for the purpose of a study trip abroad.
[..] avsedd att främja svensk tonsättark: [..] intended to promote Swedish composition. [..] The proceeds shall be awarded as a scholarship either to a student pursuing studies in composition at the Royal College of Music, or to a student pursuing such studies abroad. The scholarship recipient must be a Swedish citizen, not older than 30 at the time of application, and possess talent for composition. The scholarship recipient may receive the scholarship for three consecutive years. Should the scholarship not be awarded to a student at the Royal College of Music in any given year, it may be used to increase the scholarship amount for applicants pursuing composition studies abroad.
Fondens årliga avkastning skall av Akade: The Academy shall allocate the fund’s annual return as follows: a) 10 percent (10%) of the return shall be added to the principal each year; b) the Academy may use the remainder of the return to provide scholarships to ambitious and talented music students, regardless of their field of study. The scholarship may be used to finance studies both within and outside the country.
[..] skall fondens avkastning årligen av: [..] the Fund’s annual returns shall be distributed by the College of Music’s Faculty Council to students in need at the College of Music, with the amount available for distribution each year being awarded in full to a single student.
[...] Årligen, sedan 10 % av avkastninge: [...] Each year, after 10% of the proceeds have been added to the endowment, the Royal Swedish Academy of Music shall award a prize to promising young Mozart interpreters, to support, for example, a trip to Salzburg. The recipient must have completed their studies in Sweden with a diploma.
Fonden har till syfte att genom utdelnin: The purpose of the fund is to support young violinists in their musical training by awarding grants for studies, instrument purchases, or other initiatives aimed at achieving academic success. The grant is to be awarded annually, following appropriate auditions within the framework of KMA’s grant program, in accordance with the decision of the violin jury at KMA. The jury has the right to select multiple recipients. If there are no eligible applicants, the scholarship amount will be reserved for the following year. The announcement will be made at KMA’s annual celebration at the end of November/beginning of December.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att främj: The purpose of the Foundation shall be to promote continuing education or further training for nurses who have completed their basic education—that is, the education leading to a professional nursing degree—and who wish to further their education in a manner that benefits the teaching of health, medical, and social care. The Foundation’s purpose shall be promoted by distributing the return on capital, after a 10 percent capitalization, as scholarships.
[..] Fondens avkastning skall användas t: [..] The proceeds from the fund shall be used to provide travel grants for talented Swedish violin students at the Academy of Music. The grant shall be awarded by a special committee consisting of four regular members and one alternate. [..] An audition shall be held before the committee with the three most advanced applicants. Minutes shall be taken at the committee’s meetings, but only of the decisions made therein. Each member has one vote in a ballot. In the event of a tie, the opinion receiving the chairperson’s vote shall prevail. [..] For the awarding of the scholarship, the fund’s interest income shall be at the committee’s disposal. The scholarship shall, if possible, be awarded every other year and amount to at least 1,000 kronor or to an amount that exceeds this sum by a multiple of 100. Any excess interest income shall be added to the fund. The scholarship shall be announced at the beginning of the fall semester within the premises of the Academy and the College of Music, and applications shall be submitted by eligible students. Decisions regarding the award shall be announced on the Academy’s anniversary.
Avkastningen av fonden ska stödja musikl: The fund’s returns are to be used to support the music scene in Nybro, for example by organizing concerts and/or providing scholarships for music students from the municipality.
1. [..] att stödja vidareutbildning av u: 1. [..] to support the further education of young organists who, upon completion of their basic training, are deemed to show exceptional promise. 2. Scholarship recipients may pursue their further education both in Sweden and abroad. 3. At least 10% of the fund’s annual return shall be added to its capital, after which the remainder, following deduction of any administrative costs, shall be used for the purpose stated in 1. above. 4. The scholarship awarded should be at least 10,000 SEK, which currently corresponds to approximately 40% of a so-called base amount. The minimum amount thus specified should be adjusted to the base amount for the year in which the scholarship is awarded or, should the base amount system undergo significant changes, adjusted in some other way to reflect changes in the value of money.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att allt går till: The purpose of the foundation is to ensure that all funds go to the Department of Engineering at Karlstad University, and that the annual returns are used to award a scholarship to someone who has developed an idea that could lead to a patent and manufacturing in Sweden.
Fonden har till ändamål att vartannat el: The purpose of the fund is to award scholarships every two years, or at least every three years, to percussion students at Swedish conservatories, or to Swedish percussion students at conservatories abroad, who have demonstrated exceptional artistic talent and potential. The scholarships are to be used for educational purposes.
Fonden har till ändamål att genom utdeln: The purpose of the fund is to award scholarships to young music students with a keen interest in contemporary musical language in the broadest sense, to be used for studies in either composition or chamber music (with jazz not to be overlooked) or for other purposes that promote academic study.
Den årliga avkastningen av denna fond, s: The annual return on this fund, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the principal, shall be distributed by the foundation primarily as work grants to authors of educational materials and translators of educational literature, for guest lectures in Sweden by prominent foreign educators, for study trips by Swedish eurhythmics educators, and secondarily for other purposes consistent with the foundation’s objectives that the foundation’s board of trustees deems urgent.
Ur fonden ska årligen utdelas ett belopp: Each year, the fund will award a grant of 10,000 Swedish kronor to a selected recipient. Eligible applicants are music students born in Jämtland/Härjedalen who have been admitted to music studies at the university level in Sweden, or the equivalent, as determined by the board. The scholarship is available for all forms of music studies, including those focused on “how music can be used in clinical practice.”
Från fonden utgår premier till i övrigt: The fund provides grants to students who are otherwise eligible for such grants and who reside in Gotland, Kalmar, or Malmöhus counties. If there are no students from any of these counties or, in the future, from equivalent areas, the return on the fund’s investments shall be added to the principal; however, the board reserves the right to set aside the amount for one year for the possible distribution of a larger sum the following year. Should Norwegian students be enrolled at the institution in the future, the Board shall have the right, notwithstanding the foregoing, to award such students grants from the fund.
Enligt gåvobrevet utgår från fonden prem: According to the deed of gift, the fund awards grants to students who, in the college’s view, “are well deserving of the encouragement that such a grant represents.”
Avkastningen disponeras för utdelande av: The proceeds are allocated for the awarding of scholarships to students whom the dean and the faculty deem deserving.
Efter sedvanlig avsättning av del av rän: After the customary allocation of a portion of the interest, the remaining portion of the fund may be used for "the needs of chemistry education." This includes the salaries of laboratory assistants (though not salary supplements), interior work not funded by the state or municipality, and the purchase of special teaching materials not considered part of normal consumption. Should the chemistry laboratory established in 1938 with funds from this fund no longer be used for the teaching of chemistry as announced by the department, the fund shall, in accordance with the donor’s instructions, be transferred to Uppsala University to be used there for corresponding purposes.
[---] Detta kapital får icke förminskas,: [---] This fund may not be reduced, but the interest accrued over two consecutive years shall be paid as a travel grant to one of the museum’s regular or temporary employees for studies abroad.
Nettoavkastningen skall årligen utdelas: The net proceeds shall be distributed annually as a scholarship to a talented student to assist with their continued music studies.
Att uppmuntra ungdomssimmare inom SK Elf: To encourage young swimmers at SK Elfsborg in their future plans. Support shall be provided in the form of a scholarship that may be awarded annually to a swimmer who has not reached the age of 21 during the award year. Water polo players, subject to the same age limit, shall also be considered. The primary purpose is not to reward the top performer in any discipline, but rather to encourage those who show an aptitude for academics, demonstrate good sportsmanship, and maintain good conduct. Scholarship recipients must have competed for SK Elfsborg during the three calendar years immediately preceding the award year.
Stiftelsen skall genom stipendier främja: The Foundation shall, through scholarships, promote the education of talented young violin students who are under 16 years of age and are not enrolled in a conservatory or equivalent institution. Only the income from the Foundation’s capital may be used to fulfill the Foundation’s purpose.
Stiftelsens avkastning skall användas ti: The Foundation’s returns shall be used to fund scholarships for medical students. Eligible to receive a scholarship are medical students who 1) are studying at Karolinska Institutet and are Swedish citizens; 2) are in need of financial support to complete their studies; and 3) have demonstrated through diligence and knowledge that they are worthy of encouragement. Among those who qualify, the recipient shall be the one who has demonstrated the greatest scientific ability. The principal may also be utilized.
Stiftelsens avkastning, sedan minst en t: The Foundation’s investment income, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the capital, shall be used to fund scholarships for students studying wind instruments at all Swedish conservatories and at other Swedish institutions offering equivalent higher music education. Alternatively, the investment income may also be awarded to former college students pursuing studies abroad.

The Foundation’s investment income, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the capital, shall be used to fund scholarships for students studying string instruments at all Swedish conservatories and at other Swedish institutions offering equivalent higher music education. Alternatively, the income may also be awarded to former college students who are studying abroad.

The Foundation’s investment income, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the capital, shall be used to fund scholarships for students studying the organ or church music at all Swedish conservatories and at other Swedish institutions offering equivalent higher music education. Alternatively, the income may also be awarded to former college students pursuing studies abroad.

The Foundation’s investment income, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the capital, shall be used to fund scholarships for students studying piano at all Swedish conservatories and at other Swedish institutions offering equivalent higher music education. Alternatively, the income may also be awarded to former college students pursuing studies abroad.
[---] att användas till grundläggning oc: [---] to be used for the establishment and maintenance of one or more scholarships, - to be called the "Nilsson Scholarship," by investing such capital (so as to generate income) and by paying such income to, or using such income, from time to time, for the benefit of one or more students at the said Academy of Music, Stockholm [---] who are currently recipients of such scholarship or scholarships.
Stiftelsens avkastning, sedan minst en t: The Foundation’s investment income, after at least one-tenth of it has been added to the capital, shall be used to fund scholarships for students studying voice at all Swedish conservatories and at other Swedish institutions offering equivalent higher music education. Alternatively, the investment income may also be awarded to former college students pursuing studies abroad.
Stiftelsens avkastning skall användas ti: The proceeds from the foundation shall be used to fund two equal scholarships annually for students at Karolinska Institutet. Female students who have earned a Bachelor of Medicine degree or its equivalent but not a medical degree or its equivalent, and who have demonstrated diligence and good conduct, are eligible for the scholarship. A scholarship recipient who, through diligence and conduct, has earned the scholarship may receive it for four consecutive years. However, if the recipient earns a medical degree or equivalent, she shall no longer be awarded the scholarship. The principal may also be utilized.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att i Tristan Bjö: The purpose of the foundation is to support the artistic development of young musical talents in the spirit of Tristan Björling by awarding scholarships annually. The scholarship may be used to cover the costs of instruments, lessons, study trips, or other expenses related to further musical development. At least two scholarships shall be awarded—one for Gotland and one for Öland.
Avkastningen av kapitalet skall såsom st: The income from the capital shall be awarded as grants to one or more architects who have graduated from the University, to be used for study trips. If deemed appropriate, the capital itself may also be utilized.
Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara att främja: The purpose of the Foundation shall be to promote post-secondary education outside Sweden, including expenses such as travel, food, and lodging, for direct descendants of Jacob Palmstierna’s son, Greger Palmstierna. The Foundation’s purpose shall be fulfilled through the awarding of cash grants.
Av den årliga avkastningen ska 20% lägga: Twenty percent of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The remaining amount shall be distributed as scholarships to one or more deserving engineering students at Chalmers University of Technology, as determined by the Office of the President.
Årliga avkastningen skall användas såsom: The annual proceeds shall be used to fund the Electrical Engineering Department’s study trip.
Hela avkastningen vart femte år skall ut: The entire proceeds every five years shall be awarded to a deserving, hardworking student.
I samklang med denna livsgärning skall a: In accordance with this bequest, the proceeds from the memorial fund shall be awarded every four years as a travel grant to a civil engineer who has graduated from the Department of Civil Engineering at Chalmers University of Technology, is under 40 years of age, and has demonstrated an outstanding interest and aptitude for work in the field of port construction.
Avkastningen av fonden skall efter Styre: The Board of Directors shall determine how the fund’s returns are to be used to subsidize students’ annual trips, without giving preference to any particular vocational school.
Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara att främja: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote post-secondary education outside Sweden, including covering expenses such as travel, food, and lodging, for direct descendants of Jacob Palmstierna’s son, Niclas Palmstierna. The Foundation’s purpose shall be fulfilled through the distribution of cash grants.
Insamlingsstiftelsen Help to Help skall,: The Help to Help Foundation shall, using funds raised, work to promote positive development in developing countries by providing grants or loans for post-secondary education for young students. The Foundation may use funds to support other purposes that enable young people to pursue their studies. Furthermore, the foundation shall promote cooperation between students and the labor market and provide assistance and support in matters related to entrepreneurship and professional life. To the extent appropriate, Help to Help shall assist companies in each country in recruiting students from Help to Help’s network. Operations shall be conducted in such a way that revenues are used, to the greatest extent possible, to support the foundation’s primary purpose.
Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara att främja: The purpose of the Foundation is to support post-secondary education outside Sweden, including expenses such as travel, food, and lodging, for direct descendants of Jacob Palmstierna’s daughter, Jacqueline Palmstierna Oker-Blom. The Foundation’s purpose shall be fulfilled through the disbursement of cash grants.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att sedan 20 % av: The purpose of the foundation is that, after 20% of the fund’s returns have been added to the principal, the remainder be used to award grants to lecturers visiting Lund University Hospital.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan skall: The purpose of the foundation is that the interest shall be awarded annually as a scholarship to a poor or underprivileged student within the nation, and may be awarded to the same person for two consecutive years—all of which is to be decided by the nation’s senior council.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The foundation’s purpose is that 20% of the annual return shall be allocated to capital, while 80% may be distributed. The grant is awarded to students of Lunds Nation who have spent two years at the University and have been members of the Nation for at least the same period of time.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att lämna underst: The purpose of the foundation is to support the education of music students by awarding scholarships. Scholarships are to be awarded to piano students as well as to other music students.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja högre: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote higher education in Malmö by awarding grants to music students at the Malmö Academy of Music or—should the Academy cease to exist—to the institution that takes over its functions. In allocating the funds, consideration shall be given to ambition, aptitude, and need, and priority shall be given to violin and cello students.
Stiftelsen ska årligen lämna minst två s: The Foundation shall award at least two scholarships annually to students at Karolinska Institutet. Eligible to receive a scholarship are medical students who have distinguished themselves through diligence, skill, knowledge, and good character.
Stiftelsen ska årligen lämna ett eller f: The Foundation shall award one or more scholarships annually to students at Karolinska Institutet. Eligible to receive a scholarship are students holding a Bachelor of Medicine degree or equivalent who are in need of financial assistance.
Stiftelsen ska årligen eller med några å: The Foundation shall award scholarships annually or every few years to medical students at Karolinska Institutet. Students studying histology at the Department of Neuroscience are eligible to receive a scholarship.
Stiftelsen ska vartannat eller vart tred: Every two or three years, the Foundation shall award a scholarship to a student at Karolinska Institutet. Eligible to receive the scholarship are students holding a Bachelor of Medicine degree or equivalent who are pursuing studies in physiology.
Stiftelsen ska årligen lämna ett eller f: The Foundation shall award one or more scholarships annually to students at Karolinska Institutet. Medical students who have distinguished themselves in the study of either anatomy or physiology are eligible to receive a scholarship.
Stiftelsen ska årligen lämna ett stipend: The Foundation shall award an annual scholarship to students at Karolinska Institutet. Eligibility for the scholarship is limited to students holding a Bachelor of Medicine degree or equivalent.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att dela ut: The purpose of the foundation is to award a scholarship to a financially disadvantaged student in the Faculty of Humanities who is pursuing studies in at least one of the following subjects: literary history and poetics, history of religion, or Nordic languages, with preference given to deserving female applicants.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ge en eller f: The purpose of the foundation is to provide one or more female students at the Department of Visual Arts Education at Konstfack with financial grants (scholarships) for experimental activities in the field of visual arts and design, as well as for advanced studies in visual arts education. The annual return on the foundation’s assets may, after at least one-tenth of the return has been added to the capital, be used to provide financial grants. The recipient(s) of the grant is/are appointed by the department board of the Department of Visual Arts Education at Konstfack. The size of the grant should be of a significant amount, which is why only one or two recipients should be considered per year.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att utdela e: The purpose of the Foundation is to award one or more scholarships, or portions thereof, for undergraduate and graduate studies at Uppsala University to students from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China, who, under Swedish law, are required to pay tuition fees for studies in Sweden. Scholarships may be awarded for one or more academic years. Applicants must have documented good academic performance. Scholarship amounts may be drawn from both the current returns and the foundation’s capital. However, the foundation’s capital may not be fully utilized before the end of 2020.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stärka de kul: The purpose of the foundation is to strengthen cultural ties between Italy and Sweden by providing students at Swedish universities and colleges with the opportunity to continue their studies during a period of residence in Italy. This primarily applies to studies in the fields of musicology, archaeology, philology, or literary studies. The scholarship is awarded for one year at a time. The recipient is selected by the Swedish Institute in Rome. The recipient should be able to speak German, English, or French at a basic level and, preferably, also have some knowledge of Italian.
Sedan av årlig avkastningen en tiondel l: After one-tenth of the annual return has been added to the principal, the remainder shall be distributed as one or two scholarships, as determined by the School Board in each individual case, to well-behaved male students at any of the nation’s universities, colleges, or higher agricultural schools. To be eligible for the scholarship, the applicant must either have been born in the parish of Eldsberga or have parents who are or, at the time of their death, were registered residents there. In awarding the scholarship, priority shall be given first to the need for the scholarship and second to academic achievement. The scholarship may be held by the same person for a maximum of three years but must be applied for annually. The School Board may, however, if special circumstances so require, grant the recipient permission to retain the scholarship for a longer period than that specified above. If no applicant applies in any given year, or if the School Board otherwise determines that the scholarship may not be awarded, the income for that year shall be added to the principal.
1/ Av den årliga räntan utbetalas varje: 1/ Of the annual interest, SEK 1,000 shall be paid each year to Malte and Jenny Mårtensson, Odengatan 15, Jönköping, as long as they reside in Jönköping. In the event of the death of either spouse, the full amount shall be paid to the surviving spouse under the aforementioned conditions. 2/ From the annual interest, SEK 1,000 shall be paid to Editor Per Lundevall, S. Kyrkogatan 4, Lidköping, for as long as he lives. 3/ The remaining interest shall be paid annually, as determined by the church council, as a study grant to one or more theology students at the Kingdom’s universities who intend to enter the service of the Church of Sweden, and the interest shall be paid in the first instance to such students who were born or are registered in the parish of Jönköping.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga av: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual returns as scholarships to one or more deserving students in the graduating classes. When selecting scholarship recipients, consideration should also be given to the student’s financial circumstances, so that those in greater need of financial aid are given priority, without, however, compromising the requirements for diligence and good conduct in general.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att sedan 10 % av: The purpose of the foundation is that, after 10% of the returns have been added to the principal, the remainder be used to support students in teacher training programs who are interested in Swedish, German, or French language and literature.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av den årliga: The purpose of the foundation is that at least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the fund’s capital. The return may be used to award scholarships to students pursuing studies to become priests at universities, colleges, pastoral institutes, or equivalent educational institutions within or outside the country. As a condition for receiving the scholarship, the applicant must, following an admissions conference, have been deemed suitable to enter service as a priest within the Diocese of Växjö.
Stiftelsens upplupna ränta utdelas årlig: The Foundation’s accrued interest is distributed annually, after appropriate capitalization, in full or in part, as determined by the Board of the Department of Social Work at the School of Social Work in each specific case, as a reward to students who have been enrolled at the department for at least three semesters and who, through independent work in connection with their studies or in some other way, have demonstrated that they are particularly deserving of such a reward.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att sedan minst 1: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the remaining returns—after at least 10% of the returns have been added to the capital—as awards or scholarships to students at Svalöv Agricultural School who have achieved outstanding academic results in crop science.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to fund scholarships for Nordic music students.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att årligen dela: The foundation’s purpose is to distribute at least 10,000 SEK annually, or 80% of the annual return generated if that amount exceeds 10,000 SEK, in the form of scholarships for academic excellence to students in the theoretical programs.
Av fondens medel skall till ovannämnda E: From the fund’s assets, an annual sum of four thousand (4,000) kronor shall be paid to the aforementioned Edith Andersson. Following Edith Andersson’s death—provided that the fund’s capital amounts to one hundred thousand kronor - a scholarship shall be awarded each year to a man or woman who, after graduating from high school in Norrköping, intends to pursue studies in foreign languages at a university or college as part of their professional training and who wishes to further their linguistic education through studies abroad but lacks the means to do so. To be eligible for the scholarship, the applicant must, by means of a certificate from the school’s faculty, demonstrate that, based on outstanding proficiency in foreign languages demonstrated during their school years, they possess excellent prerequisites for continued study in these languages for their intended profession. Provided that the scholarship recipient can present a certificate from the relevant instructor at the university or college attesting to fruitful and successful language studies, the scholarship may be awarded to the recipient for a period of one or two additional years.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ge stipendium: The purpose of the foundation is to award a scholarship to a student at Lund University who has distinguished themselves through diligence and exemplary conduct and is in need of financial support.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest, to the extent that it suffices, be allocated as a scholarship to a promising young man of modest means studying at Lund University, so that he may receive from the Academic Society lodging, necessary heating, food, care, and lighting.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan skall: The purpose of the foundation is to award the interest as a scholarship to one or more students at Lund University who have distinguished themselves through exemplary conduct and diligence and who are in need of such financial support.
Av årliga räntan, sedan först en tiondel: From the annual interest, after first adding one-tenth to the principal, a scholarship of no more than 100 kronor shall be awarded at the end of the fall semester to a student who has shown aptitude for and successfully pursued studies in mathematics. Should the fund’s earnings increase to the point where additional scholarships of 100 kronor can be awarded, this may be done.
Sedan tio procent av avkastningen lagts: After 10 percent of the return has been added to the capital, the remaining return shall be allocated by the school board and used for the benefit of school staff, primarily as grants for studies, study trips, and scientific and educational work.
...till främjande av den vid högskolan [: ...to promote the education of students at the university [Stockholm University] and for similar purposes—upon decision by the university’s faculty—scholarships are awarded to exceptionally talented students in the fields of economics or political science. Only students with a special need for financial support are eligible for a scholarship.
Stipendierna skall tilldelas studerande: The scholarships shall be awarded to students at Uppsala University who are members of the Östgöta Nation and were born in the Diocese of Linköping. Preference shall be given to applicants born in Norrköping and to those who can demonstrate a family relationship with the donor. Scholarships shall be awarded to students of theology, medicine, and law, with priority given to theology students for two of the scholarships.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stödja studer: The purpose of the foundation is to support students at Lund University, with priority given first to students belonging to the Skåne student nations, and second to students from the Skåne student nations who are studying economics (as specified in the call for applications) and "industrial enterprises in the Skåne region."
Stiftelsens ändamål är att årligen utdel: The purpose of the foundation is to award annual grants to students in need—whether due to illness or other circumstances—who are members of the Helsingkrona Nation at Lund University. It also aims to ensure that priority is given to students who are residents of Helsingborg.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stipendie utd: The purpose of the foundation is to award a scholarship to a poor young man from the Småland Nation studying at Lund University, subject to the following conditions: -The recipient must be at least 17 years old. -He should be known for his piety, diligence, and virtuous conduct. -This scholarship is not awarded to graduates. -Should any of the donor’s own relatives or those of his wife, regardless of nation affiliation, apply for this scholarship, they shall be automatically selected (provided they have otherwise distinguished themselves through diligence and virtuous conduct). Should multiple relatives be studying, their applications shall be decided by lot. -Preference shall be given to a member of the Småland Nation from the parishes of Uråsa or Agunnaryd, and a poor priest’s son shall have priority.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att därav årliga: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual interest accrued as of December 1 to two students at Lund University who are known for their good conduct, diligence, and ability, with preference given to students from the Skåne Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan å kapi: The purpose of the foundation is to ensure that the interest on the capital is paid annually to a theology student at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual interest as a scholarship to one or more students in need at Lund University, with priority given to students from Skåne.

The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest be distributed equally as scholarships to two young men of my family studying at Lund University or, if none are available, to two needy, diligent, and virtuous university students born in Bohuslän.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att användas till: The purpose of the foundation is to provide a scholarship for a student of the Västgöta Nation who is continuing their studies at Lund University. No one shall receive this scholarship who is not known for good manners, diligence, and quiet demeanor, and in particular for a sincere and unpretentious fear of God. The student of the Västgöta Nation who receives this scholarship may retain it for 3 years. If no one from the Västgöta Nation is eligible for this scholarship, it shall then be awarded to a student from the Götiska Nation or another nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att för två vid L: The purpose of the foundation is to provide scholarships to two young men from Malmö or Lund who are studying at Lund University; those born in Malmö shall have priority over those from Lund, and those appointed to such a scholarship shall retain it for as long as they remain students at Lund University without receiving any public salary, and for as long as they thereby demonstrate diligence in their studies and lead a decent life, which the Skånska Nation will not fail to supervise.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att åt studerande: The purpose of the foundation is that this annual interest be awarded in full over a period of three years to students at Lund University, primarily to one of my student relatives, in accordance with the following order: 1. The children and descendants of Franz George Krook. 2. The children and descendants of Thomas Krook. 3. The descendants of Pehr Sommelius. 4 All those bearing the surname Krook, along with their children and descendants. 5 All other relatives, with the paternal line taking precedence over the maternal line. In the event that none of my relatives are enrolled at Lund University, two students born in Malmöhus County shall each receive half of the aforementioned interest payments as a scholarship for a period of two years.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att tilldela stip: The purpose of the Foundation is to award a scholarship to a student at Lund University who is of modest means but known for diligence and good character. Should any of the applicants be able to prove that he is a relative of the donor, he shall then be given priority in the awarding of this scholarship, provided, however, that it is granted under the aforementioned condition of facilitating the completion of the aforementioned studies for a young person of limited means.
Stiftelsen ändamål är att tilldelas någo: The purpose of the Foundation is to award a scholarship to a needy, diligent, and virtuous young man from the Scanian nations who is studying at Lund University; however, should there be a similarly qualified candidate who is related to us or a young man from V. Göinge district, and apply for the scholarship in question, then the former shall be given priority and the latter considered next in line when the scholarship is awarded.
Stiftelsen medel skall såsom stipendium: The Foundation’s funds shall be awarded as scholarships to one or more financially needy students at the university; in this regard, students named Bergström from the family of the same name to which I belonged, as well as students named Kraft from the family of the same name to which I belong, shall have priority in receiving available scholarships, provided that, if a student named Bergström or a student named Kraft who is eligible for priority applies for the same available scholarship, the faculty shall decide which of them shall receive the scholarship.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att: 1. av vilkas: The purpose of the foundation is: 1. to provide an annual scholarship to support a poor student, preferably from the Skånska Nation. 2. to provide a scholarship to another poor student who shows great promise, preferably from the Skånska Nation. Should any student at Lund University, upon the availability of these scholarships, be able to provide reliable proof that he is a relative and, furthermore, show promise, he shall be entitled to this benefit and assistance in preference to anyone else.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is that the annual interest on the capital, which should subsequently be invested in such a way as not to jeopardize or diminish it, be used for a scholarship to be awarded by the Faculty of Philosophy and, for as many consecutive semesters as deemed appropriate, be granted to a student at the university who, in need of financial support, possesses a desire and aptitude for Nordic antiquities and history.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att vartannat år: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at Lund University every other year.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att stipendium ti: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to women studying medicine; the scholarship may be divided among more than one applicant, at the discretion of the relevant university authorities. Eligible applicants are women who have earned a Bachelor of Medical Philosophy or a Bachelor of Medicine degree, or the equivalent of the fourth semester of medical school, or future degrees corresponding to these. The scholarship is awarded to the applicant whom the university’s medical faculty deems most deserving, based on greater talent, diligence, skill, and conduct, as well as financial need. faculty, taking into account greater talent, diligence, skill, and conduct, as well as financial need, deems most deserving.
Fondens avkastning må, sedan 10% tillför: Once 10% of the fund’s capital has been contributed, the Board of Auditors may use the fund’s returns to award scholarships to individuals pursuing higher education in singing, music, and the arts.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships to students at Lund University—specifically to students born in Sweden, regardless of which student nation they belong to or which field of study they are pursuing—who are known for their exceptional aptitude, good character, and impeccable conduct in all respects, diligence in their studies, and are in genuine need of financial support.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att dela ut stipe: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at the University of Copenhagen or Lund University who intend to pursue studies at a Nordic university other than the one to which they belong. (No document available)
Stiftelsens ändamål är att åt en därav f: The purpose of the Foundation is to award a grant to a deserving student from the Blekinge or Skåne student nations at Lund University, so that it is awarded alternately to a student from Blekinge and a student from Skåne, with priority given each time to a medical student, provided that he is deemed deserving of such priority based on his academic progress. Should the capital increase by more than 5%, two-thirds of the interest saved shall be added to the capital until it has increased by 1,000 kronor, at which point 5% of the capital thus increased shall be distributed as a scholarship, and so on.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is that the investment income and 80% of the appreciation in value of the foundation’s assets shall be used as financial grants and scholarships for law students at the faculty who, having passed their exams, have progressed in their law studies to at least the third semester or have achieved equivalent academic results. High grades alone shall not be considered a qualifying criterion for receiving a grant from the Foundation; rather, grants shall be awarded primarily to students who demonstrate a strong interest in their legal studies, with the aim of encouraging them to continue their studies toward a law degree.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att räntan årlige: The purpose of the foundation is for the university to distribute the interest annually to a student from the Kristianstad Student Nation. Every other year to a theology student and every other year to a medical student.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att verka för att: The purpose of the Foundation is to help make young students’ dreams for the future and international exchange a reality by awarding one or more scholarships to students in the architecture program at Lund University. When awarding scholarships, priority shall be given in the spirit of Sara, keeping in mind her wish to study in the United States. Further criteria within this purpose are determined by the trustee after consultation with representatives of the architecture program, as well as Sara’s parents and sister. The scholarship is normally awarded annually in the largest possible amount without depleting the endowment capital. Decisions regarding the award are made by representatives of the architecture program, consisting of one representative from the school administration and one representative from the faculty at the bachelor’s level. The application deadline shall be April 3 in memory of Sara’s birthday. In the event that the architecture program at Lund University is discontinued, the foundation shall instead be administered by the Swedish institution providing higher education in architecture closest to Lund.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att bilda en fond: The purpose of the foundation is to establish a fund for students of voice and music. The fund shall be transferred to and managed by the Malmö Academy of Music. Two vocal scholarships of 10,000 SEK each shall be awarded annually to one female and one male student, as long as the fund’s capital permits.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att fondens avkas: The purpose of the foundation is to ensure that the fund’s returns—that is, up to 90% of the interest accrued annually—are used to promote initiatives and, in particular, the development of assistive technology. Each year, a guest lecture shall be held in the name of Anders Nilsson on a selected topic. The Board of the Center for Rehabilitation Technology at Lund University of Technology and Natural Sciences is responsible for appointing the lecturer and selecting the topic. The fund’s returns may be used for other purposes in keeping with the fund’s spirit. In such cases, these purposes shall be determined by the same board and may replace the annual lecture. However, the lecture shall take precedence. Awards for special contributions in the field, particularly by graduate students, may be granted in the form of scholarships.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att fondens årlig: The purpose of the foundation is that the fund’s annual return, minus 10%, shall primarily be used to award one or two music scholarships to students at Lund University. The scholarships shall not be advertised. They shall be awarded by the Board of the Efraim and Gertrud Liljeqvist Fund. The Board may decide that available returns shall be used for purposes other than scholarships, such as the purchase of instruments, books, or sheet music for the academic chapel.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att, sedan 1/10 a: The purpose of the foundation is that, after 1/10 of the annual return has been added to the principal, the total sum of two years’ remaining returns shall be awarded each year before the end of the spring semester to a female or male student of the Småland Nation who is pursuing modern language or medical studies and who, through diligence and success in these fields, has made themselves well-deserving of the award.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela tvenne: The purpose of the Foundation is to award two scholarships to needy students at Lund University; and of these scholarships, each of equal amount, one 1) shall be awarded to a student of the Skånska Nation and the other 2) to a student of the Småländska Nation, with priority given first to those bearing the testator’s name and secondarily to those descended from the daughters of the testator’s brother, Lagman Danckwardt.
