Stiftelsens ändamål är att all avkastnin: The purpose of the Foundation is that all returns on the capital received—including interest, dividends, any appreciation in value, etc.—shall, after 10 (ten) percent has been set aside for capital appreciation, be distributed annually to students at Lund University, primarily for studies in Arabic and secondarily for studies in Spanish. Should the University’s programs in the aforementioned languages be discontinued, the University may change the recipient group to students in other languages. In the event that all language programs are discontinued, the University is free to allocate the funds to other scholarships. The purpose is for the scholarship to cover a student’s tuition costs for one semester from time to time. In the event that the return exceeds this amount, additional scholarship recipients, or alternatively a scholarship for the same person over multiple semesters, may be considered. The university shall decide on this. Even smaller surpluses may be used, for example, to purchase literature, and distributed as an incentive. Such purchases shall then be made by the university. To the extent that a surplus is not deemed distributable, the amount shall be capitalized. Should the return fall short of the founder’s intentions, it shall nevertheless, to the extent that it suffices, be distributed in accordance with the terms of the endowment.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja verksa: The purpose of the Foundation is to support the activities of the Department of Analytical Chemistry at Lund University, with a focus on funding initiatives for which funds are lacking or would be difficult to obtain through other means. The fund may thus be used to cover, among other things: 1) travel grants, etc.; 2) costs for invited guest lecturers; 3) entertainment expenses. Distributions from the fund shall primarily be made from the investment income. Should this prove insufficient, the principal may also be utilized.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att, sedan minst: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute grants, after at least one-tenth of the annual interest has been added to the principal, to one or more deserving and diligent students of the Småland Nation at Lund University.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to use the proceeds to fund scholarships for students at the Malmö Academy of Music. The scholarship is awarded once a year.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att ge understöd: The purpose of the foundation is to provide financial assistance to diligent, needy theology students at the university. Priority shall be given to descendants of Vicar Per Carlström of Önnestad, followed by descendants of Pastor Carl Trädgårdh of Esphult.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att av de årliga: The purpose of the foundation is to use the annual interest income to provide financial assistance to deserving medical students in need at the university. In doing so, priority is given to the descendants of Pastor Carl Trädgårdh of Esphult.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the Foundation is to award the annual interest, in the form of a scholarship, to a needy student at Lund University who is known for diligence and good character and who belongs to the Kalmar Nation or a provincial association, with preference given to those who can prove kinship with the donors, are of noble birth, and are engaged in the study of law. The scholarship may be held by the same person for three, or at most four, years.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela den år: The purpose of the Foundation is to distribute the annual interest, less ½% calculated on the basis of the principal amount, which is added to the principal, to students of the Skåne Nation who are pursuing studies at the University of Lund, provided they distinguish themselves by their piety and exemplary conduct, combine natural aptitude for their studies with diligence, and are in need of such support. Preference is given to individuals descended from Fredrika Elisabeth Borg and Brita Charlotta Richter, regardless of their national affiliation, provided they otherwise meet the eligibility requirements for this scholarship.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships every other year to students at Lund University who demonstrate good character and outstanding diligence, giving priority to 1) students from low-income families with good academic performance, and 2) students born in Skåne.

The purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships in two equal parts, one of which is to be granted to a relative—a de Berg, a Liljehorn, or anyone who can demonstrate a family connection to these lineages— and the other to a student of limited means, born in Borgholm on the island of Öland or in that part of Småland that constitutes Kalmar County, provided that such students are known for their good character and diligence and are members of the Kalmar Nation at Lund University. Should no relative apply for the scholarship, it may be awarded to a student of limited means within the Kalmar Nation.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att; a) främ: The Foundation’s purpose is to: a) promote medical and humanitarian aid, such as by providing grants to politically and religiously independent aid organizations that work in various crisis situations—for example, in connection with natural disasters and epidemics—assist with health care, and work to ensure access to quality medicines and treatment methods in areas where they are needed, as well as otherwise work to save lives and alleviate suffering in these areas. The international aid organization Doctors Without Borders shall be the primary recipient of these funds. b) award scholarships to promising music students at the Royal College of Music in Stockholm (KMH), or the organization that may replace KMH, to promote their continued musical development; and c) promote the cultural field of porcelain painting. This purpose may be promoted, for example, by awarding scholarships or by supporting activities that provide education in this field. Disbursements for the purposes stated above shall be decided upon and paid out by the trustee with the following considerations in mind. Of the grants awarded annually, at least fifty percent shall be allocated to the purpose under § 1 a above. Furthermore, as a guideline, twenty-five percent of the annually granted funds shall be allocated to the purpose under § 1b and twenty-five percent to the purpose under § 1c above. If, in a given year, there is no need to allocate twenty-five percent to the purposes under § 1b or § 1c, the purpose under § 1a should be further prioritized. It is thus not the intention that the purposes under § 1b or § 1c be promoted with more than twenty-five percent each. Allocations for the purposes under § 1b and § 1c above should be made following an application process. The promotion of the Foundation’s purposes may take place both through its own activities and through contributions to other activities. To fulfill the foundation’s purposes, the annual direct return, less administrative costs, may be used. Direct return refers to current income, such as interest and dividends.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att dela ut stipe: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at Lund University. (No charter available)
Stipendier ska utdelas till studerande v: Scholarships will be awarded to students at Lund University who have demonstrated good academic performance for at least two semesters.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award an annual scholarship to a poor, diligent student of good character who has not yet received a master’s degree.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdelas som s: The purpose of the foundation is to award a scholarship to a student of the Blekingska Nation at Lund University who is, preferably, in need of financial support and who, in addition, distinguishes himself or herself through diligence and good character, and who, during the semester for which the scholarship is sought, is enrolled in the nation and has been enrolled there for at least one preceding semester.
Stipendium till studerande vid samtliga: Scholarships are available to students in all programs at the College of Education and the College of Music. Scholarships are primarily intended for students who do not receive a salary or honorarium.
A. Varje år första helgfria dag i oktobe: A. Each year, on the first weekday in October, provided that eligible applicants for the scholarship have applied, half of the approved scholarship amount shall be paid out; and on the first weekday in February of the following year, the other half of the amount shall be paid out. B. Only those who meet the following criteria are eligible to apply for this scholarship: 1. were born in Stockholm and have taken their high school graduation exam there; 2. have been enrolled at the University for at least one year / two academic terms / and during that time have shown promise regarding talent and diligence, demonstrated good conduct and maintained an honorable reputation, and are still studying at the University; 3. is, in the first instance, the son of a widow of modest means who was the widow of a government employee in the salary class of at most a postal assistant and at least a postal clerk; in the second instance, the son of such an employee; in the third instance, the son of a destitute widow who was the widow of a smallholder, tenant farmer, or the like; fourthly, the son of such a person; fifthly, the son of a destitute widow of a craftsman; and sixthly, the son of such a person; 4. is enrolled in the mathematics and natural sciences program at the university. 5. Is demonstrably destitute. C. The scholarship may be retained for a maximum of five years, subject to annual review. D. Applications for the scholarship must be submitted annually by the end of March to the faculty, which selects the recipient no later than May. Should the faculty be unable to reach a decision, the Rector has the right to select the recipient from among the two applicants who received the most votes within the faculty.
Avkastningen skall årligen användas för: The proceeds shall be used annually to award scholarships to three young people who were born and reside in one of the specified municipalities (Gravarne, Fisketången, and Bäckevik) and who have graduated from high school with excellent grades.
Stipendium till studerande vid Lunds Uni: A scholarship for students at Lund University who regularly participate in the academic chapel’s rehearsals.
Till teologie studerande vid Lunds Unive: For theology students at Lund University who intend to become priests in the Church of Sweden. Priority will be given to students at Smålands Nation.
Stipendium till studerande vid Lunds Uni: Scholarship for students at Lund University who are members of Kalmar Nation and have been enrolled in the nation for at least one semester. Awarded for four semesters.
Årliga räntan skall, sedan en lämplig de: The annual interest, after an appropriate portion thereof has been added to the principal, shall be awarded as a scholarship to a student of the Kalmar Nation who, during the semester in which the scholarship is sought, is enrolled at the university and has been enrolled there for at least two semesters.
Till studenter vid Lunds Universitet, so: To students at Lund University who are members of the Värmland Nation and have been enrolled in the nation for at least one semester.
Stipendium till studerande vid Lunds Uni: Scholarship for students at Lund University who are members of the Värmland Nation.
Till studerande vid Lunds Universitet so: To students at Lund University who have been enrolled at Västgöta Nation for at least one semester.
To students at Lund University who are members of Östgöta Nation.
Stipendium till 3 studerande tillhörande: Scholarships for three students affiliated with the Småland Nation at Lund University, who are from the Diocese of Växjö.
Stipendium till studerande vid Lunds Uni: Scholarship for students at Lund University, with priority given to students affiliated with the Skåne student nations who were born in Skåne.
Stipendium under vårterminen av filosofi: Scholarships for the spring semester from the Faculty of Arts are awarded to students enrolled at the university who are well-behaved and have demonstrated merit in the study of Nordic languages.
Stipendiet må utdelas till studerande in: The scholarship may be awarded to students in the faculties of law, medicine, or philosophy, with no preference given to any particular faculty. It should be awarded to deserving, talented, academically successful male or female students born in Malmöhus County, preferably those who have earned a degree from the university, whereby completion of the first half of the Bachelor of Laws degree is considered a completed degree. Naturally, only members of Lund’s Nation are eligible.
Att en gång per år arrangera och bekosta: To organize and fund guest lectures at Lund University once a year on topics related to rheumatology.
Stipendium utdelas till någon behövande: The scholarship is awarded to a deserving student at Lund University who is in need of financial assistance.
Stipendium till studerande vid Lunds Uni: A scholarship for students at Lund University who have distinguished themselves through diligence and progress in instrumental music during the Academic Chapel’s rehearsals.
Hvaraf räntanårligen kommer att användas: The interest earned each year will be used for the second group of students
Den årliga räntan skall utbetalas till e: The annual interest shall be paid to a theology student, with preference given to those who were born in or have been members of the Båstad or Hof parishes for several years and wish to be ordained as priests in the Diocese of Lund.
Nr1: Stipendium för studenter vid religi: No. 1: Scholarship for students in the religious studies program who are primarily affiliated with the Gothenburg or Halland Nations, and secondarily with the Blekinge Nation. Preference is given to theology majors. No. 2: Scholarship for students in the religious studies program, primarily for members of the Blekinge Nation, and secondarily for members of the Gothenburg or Halland Nations. Preference given to theology candidates or equivalent.
Fondens avkastning skall årligen utdelas: The fund’s returns shall be distributed annually as scholarships to one or more students at Lund University or any other university in the Kingdom. Students at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences or any other university specializing in agriculture or forestry may be considered for a scholarship. Descendants of members of the Skåne Association of 1900, who have fulfilled their financial obligations to the Association and its scholarship fund, shall, regardless of their field of study, have priority for the scholarship over other applicants, and the need for financial support shall be given special consideration when reviewing the descendants’ applications. If no descendants of members of the Skåne Association of Men of 1900 apply for the scholarship, it may be awarded to another student at the University of Agricultural and Forestry Sciences or to a student in the Department of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at Lund University.
Stipendium till en eller högst tvenne vä: A scholarship for one or, at most, two deserving students affiliated with the Helsingborg-Landskrona Nation at Lund University. The scholarship may be renewed, but may not be awarded to the same recipient more than three times.
Stipendium tilldelas en vid Lunds Univer: The scholarship is awarded to a financially disadvantaged student enrolled at Lund University who is pursuing medical studies to become a physician and who, through diligence, interest in their studies, and exemplary conduct, has demonstrated that they are deserving of it.
Stipendium utdelas till en teologie stud: The scholarship is awarded to a theology student at Lund University.
2 stipendier till studerande vid religio: 2 scholarships for students in the religious studies program who intend to enter the Protestant ministry of the Church of Sweden. 1 scholarship for students in the education sector for cultural and information professions (with the exception of the religious studies program); the language studies and history and social sciences teacher training programs.
Stipendium för befrämjande af högre teol: Scholarship for the promotion of advanced theological studies.
Ett årligt stipendium för någon beskedli: An annual scholarship for a well-behaved and diligent student at Lund University.
Stipendium till vilken årlig ränta Consi: A scholarship in the form of an annual stipend awarded by the Consistorium Academicum to a needy student who demonstrates a desire and aptitude for study, to be used over three consecutive years, in exchange for a commitment to continue their studies at the academy during that time.
Stipendium skall utdelas till två vid un: The scholarship will be awarded to two well-behaved and deserving students enrolled at the university who are studying Nordic languages
Den årliga avkastningen av stiftelsens f: The annual return on the foundation’s fund shall be awarded as a scholarship to young people under the age of 25 in Rehns BK to support their studies. The scholarship is awarded to young people who are members of the district elite in orienteering or ski orienteering. The scholarship recipient must have the ambition to continue pursuing orienteering while pursuing their studies. Young people who have demonstrated strong leadership within Rehns BK and who have the ambition to continue as leaders within the club while pursuing their studies may also be considered.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att med den årlig: The purpose of the Foundation is to use the annual interest to provide financial support to a student at Uppsala University who is preparing to enter the ministry of the Church of Sweden in his or her home country or in its mission fields, and who, by virtue of Christian character, aptitude, and lack of personal funds, may be considered qualified for such support —with preference given to students of the Västgöta Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at Lund University who have a good reputation for leading a God-fearing, quiet, and virtuous life, and who are capable of studying at foreign universities to their benefit.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att för all framt: The purpose of the foundation is to serve, in perpetuity, as a travel grant fund for students at the university, with priority given to my siblings and those of my late wife, Augusta Andersson, as well as the heirs of Per Elis Melander.
Stipendium till studerande vid LU, med f: Scholarship for students at LU, with priority given to students belonging to the Småland, Helsingkrona, Blekinge, or South Scania student nations.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to award the annual interest as a scholarship to a well-behaved and diligent young student of the Skånska Nation.
Den för utdelning disponibla avkastninge: The return available for distribution shall be used to provide scholarships to students from the former municipality of Sörbygden, corresponding to the geographical area of the parishes of Krokstad, Hede, and Sannes. The scholarship shall be awarded to students pursuing higher education, preferably for training as a priest, a teacher in compulsory education, a physician, or an engineer. However, the proceeds may not be used to cover needs that, by law, must be met with tax revenues. At least 1/10 of the annual net proceeds shall be added to the principal. The remaining amount is available for distribution the following year. Proceeds that are not distributed shall be reserved for distribution in future years.
Till förmån för elever vid skolor inom M: For the benefit of students at schools in the municipality of Mellerud. The funds are to be used within the compulsory school system in the municipality of Mellerud to subsidize field trips, camp trips, end-of-year celebrations, theater activities, lectures, excursions, and town-twinning exchanges—including Nordic exchanges—or other school-related activities not covered by allocated funds.
Avkastningen ska till 4/5 årligen utdela: Four-fifths of the proceeds are to be distributed annually as scholarships to talented young music students to help them develop their musical skills.
1.Stipendiet utdelas av universitetets s: 1. The scholarship is awarded by the university’s scholarship committee every three years, beginning in 1975. 2. Eligible to receive the scholarship are needy students at the university, with priority given to a) students whose father or mother is or has been employed by the university and belongs or belonged to the category referred to in Forsling’s time as janitors, b) students who were born in Uppland. 3. For the time being, the scholarship amounts to 500 SEK. When the fund’s annual return reaches 1,000 SEK, the University Council shall decide on the amount at which the scholarship shall be awarded in the future. Any further regulations deemed necessary, in addition to the above, shall be issued by the University Council.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att, sedan minst: The purpose of the Foundation is that, after at least one-tenth of the annual return has been added to the principal, funds shall be allocated every five years to the city veterinarian in Karlskrona, the district veterinarian whose area of operation is the Municipality of Karlskrona, and other veterinarians with the same area of operation, as grants for studies, study trips, or scientific publications.
[...] beloppet af de medel, som blifvit: [...] the amount of the funds that have been collected [...] shall be distributed as a grant or award to one or more members of the Norrland Nation at Uppsala University, together with interest on the funds received through the end of the current year [...].
[...] Stipendium åt en som Student vid U: [...] A scholarship for a young man enrolled as a student at the Royal Academy of Uppsala and studying there, born in Västra Dalarna in the county of Fahlu or Stora Kopparberg [...].
[...] räntan skall användas till ett två: [...] The interest shall be used to fund a two-year scholarship for a theology student from the Gästrike Hälsinge Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att den årliga rä: The purpose of the foundation is to use the annual interest earned on the fund’s assets for charitable purposes in the form of awards or scholarships for students in Karlshamn.
Den årliga ränteavkastningen (med kapita: The annual interest income (with the principal remaining intact) is awarded to a deserving theology student from the Vestmanland and Dala Nation during his or her studies.
Till stiftande af ett Stipendium för väl: For the establishment of a scholarship for deserving students of the Norrland Nation at Uppsala Academy [...]. Future scholarship recipients may receive this support for four years or, in particularly important cases, for a maximum of five years.
[...]avkastningen från fonden ska utdela: [...]the returns from the fund shall be distributed every other year in the form of scholarships to deserving students at the C-level [...] who have presented their papers at the C-seminar during the two preceding years (with a cutoff date of November 1). If there are deserving candidates of both genders, one scholarship recipient shall be female and the other male. The scholarships shall not be subject to application.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att i första hand: The purpose of the foundation is primarily to award the scholarship to a direct descendant of J.E. Arpi, the pastor of Börstil, who is studying at one of the country’s universities. If no relative applies, the scholarship is awarded to a deserving, talented student from the Uplands Nation. The Nation’s seniors nominate three applicants, after which a lottery is held among them at a general meeting. A relative receives the scholarship for the entire duration of their studies; others receive it for four years.
[...] räntan, såsom årligt underhåll til: [...] the interest, as an annual stipend, shall be awarded alternately to a deserving and needy student from the Östgöta and Stockholm Nations; however, those who are related to me or my dear wife, and who are otherwise equally deserving and in need as their unrelated fellow applicants, shall have priority; however, no one may receive such support for more than four years;
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att främja v: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote language training for police officers who have completed their basic training, meaning those who have graduated from the Police Academy. Civilian staff and lawyers in the police management track, however, are not eligible. The languages referred to here are German, French, Spanish, and Portuguese, but not English or Russian. This objective may be achieved by awarding scholarships to cover the costs of continuing education in the languages listed above. Applicants must possess basic knowledge of the relevant language, which should be demonstrated by grades or other reliable proof of study. Applicants who have studied the relevant language at the university level shall always be given priority. The study plan should include improvement in reading the relevant language as well as in oral and written expression. Language studies may advantageously be conducted in a country where the language is official and spoken. The purpose of the Foundation is to provide police personnel with the opportunity to develop their skills in speaking, reading, and writing foreign languages, in order to qualify for international service within a police operational area, such as the UN, NATO, or EUROPOL. Police personnel intending to apply for international assignments through the Folke Bernadotte Academy are also eligible. In the selection process, efforts shall be made to ensure an equal distribution of male and female scholarship recipients. Should there not be a sufficient number of applicants to achieve an even distribution, a portion of the amount available for distribution may be returned to the capital if this is in the best interests of the foundation, such as when taking current tax legislation into account. To fulfill the foundation’s purpose, the direct return may be used, less administrative costs. Direct return refers to current income, such as interest and dividends. At least ten percent of the annual return should be added to the capital. It is of the utmost importance that the real value of the foundation’s endowment capital be maintained and, ideally, increased.
[...] Fonden är avsedd att ligga till gr: [...] The fund is intended to serve as the basis for an award granted to doctors and licentiates who have authored and published a dissertation on the Swedish language. The fund shall remain untouched until it has grown to 5,000 kronor. Thereafter, the annual interest income—after deducting one-fifth, which is added to the principal —shall be allocated to a prize, named the Natan Lindqvist Prize, which is awarded every three years to the doctor or licentiate at Uppsala University who is deemed to have, during the preceding five years, through published works, made the greatest contribution to the study of the Swedish language.
Studiehjälp för jordbruksungdom inom soc: Financial aid for young people in the parish who wish to attend horticultural or agricultural school or other comparable training programs that serve the purpose of encouraging young people to return to rural areas.
Avkastningen av denna fond skall använda: The proceeds from this fund shall be used to promote cultural cooperation among the Scandinavian countries, preferably in the form of scholarships for students at folk high schools, with priority given to students at the music school in Frösön, if it is established, or otherwise in Arvika.
Avkastningen överlämnas till Styrelsen f: The proceeds are transferred to the Board of Chalmers University of Technology every two years to be awarded as a travel grant to a deserving student in the final or, if applicable, penultimate year of the School of Architecture.
Räntan af Tretusen (3000) Rdr Rmt utdela: The interest on three thousand (3,000) riksdaler is to be distributed annually as a scholarship to a young man from Ångermanland studying at Uppsala Academy, who, despite limited means, possesses outstanding aptitude for study and has distinguished himself through diligence, moral conduct, and a thrifty lifestyle. With regard to the selection of the scholarship recipient, we request that the Inspector of the Norrland Nation, upon the recommendation of the nation’s Curators and Seniors—or, should these titles cease to exist over time, the ten oldest members of the nation— be willing to undertake, after a conscientious examination of the prevailing circumstances, to select the person most deserving of this scholarship, who, provided that the conditions set forth above continue to be met, may enjoy the same for six (6) academic terms during which he has been present at the Academy. Should there be anyone at the Academy who, possessing the aforementioned qualities, is a direct descendant of the late merchant J.C. Kempe of Hernösand and Anna Catharina Vikner, or of the late Office Manager E.P. Holmberg of Nora and his wife Hedvig Bergquist, then such a student shall have priority.
Interesset för hela Capitalet a 6 proCen: The interest on the entire capital at 6 percent per annum shall be used for six years to support a scholarship recipient from the Östgötha Nation who was born in the Diocese of Linköping and is studying at Uppsala Academy; such a scholarship recipient shall be called a Palmaerianus. [...] 4:0 When a scholarship has become vacant in one way or another, the Inspector of the Östgötha Nation, together with the Seniors, shall appoint, by a majority vote (unless otherwise agreed, and in which case the Inspector shall have three votes), three God-fearing, virtuous, diligent, and quick-witted young men, especially those who are poor, who are nominated and presented to the Consistorio Academico, which, following the preceding examination, shall appoint one of them to the vacant scholarship, and this also by a majority of votes, where necessary, since the Inspector of the Östgötha Nation always has three votes in the ballot. 5:0 Should the person so appointed, within the six years of the scholarship, either completely abandon Uppsala Academy or, after two years have elapsed, fail to appear there to duly continue his studies, from roll call to roll call, during the current academic terms, another shall immediately take his place. 6:0 Should any member of the Palma family be equally worthy and capable as another, he shall have priority for this scholarship. 7:0 Should a Palmaerian scholarship recipient, during the scholarship period, spend one or at most two years residing elsewhere than in Uppsala, he shall receive no scholarship funds during that time; instead, they shall be added to the capital and accrued in the same manner. If he returns within two years (whether he has been at another academy or elsewhere where he has acquired useful knowledge), he shall again receive his scholarship under the conditions set forth in Section 5; however, he must not, on the second occasion, leave the academy during the semesters, whether for a longer or shorter period, unless he was absent for less than two years the first time, in which case the scholarship shall immediately be transferred to another. 8:0 While the scholarship recipient is at the Academy, he must take an annual examination before the Inspector of the Nation and demonstrate how he spends his time. If he is noted for idleness or an immoral life, he shall immediately forfeit the scholarship. 9:0 The capital shall remain untouched in perpetuity and shall otherwise be managed as previously stated. 10:0 Should a Stipendiarius Palmaerianus, during the term of the scholarship (NB: in order to achieve greater advancement in any noble branch of the sciences), wish or have the opportunity to travel abroad, whether or not this occurs in the company of a student, at his own expense or not, with or without a traveling companion, he shall receive his scholarship in full during the journey, provided that he does not, during the time of his travels, demonstrably render himself unworthy of it.
[...] skal uprättas ett Stipendium [...]: [...] a scholarship shall be established [...] to be awarded for a period of three years to a poor, quick-witted, and virtuous student at the University of Uppsala [...] 2:0 Furthermore, when appointing a scholarship recipient, the aforementioned Consistory shall be required to propose three students, but by no means any other than those who are known to be of such means as to be in need, of particular quickness in their studies and pleasantness in their conduct, and who, for that reason, have previously spent at least one year at the Academy. Of these three, my eldest son, and if he dies without a son, then the second, and so on, indeed even the descendants of my daughters, the nearest branch having the right to name the one who should enjoy this scholarship for the continuation of his studies. 3:0 I wish, however, that if any of my own or of my late or my late wife’s family or descendants should be known to be residing at the Academy and possess the three qualities mentioned in the next §2, he should nevertheless, after examination by the relevant consistory, be deemed the closest to this scholarship, and this without regard to closer or more distant kinship; I also wish to emphasize most strongly that neither kinship nor any other factor shall be taken into account, unless, on the one hand, poverty or destitution, and on the other hand, virtue and intelligence, speak in favor of the applicant. 4:0 If none of the aforementioned relatives apply and are found suitable upon examination, the following shall be appointed: (following a proposal of three such candidates) one student alternately from the Östgöta and Västgöta nations, so that when an Östgöta has held the position for three years, three Västgöta students shall be proposed for it and one of them shall receive it, and so forth. 5:0 This Stipendiarius shall be, as previously stated a) previously known at the Academy by the Professors, particularly by the Inspectors of the Nation, b) of modest means, diligent, quick-witted, and virtuous, especially God-fearing, sober, and of good character, so that there is good hope and promise regarding him, and c) preferably the son of a clergyman, provided that he, along with others, is found to possess the required qualities with certainty. 6:0 If this scholarship recipient, during the three years that he has held this scholarship, has shown particular diligence and made remarkable progress—such that he is deemed ready to assume academic honors—then, upon the recommendation of the Academic Consistory, he may be granted a one-year extension by the Scholarship Curator, but neither earlier nor later. 7:0 It is the duty of the scholarship recipient to be present at the Academy at all times while lectures and exercises are being held, thereby making full use of this benefit; if, due to private tutoring at his convenience or for any other excusable reason, he is absent for any term or semester, the Academic Consistory alone shall have the authority to judge whether the absence is justified,
Stiftelsen skall ha till huvudsakligt än: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to award one or more “AF Scholarships” annually to an employee or student at Linköping University who, through their own efforts, has made a commendable contribution to activities, development, or innovation of value to Linköping University. No more than three scholarships shall be awarded in any given year. The Foundation is open to monetary donations from individuals.
Fondens avkastning ska årligen I form av: The Fund’s returns shall be awarded annually in the form of scholarships to: a) talented, less-affluent young Swedish men and women residing in Eskilstuna and the surrounding area within Södermanland County, who wish to—and are deemed to be clearly qualified for—pursue training at conservatories in Sweden or abroad to become professional singers or musicians (piano, violin, cello, or organ); b) an institution or individual who meritoriously administers and leads vocal or music instruction among schoolchildren deemed to possess special aptitude for successful vocal or music studies. This refers to an institution or individual who is in a position to train, for example, a large boys’ choir for public concert singing, orchestral music, etc.
Den årliga räntan skall uteslutande anvä: The annual interest shall be used exclusively to provide financial assistance to a young person born to poor parents in this community [Kungsbacka] who, having completed the local school with a commendation for good character, diligence, and outstanding aptitude for mechanical trades, wishes to acquire further knowledge at a comprehensive technical college. This support may, provided that good conduct is maintained, be received by the same person for three, or at most four, years.
Fonden skall användas till att årligen d: The fund is to be used to award an annual scholarship to a student who, during the year, has demonstrated exceptional achievement in singing and/or music within the Cultural School’s area of operation. The scholarship is to be used to support continued studies and professional development after the student has completed elementary school.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att med h: The purpose of the Foundation shall be to use the returns on the Foundation’s capital and funds raised to award scholarships that enable deserving engineering students to complete part of their mandatory professional internship in North America, which is expected to be of value to their education at Chalmers University of Technology and their future professional careers.
[...] till ett stipendium för Filosofies: [...] for a scholarship for philosophy students at the aforementioned institution [...] And the children of elementary school teachers from the province of Ångermanland shall have priority for this scholarship. The conditions for receiving the scholarship are that the recipient be of modest means, have resided at the university for two (2) years for the purpose of pursuing studies, and have distinguished themselves through diligence, hard work, and good character. The scholarship may be held by the same recipient for a period of four years.
Avkastningen av fonden skall tilldelas g: The proceeds from the fund shall be awarded to a young man or woman with a severe disability who demonstrates academic aptitude. Priority shall be given to those whose parent(s) receive public assistance.
Genom årlig utdelning av stipendium stim: To encourage studies, education, and related activities in the field of art in the broadest sense through the annual awarding of scholarships.
Disponibel avkastning får användas till: The available return may be used to fund scholarships for students from the municipality of Eskilstuna, with priority given to those from the parish of Ärla, for basic nursing education or for specialized training following completion of nursing school; ten percent of the return each year shall be added to the principal, and any unused return may be set aside for distribution in future years.
Till Malmö Latinskola att vid varje vårt: To Malmö Latin School: At the end of each spring semester, one or two scholarships—as determined by the board—shall be awarded, if possible, to a student in the highest or second-highest class who intends to pursue medical studies. If the board deems it appropriate, the same person may receive the scholarship for two consecutive years.
Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara att utdela: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to young musicians or music students in the municipality of Vara. Scholarships may be awarded annually and may not exceed the fund’s annual return plus 5% of the fund’s capital.
AV de årliga räntemedlen lägges 1/5 till: One-fifth of the annual interest income is allocated to the principal. The remainder is set aside so that the return available for distribution in a given year is reserved to be combined with the corresponding return from the following year to form a scholarship to be awarded to students at the institute who have earned it through academic achievement.
Sedan av den årliga avkastningen 5 % lag: After 5% of the annual return has been added to the principal, the remainder shall be distributed annually at Christmas in the form of grants for upbringing or education, or as financial assistance to needy persons belonging to the Knighthood and the Nobility, however, primarily to descendants, both free and non-free, in the direct line of descent from the aforementioned Major General Toll and his wife, as long as such descendants exist. Until the annual yield reaches 200 kronor per year, the entire yield shall be added to the fund’s principal. Grants and support are not fixed in number; rather fewer than more, so that with regard to their size, care is always taken to ensure that they provide the recipients with genuine support and substantial assistance at all times. Applicants for the aforementioned grants or subsidies shall themselves prove their kinship with the aforementioned persons, if such kinship is not evident from the genealogies prescribed and available at the House of Nobility, and it shall be observed that, in the event of competition among several applicants, preference shall be given to the one who proves to be most in need of assistance, regardless of whether they are closer to the common family line or not. Upbringing or educational grants may be awarded to girls or boys during their school years and may thereafter be retained by the recipient, increased by a fixed amount, for a maximum of five years for studies at universities, colleges, military academies, teacher training colleges, or equivalent institutions of higher education, provided that the recipient demonstrates satisfactory progress in their studies. Students at such institutions may also receive the aforementioned grant directly; however, in the event of continued studies, it may be retained under the conditions just stated and for the period normally required to complete a degree, but for no longer than five years. The Directorate of the House of Nobility may, however, decide that in exceptional cases the amount may be retained for a longer period.
Stiftelsen ska årligen utdela avkastning: The Foundation shall annually distribute the proceeds of this fund as financial aid to male students attending civilian or military colleges who need and deserve such assistance, with priority given to members of the Lowinsin, Von Heijne, or related families.
Stiftelsens avkastning, skall efter avdr: The proceeds of the foundation, after deduction of administrative costs, shall be used to provide scholarships to male or female students for further studies or training in a theoretical or practical profession. Priority for the scholarship is given to those who bear the name Tigerschiöld or are descended from someone with that name, regardless of whether he or she is of noble birth. If no eligible applicant applies, the scholarship may be awarded to a male or female student of noble birth, but only for one year at a time. The annual return may also be reserved for distribution together with the returns of subsequent years or added to the principal.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att öka inom Skin: The purpose of the foundation is to increase the knowledge of agriculture and forestry among permanent residents of the municipality of Skinnskatteberg. This may be achieved by awarding grants for studies and travel or by recognizing meritorious work in agriculture and forestry. At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the capital.
Avkastningen önskas komma till nytta som: The proceeds are intended to be used to support the education of a future priest.
Wulfcronska familjestiftelsen skall ha t: The purpose of the Wulfcrona Family Foundation shall be: (a) to provide family members bearing the name Wulfcrona with opportunities to study at a university or college, provided that such support does not extend beyond the year in which the student turns 30; and (b) to provide financial assistance to other family members bearing the name Wulfcrona who are in need. At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the capital.
Åt stiftarens släkt, hans tjänare eller: To provide financial assistance to the founder’s family, his servants, or other individuals during the Christmas season or on other occasions, in amounts to be determined by the foundation’s board. It may also grant loans on terms determined by the board, or provide financial support to promote the studies of those who demonstrate a distinct aptitude for such studies and possess a character that gives reason to believe they will become good citizens.
Den årliga avkastningen utdelas den förs: The annual proceeds are distributed on May 1 of each year as scholarships to two graduating students who have demonstrated enthusiasm and drive in their studies.
Disponibel avkastning skall användas til: The available proceeds shall be used to support the agricultural, forestry, and horticultural sectors within the Boda parish by providing grants for education, study trips, or other appropriate measures. The proceeds may not be used to cover needs that are to be met through public funds.
Avkastningen skall årligen utdelas i for: The proceeds shall be distributed annually in the form of scholarships to each of the two top students in modern languages for study abroad.
Räntan i form af årliga stipendier å hög: The scholarship, in the form of annual grants of up to one thousand (1,000) kronor each, is awarded to needy medical students by the Norrlands Nation at Uppsala University.
Räntan å fonden skall, efter afräkning a: The interest on the fund shall, after deduction of administrative expenses—which, however, may not exceed half a percent of the principal—be paid out annually as a scholarship and disbursed by the Nation’s treasurer in two equal installments at the end of each semester. The recipient of the scholarship shall be a member of the Norrland Student Nation, in need of financial support, and known for diligence and good conduct, with preference given to those who show the greatest promise of further progress in the field of study that is considered to receive the least encouragement through national scholarships. The scholarship may not be awarded to a student who has been enrolled at the university for more than four years or who holds another scholarship within the Nation. The scholarship recipient shall receive the scholarship for three years, provided that he is present at the Academy for more than half of each academic term during that period and does not prove himself unworthy of retaining the scholarship. Should the scholarship not be awarded during any semester for any reason, such as the death of the scholarship recipient or a lack of applicants, the amount thus saved shall be allocated to a special endowment fund, intended to use the interest earned to both strengthen the existing scholarship capital—in the event that the real value of the outgoing scholarship becomes less than it originally was due to a decline in the value of money—and to create new capital for the establishment of new scholarships.
Räntemedlen skola utgå i form av stipend: The interest proceeds shall be paid out in the form of scholarships, one during the spring semester and one during the fall semester, each in the amount to which they have risen as of March 1 and September 1 of the respective semester, less any administrative costs; these scholarships shall be awarded to needy theology students at Uppsala University who are training to become priests and who belong to the Katarina Parish in Stockholm, with priority given to those who, during the term in question, are taking the practical theology course at Uppsala University.
Skall årliga avkastningen såsom stipendi: The annual proceeds shall be awarded as scholarships to a student of the Norrlands Nation, with preference given to students from Haparanda, Piteå, or Härnösand, preferably to someone studying Nordic languages. The recipient may hold the scholarship until he or she has completed his or her academic studies.
10 % av avkastningen skall årligen lägga: 10% of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The remainder of the return shall be distributed as one or more equal scholarships to students in Karlstad, with priority given to young people from the Bredgården and Maxstad estates in the Östra Fågelvik parish.
Den årliga avkastningen skall, sedan en: The annual return, after one-tenth has been set aside for the principal, shall be distributed each spring semester, beginning in 1946, as a scholarship to a student who was born in the dioceses of Härnösand or Luleå and who has passed the upper secondary school leaving examination at Fjellstedtska School in Uppsala. Prior to the awarding of the scholarship, the principal of the aforementioned school shall be given the opportunity to comment on the applicants. Should the Fjellstedtska School cease to exist, the scholarship shall be awarded to a medical student born within one of the aforementioned dioceses. The scholarship may be awarded to the same person for two consecutive years.
Stipendier åt elever på Polhemsskolan in: Scholarships for students at Polhemsskolan in the field of mathematics. If possible, scholarships may also be awarded to encourage fairy tale writing and the study of fairy tales. The foundation’s purpose is set forth in a will drawn up by Helge Johan Viktor Bratt on March 1, 2011, as well as in guidelines regarding the foundation signed by Helge Bratt.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att avkastningen: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the annual returns in the form of scholarships for post-secondary higher education (excluding adult education) to students from the Borrby parish. The fund shall be managed by the School Board of Simrishamn Municipality. Scholarship recipients shall be selected by the School Board following an application.
Avkastningen av fonden skall användas ti: The proceeds from the fund shall be used to provide scholarships for Swedish students from Finland who are studying at Uppsala University.
Stiftelsen har till huvudsakligt ändamål: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships to deserving students or groups of students in the nursing program at Mälardalen University in Eskilstuna, which is funded by the Sörmland County Council. When deciding on distributions from the foundation’s endowment fund, due consideration shall be given to the terms and conditions of the donations comprising the endowment fund. One-tenth of the annual net return shall be added to the foundation’s capital before any distribution may be made.
Stipendium till teologistuderande av Söd: A scholarship awarded by the Södermanland-Nerike Nation to theology students who "have demonstrated the ability to take up the priesthood." The scholarship is awarded for two years, with the possibility of a one-year extension.
Den årliga räntan torde såsom stipendium: The annual interest should be awarded as a scholarship to a financially disadvantaged, diligent, and serious student in the Uplands Nation at Uppsala University.
Av den vid varje års bokslut Nationen ti: From the interest credited to the Nation at the close of each fiscal year, an annual scholarship of 600 kronor is awarded to needy students at the Northern Natural Science School who have demonstrated academic ability and are known for their diligence and good conduct. The remaining interest shall be managed by the Nation and capitalized until the capital thus formed amounts to 5,000 kronor, at which point the Nation shall determine the use of the returns on this savings fund in accordance with the provisions of the deed of donation. When applying for the scholarship, the following shall be observed in particular: the applicant must, in accordance with the Nation’s current bylaws, be enrolled in the Nation without having applied for membership; the applicant must, at the time of application, have been a member of the Nation for at least two years and be enrolled and present at the University and in the Norrland Nation.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att dela ut stipe: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to students at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences. At least one-tenth (1/10) of the foundation’s returns shall be added to the endowment.
Stipendiefond för teaterstuderande värml: Scholarship fund for young people in Värmland studying theater; "theater studies" refers to acting, singing, and dance.
[...] årliga räntan till det högsta belo: [...] the annual interest on the maximum amount that the Academy customarily pays out in scholarships each Walpurgis Night shall be awarded as a prize to one of the nation’s younger students who is in need of it and has earned it through diligence and good conduct, in accordance with the same principles and by the same method of selection as in the awarding of the Wallin Prize.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att främja v: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote activities at Linköping University, particularly with regard to education based on scientific or artistic principles, as well as proven experience, and related development work. The Foundation’s purpose shall primarily be promoted through the awarding of grants to individuals who make or have made a significant contribution to education and its development at Linköping University, with a lasting impact on student learning.
Av fondens avkastning skall årligen 1/5: One-fifth of the fund’s annual return shall be added to the principal. From the remainder of the return, an annual scholarship shall be awarded to students at Uppsala University who are in genuine need of financial support and who lead a moral and sober lifestyle. If there are several applicants who equally meet the aforementioned conditions, priority among them shall be determined by their acquired knowledge.
Av årliga räntan avsätts till ökning av: One-tenth of the annual interest, plus any amount by which the remainder of the interest exceeds an even hundred kronor, shall be set aside to increase the fund, the capital of which may not be reduced. The fund’s return, after being administered as stipulated in § 2, shall be awarded for three years under the name of the Gustaf Fröding Scholarship to a Swedish poet, who shall be selected by a vote among the members of the Uppsala Student Union and other student unions in Sweden.
Stipendiet utdelas vid läsårets avslutni: The scholarship is awarded at the end of the academic year to one or two students. The principal has the authority, after consulting with the faculty, to award the scholarship to a student who is of modest means or from a low-income family and who, in addition, has demonstrated merit through good conduct, diligence, and discipline, as well as an aptitude for learning.
Förmånsrätt för avkomling till komminist: Priority is given to descendants of Assistant Pastor AP Holmström. For individuals wishing to pursue education at a university or other educational institution. The grant is awarded for a maximum of 4 years to the same person. The recipient should preferably have been born in Ilsbo. Priority, etc.
Stiftelsen har, enligt testamente från 1: According to the will dated June 7, 1974, the foundation’s purpose is to award scholarships to young students living elsewhere who are registered members of the Ockelbo parish. In this regard, special consideration shall be given to studies at a university or equivalent institution.

The remainder of the return is distributed as a scholarship in the form of a rent reduction for a room in Södermanlands-Nerikes Nation’s student housing or properties owned by the Södermanlands-Nerikes Nation Student Housing Foundation. The scholarship, which is awarded by the Nation’s Scholarship and Grading Committee following a standard application process, is granted to a diligent and academically gifted member of the Nation who is in need of this financial support. In cases of equal merit, preference shall be given to applicants who can demonstrate that they are studying the Greek language toward a Bachelor of Arts, Master of Arts, or higher degree. The scholarship may be received for a maximum of three years.

After deducting administrative costs, one-fourth is added to the endowment. The remainder is used for a scholarship. The scholarship, which is awarded by the Nation’s Scholarship and Grading Committee following a standard application process, is granted to a talented and diligent male student affiliated with the Nation and enrolled in the Faculty of Philosophy. The scholarship is awarded for a maximum of three years.

After deducting administrative costs, one-quarter of the return is added to the fund’s capital. The remainder is used for a scholarship. The scholarship, which is awarded by the nation’s scholarship and grading committee following a standard application process, is granted to a financially disadvantaged theology student from the Södermanland-Nerike Nation, with preference given to those registered in Eskilstuna who have attended Eskilstuna Upper Secondary School. To be eligible for the scholarship, the applicant must also have been enrolled as a student at Uppsala University for two years and, during that time, have demonstrated academic aptitude, diligence, and good character. The recipient of the scholarship may hold it for three consecutive years, provided that the recipient continues to pursue studies at Uppsala University during that time and otherwise continues to meet the requirements for receiving the scholarship.

Stiftelsens ändamål är att utdela stipen: The purpose of the foundation is to award scholarships to promising artists studying at the Royal Institute of Art who may require such financial support for their stay in Stockholm. However, two annuitants shall be entitled to receive the foundation’s income for the remainder of their lives, and only thereafter shall the foundation be transferred to the Academy of Fine Arts, which will then have the right to dispose of the foundation’s assets.
Kapitalet får ej minskas, utan en tionde: The principal may not be reduced; instead, one-tenth of the interest income is added to the principal annually. The fund is to be used for the purchase of a scholarship room in the properties of the Södermanland-Nerike Nation or the Södermanland-Nerike Nation Student Housing Foundation. This is awarded to a student at Uppsala University who: 1. belongs to the Södermanlands-Nerikes Nation and has completed the upper secondary school diploma at Nyköping High School; 2. has been enrolled in the Nation for no more than three years at the time of application; 3. is diligent and in need. The room may be retained for two years. In the absence of qualified applicants, the entire return is added to the capital.
Stipendier ur denna fond skall tilldelas: Scholarships from this fund shall be awarded to students born in Gävleborg County.
Af årliga afkastningen skall en femtedel: One-fifth of the annual proceeds shall henceforth be set aside and added to the principal, while the remaining four-fifths of the proceeds shall be used to fund one or more scholarships for financially disadvantaged students who are Swedish citizens and reside in Gefle County.
Det ena stipendiet skall utdelas till el: One scholarship is to be awarded to a student in the final year of the Construction and Civil Engineering track—specializing in Wood Construction Technology within the Construction Program—or in the Building and Civil Engineering track. The other scholarship is to be awarded to a student in the third year of the Technology track—specializing in Construction Technology within the Natural Sciences Program—or in the Technology track. The scholarships shall be awarded to students from the Siljan region who have demonstrated commendable academic performance.
\"Fondens uppgift är att utdela studiebi: "The purpose of the fund is to award scholarships to two academically gifted young people from Björskog, primarily those studying at a teacher training college, both female and male, of whom one of the first two should be male. The fund amounts to one hundred and fifty thousand kronor (150,000:-), which may not be reduced. The entire return on the fund shall be distributed each year, beginning in 1985. Vars avkastning efter nationsstyrelsens: The proceeds from which, following a decision by the nation’s board, are to be awarded annually to a financially disadvantaged student belonging to the said nation.
Sedan 20 % av den årliga avkastningen la: After 20% of the annual return has been added to the principal, the remainder of the return shall be distributed annually as a scholarship to a member of the student nation born in Hälsingland who is pursuing studies at the Faculty of Medicine. The scholarship recipient should be known for diligence and a keen interest in their studies.
Att kapitalet ej får förminskas, att end: The principal shall not be reduced; only the interest on the scholarship shall be distributed annually to a deserving, talented, and well-behaved student of the same nationality, and may be retained for up to three years.
Årligen under november månad tilldela Na: Each year in November, the Nation’s Inspector and senior members shall award a scholarship from the fund’s retained earnings to a male student of the Nation in need of financial assistance, giving priority first to those engaged in botanical studies, and second to medical students. The scholarship, which is paid in two equal installments each semester of the academic year, is determined as follows: as long as the retained annual return amounts to a minimum of 200 and a maximum of 300 kronor, 200 kronor is awarded as a scholarship; when it amounts to a minimum of 300 and a maximum of 350 kronor, 250 kronor shall be distributed; when it amounts to no less than 350 and no more than 400 kronor, 300 kronor shall be distributed; when it amounts to no less than 400 and no more than 450 kronor, 350 kronor shall be distributed; when it amounts to no less than 450 and no more than 500 kronor, 400 kronor shall be distributed; if it exceeds 500 kronor, nine-tenths of the retained annual return shall be distributed, rounded up to the nearest even ten-kronor amount. The portion of the retained annual return thus not distributed shall be added to the capital for the growth of the fund. To be eligible for the scholarship, the selected recipient must be present at the University during the semester for as many days as are generally prescribed by the University authorities for the receipt of scholarships. If he fails to meet this requirement and cannot provide reasons approved by the Nation’s Inspector and the seniors, the portion of the scholarship intended for that semester shall be withheld and added to the fund’s capital for its growth.
Stiftelsens syfte att inom Universitetss: The purpose of the Foundation is to award grants at Örebro University Hospital to nurses who, through additional courses or similar means, wish to further their professional development, or to nurses who have performed their duties in a particularly self-sacrificing and exemplary manner. Talented and capable students should also be considered.
Så snart kapitalet uppgått till 2 000 kr: As soon as the fund has reached 2,000 kronor, 9/10 of the interest shall be awarded, in equal installments, at the end of each term to the scholarship recipient designated for that year. The recipient should be in need of financial support and have demonstrated good conduct, diligence, and academic progress. The scholarship is awarded for one year, though the recipient retains the right to reapply. The recipient should be present at Uppsala University for at least two months each term. However, a stay in the capital to fulfill the required coursework for a licentiate degree in medicine or for studies at the museums does not constitute an obstacle to receiving or retaining the scholarship.
Räntan derå må användas till stipendium: The interest thereon may be used to provide a scholarship to a member of the nation. The scholarship recipient should be in need of financial support, known for piety and good character, as well as diligence and progress in their studies. The scholarship is awarded for only one year; however, the recipient retains the right to reapply and receive the scholarship if no other applicant meets the above criteria. If no qualified applicant applies, the interest shall be added to the principal, lent out as soon as possible, or deposited in a bank. If two or more equally qualified applicants apply, the recipient shall be determined by lot, unless it is deemed more appropriate to divide the scholarship among them.
Fondens ändamål skall vara att fämja stu: The purpose of the fund is to support students from the Risbäck and Dorotea parishes, or students with close ties to these parishes, who are preparing for a professional career within the Church of Sweden.
Räntan på stiftelsens kapital skall delv: The interest on the foundation’s capital shall be used in part to fund scholarships for promising young trainees in the horticultural profession to pursue internships and studies abroad. For this purpose, two thousand (2,000) kronor may be allocated from the interest income for each three-year period beginning on January 1, 1989. Scholarships should not be less than one thousand (1,000) kronor per year, which is the shortest period for which a scholarship may be awarded. Of the remainder of the interest, a maximum of two hundred (200) kronor, divided into equal amounts, shall be awarded as prizes for the best-cultivated flowering plants or cut flowers exhibited at the Society’s annual celebration in February each year. The remaining interest income shall be added to the principal or used at the Society’s discretion.

Stiftelsens ändamål är att dela ut stipe: The purpose of the foundation is to award a scholarship to a student at the Gästrike-Hälsinge Nation.
Stiftelsen ska efter avdrag af en tionde: After deducting one-tenth, the foundation shall award the remainder as a scholarship to a member of one of the above-mentioned student nations who is residing here in Uppsala to pursue studies, preferably a native of Hudiksvall. Once the capital reaches five thousand kronor, the allocation of interest shall cease. The scholarship may thereafter consist of the entire interest.
Av räntan å Peter Carl Noraeus stipendie: From the interest earned on the Peter Carl Noraeus Scholarship Fund, the Faculty of Political Science and Law at Stockholm University annually awards a scholarship to law students at the university in the amount of one hundred kronor, to the extent that the available interest income permits. The scholarship is awarded to students who, taking into account academic ability, diligence, and financial need, are deemed deserving of it. Students who are also teaching assistants at the faculty or who hold another scholarship are not thereby prevented from receiving this scholarship.
Stipendiet skall utdelas till någon i na: The scholarship shall be awarded to a student enrolled in the nation who is engaged in the study of modern Swedish, with a particular emphasis on language preservation. Preference shall be given to students enrolled in the nation who can demonstrate descent from one of the donors’ siblings, with closer relatives having priority over more distant ones.
Fondregler + varje enskilt stipendium ka: Fund Rules + Each individual scholarship may be awarded for up to three years of study + A scholarship may be revoked if a student does not fully meet Lundsberg School’s requirements regarding academic performance and active physical recreation + The scholarship must be announced by the Principal in the Lundsbergaren newspaper + Applications for scholarships for the upcoming academic year must be submitted to the Headmaster no later than April 15. + The Headmaster has sole decision-making authority regarding scholarships, and his decision cannot be appealed.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att främja d: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote the academic choral tradition, that is, the form of choral singing traditionally practiced in student life, such as at colleges and universities. The aim is to develop, disseminate, and keep these old traditions alive. This purpose can be effectively fulfilled by awarding one or more scholarships to talented male and female student singers, to give them the opportunity to refine and develop their singing skills in connection with the older musical tradition within student life. The purpose may also be promoted by supporting and/or conducting other activities, such as events related to the aforementioned singing tradition. To fulfill the Foundation’s purpose, the annual direct return, less expenses, may be used. Direct return refers to current income, such as interest and dividends. In exceptional cases, the Foundation may, following a specific decision by the Trustee, also use realized gains to fulfill its purpose. As a guideline, some capitalization of funds should, if possible, take place annually to safeguard the endowment capital and create conditions for its growth. The Trustee shall annually determine the amount that may be utilized to fulfill the Foundation’s purpose, taking the above into account.
Disponibel avkastning av samfonden ska a: The available returns from the joint fund shall be used for students at Wiks Folk High School to purchase special equipment, primarily for the students’ leisure activities, for study trips, or for awards and scholarships. However, the returns may not be used to cover needs that, by law, must be met with funds raised through levies. When deciding on distributions from the joint fund, consideration shall be given to the provisions governing the donations included in the joint fund to the extent deemed appropriate, with the aim of fulfilling the donor’s will and wishes to the greatest extent possible. The joint fund was established from the E.E. Eriksson Donation Fund and the Carl Edvard Casparsson Scholarship Fund
Stiftelsen ska varje år utdela stipendiu: Each year, the Foundation shall award a scholarship of 10,000 Swedish kronor, or such higher amount as the Foundation’s board deems justifiable from time to time in light of the Foundation’s financial position, to at least one person who has been admitted to and has begun a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) program in Sweden and who comes from a non-academic family. In this context, the term “non-academic family” refers to a family in which neither parent has a Swedish university education.
Av stiftelsens avkastning lägges årligen: For the time being, 10% of the foundation’s annual returns are allocated to the fund, with the Nation’s Administrative Committee having the right to increase this amount if economic circumstances so warrant. The remaining returns are distributed every other year as a travel grant. The grant may be applied for by students of the Södermanlands-Nerikes Nation who are members of the v.f.N. society and belong to any faculty, but not by anyone who has passed a doctoral examination. The application must be accompanied by a travel plan, and the planned trip must be part of the applicant’s studies at Uppsala University. To receive the travel grant, the applicant need not be financially destitute. Among applicants of equal merit from an academic standpoint, preference should be given to those who have devoted time and effort to the society or the Nation’s affairs, or who have otherwise contributed to enhancing fellowship within the Society or the Nation.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att genom si: The purpose of the Foundation is to use the interest income from its assets to promote studies in internal medicine and its auxiliary sciences. The fund, which shall have a separate account in the Society’s financial records and be administered by the Society’s Board, shall be increased to an amount of 10,000 (ten thousand) kronor by adding the interest income to the principal. Once the fund’s capital has reached 10,000 kronor, the chairperson shall annually, on the anniversary in October, in accordance with the board’s decision, announce the amount of available grant funds. The applicant must be a domestic member of the Society.
Stiftelsens medel skall användas till un: The Foundation’s funds are to be used to support “poor students who seek to advance in the Word of God.” To this end, two equal scholarships are awarded annually to poor theology students from Södermanland who belong to the Södermanland-Nerike Nation at Uppsala University.
Efter avdrag av förvaltningskostnaderna: After deducting administrative expenses, one-fifth of the annual interest income is added to the principal. The remainder is used for a scholarship. When the principal has grown to the point where the scholarship can be awarded in the amount of five hundred kronor, the Nation shall issue new regulations in accordance with the directives specified by the donor in the deed of gift, such that either this amount is further increased or a new scholarship of five hundred kronor is established. The scholarship is awarded to a needy medical student of the Södermanland-Nerike Nation who has distinguished themselves through talent and diligence as well as impeccable conduct. The term “medical student” refers both to those studying for a Bachelor of Medicine degree and to those pursuing studies for a Licentiate of Medicine degree, but not to a Licentiate of Medicine who is working on a doctoral dissertation. When awarding the scholarship, the following principles specified by the donor shall serve as guidance: “First and foremost, I consider financial need in conjunction with genuine hardship and difficulty in obtaining assistance from others. Thus, a truly greater need may make a younger medical student more deserving than, for example, a medical candidate who has progressed further in their studies.” For any additional scholarships that may be established, medical students shall not be given priority; rather, students from any faculty or department may be awarded a scholarship. The scholarship may be held for three years, with the Scholarship and Grading Committee having the right to grant extensions for one year at a time.

The scholarship is paid out on a semester basis once the Inspector has confirmed the selection. To be eligible for this scholarship, one must have spent two semesters at the university, have been elected a junior, be known for diligence, knowledge, and good character, and finally, while not necessarily destitute, not be in such circumstances that the scholarship would be unnecessary for one’s stay at the university. The scholarship is awarded for two semesters at a time. A single scholarship recipient may receive the scholarship for a maximum of four semesters.
Friherrinnan Jozefa Armfelts, född Hajdu: The scholarship foundation established by Baroness Jozefa Armfelt, née Hajdukiewicz de Pomian, for study trips shall,after 1/20 of the annual yield has been added to the principal, distribute the remainder as a scholarship to Catholics (male or female) who wish to pursue studies in Poland or, if they do not wish to do so, in Rome, France, England, Switzerland, Belgium, or the Netherlands.

Fondens avkastning skall utdelas som sti: The fund’s returns shall be distributed as scholarships to journalists who wish to pursue studies, preferably in foreign and security policy.
Fonden skall utdela stipendium till medi: The fund shall award a scholarship to a medical journalist for studies and other professional development. The scholarship is awarded every two years.
Fondens grundkapital är 1.500 kronor. Av: The fund’s initial capital is 1,500 Swedish kronor.
