Att utdela semesterstipendier åt ordinar: To award summer scholarships to registered nurses at the University Hospital. Grants from the fund may not be used to cover the costs of convalescent care or medical studies. The annual interest income, after one-fifth of the interest has been added to the principal, is available for distribution during the following calendar year as vacation grants, each not less than two hundred (200:-) kronor.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall, sedan minst e: Once at least one-tenth of the Foundation’s assets have been added to its capital, the remainder shall be used to provide scholarships to deserving students in need.
Fondens avkastning skall disponeras av g: The returns on the fund shall be allocated by the Director-General and the Head of the Medical Board to be used, in accordance with the wishes of the donors and my own, for measures to promote public health, such as inviting guest lecturers, providing grants to staff within the Board and bodies affiliated with the Board for study trips, and publishing medical works, preferably in the field of public health.
Av avkastningen skall 10 % per annum läg: Ten percent of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The remainder shall be distributed as one or more scholarships to young people to assist and encourage them in their secular and religious education. Eligible to apply for funds from the foundation are: - young people who have received their primary education at Råbergsskolan in Rosersberg - young people who reside in Rosersberg or have strong ties to the Rosersberg/Norrsunda parish.
Av stiftelsens medel ska ett stipendium: From the foundation’s funds, a scholarship of at least 7,500 SEK, adjusted annually according to the CPI, shall be awarded to the student in the Optometry program at Linnaeus University who has improved their academic performance the most during their second year of study compared to their first year. The student must be enrolled in Kalmar. The scholarship may be awarded to more than one student who has most significantly improved their academic performance.
Att bereda stipendier till företrädesvis: To provide scholarships, primarily for young singers or vocal students, to be awarded annually on the Stockholm Lodge’s Anniversary Day, beginning in 1990. To maintain the value stability of the Memorial Fund, 10% of the annual return, after the Fund’s expenses and the Stockholm Lodge’s 5% administration fee have been paid, shall be added to the principal.
Till förmån för studerande vid de allmän: For the benefit of students in the general teacher education programs within the education sector at the future university in Kalmar, to be used for scholarships and awards as well as for initiatives aimed at enhancing student well-being
Stiftelsens änamål är att ge stipendier: The foundation's primary purpose is to award scholarships to students from the municipality of Rånö.
Stipendium till adlig person som studera: Scholarship for members of the nobility studying at a university, college, or other institution of higher education. Priority is given to members of the von Warnstedt family (line 78). Financial aid for members of the nobility, with priority given to members of the von Warnstedt family (line 78).
Av den årliga avkastningen skall en tion: One-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, which shall not be touched. The remainder of the fund’s return shall, for as long as my aforementioned cousin, Mrs. Berntine Otter, is alive, be paid to her in full, and after her death, as an annual scholarship for education and the acquisition of knowledge, upon application, distributed to the male or female descendants of the late Chamberlain Henrik Albrecht von Stockenström, and secondarily as support for such descendants who, due to age, illness, or other compassionate circumstances, may be in need thereof. The amount paid out annually should, as a rule, not be divided among several persons, and the same person shall be free to receive the grant in question for two or more consecutive years. When selecting among multiple applicants for a scholarship, consideration shall be given to the applicant’s financial circumstances; however, unless there are special financial reasons, the benefit of the studies intended by the scholarship for the applicant’s future career shall be the primary determining factor. In the event that interest does not need to be paid in any given year, it shall be capitalized.

Stiftelsen skall hava till ändamål att m: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide financial support, in the form of scholarships, to young people of good character from Härjedalen and Norrbotten who have demonstrated a marked aptitude for pursuing various types of university or college studies. The scholarships are intended for students who cannot count on sufficient support from the state, municipality, or other sources, and, under otherwise equal circumstances, priority should be given to students in Härjedalen. One-fourth (1/4) of the annual return on the donation shall be added to the capital. The board of directors may, after covering the costs associated with the foundation’s activities during the year, use the remainder of the annual return for the foundation’s purposes. The distribution of available funds may be deferred in whole or in part to a future year.

Den årliga fondavkastningen ska utdelas: The annual return on the fund shall be distributed as scholarships to young people who are studying agriculture, forestry, or horticulture, either in Sweden or abroad, through theoretical or practical training. Scholarship recipients must be registered residents of the municipality of Säffle at the start of their studies.
Av stiftelesns disponibla avkastning ska: Each year, the Faculty Board of Science and Technology shall award one or more scholarships from the foundation’s available returns, preferably distributed equally between women and men. The scholarships are to be used for language studies in French, Spanish, or German, preferably at Uppsala University, or alternatively at equivalent universities in France, Spain, or Germany. Students at the Faculty of Science and Technology at Uppsala University are eligible to receive a scholarship. Preference is given to students who demonstrate good academic performance. A scholarship may be awarded no more than once and for no longer than one year. If a scholarship cannot be awarded in a given year, the proceeds are added to the endowment.
Samfonden har till ändamål att dela ut s: The purpose of the joint fund is to award grants to artists at the Royal Swedish Opera and the Royal Dramatic Theatre to enable them to study abroad. When disbursing funds from the joint fund, due consideration shall be given to the provisions of the donation deeds. At least one-tenth of the returns shall be added to the principal.
90% av avkastningen utdelas som stipendi: 90% of the proceeds are distributed as scholarships to students attending schools in Trollhättan that are operated by the municipality and who do not receive financial aid from said municipality.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att med h: The purpose of the Foundation shall be to use the returns on the Foundation’s capital and funds raised to award scholarships that enable recipients to undertake study trips likely to be of value to their education at Chalmers University of Technology and their future professional careers.
[...] Räntan årligen utdelas till en ell: [...] The interest shall be distributed annually to one or, at most, two well-behaved young men or women bearing the surname Gyllensvärd who are in need of financial assistance for their education at a school or university; if in any given year no eligible applicant applies, the interest shall be added to the principal, and should the name die out, the donation shall be transferred to the Malmö Higher Commercial Institute to be administered under the aforementioned name, and the interest shall be paid annually to one or two of the institute’s deserving students in need.
Stiftelsen ska ha som ändamål att utge s: The purpose of the Foundation is to award scholarships to the grandchildren of Gunhild and Isidor Andersson and their descendants. Scholarships as described above should be awarded to students at universities or colleges, but other educational institutions are also acceptable. Scholarships shall be awarded as deemed appropriate, at the discretion of the Board—but a starting point is an amount corresponding to the total student financial aid (grant and loan portions combined) currently in effect, as granted by the Swedish Board of Student Finance (CSN) or any future equivalent thereof. In the event that the Foundation does not receive applications for study grants, or that the purpose described above can no longer be fulfilled, the Board has the right to capitalize the return or make contributions to public-benefit organizations, such as, for example, the Lions’ activities in Täby (“Barnfonden”). The Foundation shall also be the holder of the burial rights to the grave site numbered 141, located within the Swedish Church at the Täby Södra Cemetery, Block B2. The Foundation shall grant the Founder and the Founder’s children—Helena Håkanson, Tomas Andersson, Håkan Einerth, and Carina Norberg—the right to be buried in grave site No. 141, if they so desire. The Foundation shall promote the maintenance of the burial rights. This maintenance shall be promoted by the Foundation even if the Foundation were not the holder of the burial rights. Grave maintenance shall be performed by the Church of Sweden, or by a contractor deemed suitable by the Church. The grave shall be maintained with care in such a way that a complete annual maintenance plan is arranged, and in such a way that spring and summer flowers are planted and appropriate autumn and winter decorations are arranged. To fulfill the Foundation’s purpose, the annual direct return may be used, less administrative costs. Direct return refers to current income, such as interest and dividends. During the first three years following the Foundation’s establishment, a small portion of the endowment capital may be used to fulfill the Foundation’s purposes, but not exceeding three hundred thousand (300,000) kronor and never without regard to the requirements of the Foundations Act regarding permanence. The Board of Directors shall annually determine the amount that may be utilized to fulfill the Foundation’s purposes.
Till innehavare av Stjernecreutz´s stipe: To recipients of the Stjernecreutz Scholarship for students of medicine or philosophy. Scholarship recipients will be notified of the opportunity to apply for a travel grant upon submission of a separate application.
Avkastningen av gåvoegendomen skall dela: The proceeds from the donated property shall be distributed as a scholarship or scholarships to one or more women for undergraduate and/or graduate education in the Swedish healthcare system.
Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara 1. att med: The purpose of the Foundation shall be: 1. to use the investment income, after 10 percent has been added to the capital, to fund an annual prize of 50,000 SEK (which may be adjusted in line with the consumer price index) and a diploma for the best thesis in teacher education related to history or the social sciences. The prize shall be called “Lecturer Bengt Åke Häger’s Prize for the Best Thesis.” The prize shall be awarded at a special ceremony. Secondarily, to the extent that the investment income allows, smaller scholarships may also be awarded to students in the teacher education program for well-executed theses related to history or the social sciences. 2. to fund the maintenance of the shared grave site of my parents and other relatives (St. Pauli Central Cemetery in Malmö, plot 154 in block 7).
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a scholarship, with the amount rounded down to the nearest multiple of five Swedish kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added to the fund’s capital each year. Scholarships are awarded to male students of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation who are currently enrolled at the university for the semester, are of modest means, and who “have distinguished themselves through diligence and good character.”
Nio tiondedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Nine-tenths of the fund’s interest is distributed over three consecutive years as four equal scholarships to members of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation. In the fourth year, the amount is distributed as two equal travel grants to “two needy, promising, and well-regarded for their diligence and conduct, of the Uppsala Student Union’s General Singing Society, regardless of their nation, who are currently enrolled at the University for the semester, to be used for travel abroad for the stated academic purpose.” The amount of each scholarship is rounded down in all cases to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added to the fund capital each year.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest income is distributed annually as three scholarships, known as the “Sigrid Johansson Scholarship”; however, the amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor for each scholarship. The remainder of the interest income is added to the fund’s capital each year. Scholarship recipients are selected from among students at Uppsala University or another institution of higher education who are enrolled in the Västmanlands-Dala Nation, with preference given to those from less affluent families and who themselves face difficult financial circumstances.
Att utge stipendier till kvinnliga stude: To award scholarships to female students who are training to become teachers. The foundation’s investment income may be used to further the foundation’s purposes.
Nio tiondelar av fondens ränta för tre p: Nine-tenths of the fund’s interest income for three consecutive years shall be distributed during the spring semester of the year following the last year of the three-year period as a scholarship, designated the “Hjalmar Åselius Scholarship,” with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund capital to increase it. The scholarship is awarded to a student of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation who is enrolled at the university for that semester.
Nio tiondelar av fondens ränta utdelas å: Nine-tenths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a scholarship, known as the “Carl Atle Öberg Scholarship,” with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to increase it. The scholarship is awarded by the Västmanlands-Dala Nation to a needy student from Västerås who is currently enrolled at the university. The same recipient receives the scholarship for five consecutive years, provided that he remains enrolled at the university and registered with the nation during this period.
[.] utdelas fyra femtedelar av fondens r: [.] Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a scholarship, provided that the amount is rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to increase it. The scholarship is awarded to “needy, talented theology students” by the Västmanlands-Dala Nation, who are currently enrolled at the university for the semester. The same scholarship recipient may receive the scholarship for a maximum of six consecutive semesters.
Fondens årliga nettoavkastning utdelas å: The fund’s annual net return is distributed each year as a scholarship, known as the “Henrik and Hans Park Scholarship.” The scholarship is awarded to a student in need who is currently enrolled at the university and is a member of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation, and who is pursuing studies in the humanities. The scholarship is awarded for one year. However, upon special application and after review by the Senior Council, the recipient may receive the scholarship for one year at a time for an additional two consecutive years, provided that he is enrolled at the university and registered with the nation during this period.
Nio tiondelar av fondens ränta utdelas å: Nine-tenths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a scholarship, known as the “Anders Diös Scholarship,” with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The scholarship is awarded to a student of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester. The same recipient receives the scholarship for three consecutive years, provided that he is enrolled at the university and registered with the Nation during this time.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest income is distributed annually in the form of three scholarships, known as the “Löfberg Scholarship”; however, the amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor for each scholarship. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it, after the required amount has been paid to the Västerås Cemetery Administration for the maintenance of Löfberg’s grave. Scholarship recipients are selected from among students belonging to the Västmanlands-Dala Nation at Uppsala University who are in need of financial support and who have distinguished themselves through diligence, integrity, and academic excellence, with preference given to students in historical or natural science subjects. The scholarship may not be retained for longer than three years.
Av fastighetens årliga nettoavkastning s: One-tenth of the property’s annual net income shall be used to increase the fund’s capital, and the remainder shall be used to provide financial support to well-behaved and diligent young men and women in the Skivarp parish, to be used after completion of their schooling for further studies or training in agriculture, crafts, or other trades, according to their interests or aptitudes.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a grant, with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remaining interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to increase it. The award is distributed without prior application at the ceremonial gathering on April 30 to a fellow student who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester. The recipient of the award is selected by the Nation’s Senior Council. “Those who have demonstrated special talent in a particular field shall have priority in receiving the award.” In other respects, the recipient may be chosen from among those “who may otherwise be considered worthy of it.”

Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a prize, provided that the amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remaining interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to increase it. The premium is awarded under the name “A Gift from an Old Countryman” at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 to “a diligent medical student belonging to the Nation who may be in need of it,” in accordance with the regulations governing the Wallin Premium.

Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a grant, provided that the amount is rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remaining interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is awarded at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 to “a well-behaved and needy fellow student” who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester, in accordance with the regulations governing the Wallin Premium.
Pengarna skall användas till stipendier: The funds are to be used for scholarships for study trips focused on international cooperation between Swedish and Finnish students.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta för två: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest income for two consecutive years is distributed as a bonus. The bonus amount is rounded down to the nearest multiple of five Swedish kronor. The remaining interest income is added annually to the fund capital to strengthen it. The premium is distributed without prior application at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 of the year following the second year of the two-year period, by secret ballot of the juniors present, to a junior who is currently enrolled at the university and “who has demonstrated exceptional diligence and honorable conduct.”
Fondens årliga nettoavkastning utdelas i: The Fund’s annual net return is distributed in the form of four scholarships of one thousand five hundred (1,500) kronor each. Any amount remaining after the scholarships have been awarded is added to the principal. Should the net return be sufficient to do so, the Nation’s Administrative Committee may decide to establish additional scholarships of 1,500 kronor. However, once the number of scholarships reaches twelve (12), no further scholarships shall be established; instead, any excess return, following a decision by the Administrative Committee, shall be added to the scholarship amounts. Scholarships are awarded to students currently enrolled at Västmanlands-Dala Nation. When awarding the scholarship, if applicants are considered equally eligible to receive it, preference shall be given to students belonging to the Faculty of Humanities. The same scholarship recipient shall receive the scholarship for three consecutive years, provided that he is enrolled at the university and registered with the nation during this period.
Nio tiondelar av fondens ränta utdelas å: Nine-tenths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a scholarship, known as the “Albert Koersner Scholarship,” with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to increase it. The scholarship is awarded to a student of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation currently enrolled at the university for the semester, with preference given to those pursuing legal studies. The same scholarship recipient receives the scholarship for three consecutive years, provided that he is enrolled at the university and registered with the Nation during this time.
Vartannat år med början år 1991 utdelas: Every other year, beginning in 1991, the fund’s returns from the immediately preceding year are awarded as a scholarship, known as the “Henrik Hydman Scholarship,” with the amount rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remainder of the returns is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The scholarship is awarded to students currently enrolled at the Västmanlands-Dala Nation.
Så länge legat utgår av fondens avkastni: As long as the fund’s returns are sufficient, one scholarship of 100 kronor shall be awarded annually; thereafter, two or more scholarships, each of 100 kronor, shall be awarded, in accordance with the donors’ expressed wishes. The number of scholarships is determined by the Nation’s Administrative Committee, ensuring that at least one-fifth of the annual interest income is retained to strengthen the fund’s capital. Scholarships are awarded to fellow countrymen who are currently enrolled at the university for the semester and “who, through diligence, good conduct, and success in their studies, have earned it.” The same scholarship recipient may receive the scholarship for a maximum of six consecutive semesters.
Stiftelsen Tore Forssén har som ändamål: The Tore Forssén Foundation aims to provide financial support to young people whose parents or parent are registered residents of Junsele Parish in Sollefteå Municipality for their college or university studies. The returns on the shares are distributed annually after the foundation’s expenses have been covered. If there are not enough applicants to whom funds are granted to ensure that the year’s returns are distributed in full, Junsele IF may apply for funds for investments and training/conferences/etc. from the remaining amount.
Främja utveckling av företagsekonomi som: To promote the development of business administration as a field of study, with a particular focus on issues related to accounting and finance. The fund’s returns and capital are fully available for the fund’s purposes. The Fund may fulfill its purpose by: - organizing an annual seminar at which one or more theses or research projects in the field of Accounting and Finance, selected by a special jury, are awarded. Each scholarship shall be accompanied by a brief justification. - otherwise promoting scientific research.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att: a) främ: The Foundation’s purpose is to: a) promote the care of children and young people in need, for example by providing grants to projects and activities that help these children and young people experience joy and well-being. Grants may be provided to organizations as well as to individual initiatives; b) award scholarships to talented, promising, and needy students at colleges or universities, taking into account that i. an even distribution between female and male students should be sought; ii. the scholarships must cover tuition and living expenses but not travel, and that iii. scholarship recipients must be no older than twenty-six years of age at the time the scholarships are awarded, c) promote and encourage social assistance activities at the group level, for example through activities at senior centers or other forms of group housing. This is to enable the elderly and/or sick to go on outings, take trips, participate in reading aloud and other gatherings, or receive care in the form of, for example, hair and facial care, foot care, manicures, or pedicures, so that a joyful and pleasant life may be achieved. Grants may be awarded to organizations as well as to individual initiatives. In promoting the purposes listed under a–c above, the Kalmar County area shall be prioritized. To fulfill the foundation’s purposes, the annual direct return may be used, less administrative costs. Direct return refers to current income, such as interest and dividends.
Av avkastningen skall minst en tiondel å: At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal. The portion of the fund’s return available for distribution is distributed annually at the close of the fiscal year to applicants who, during the academic year in question or earlier, have completed the greenhouse horticulture track of the horticultural technician program. Scholarships should be awarded to applicants who have demonstrated good academic performance and who intend to use the scholarship to acquire further knowledge in the field of horticulture. Should the horticultural education program at Alnarp undergo such a reorganization that the conditions for utilizing this fund for its intended purpose no longer exist, the Institute Board may, upon the recommendation of the Horticultural Department Faculty, decide on the future use of the fund.
Vart annat år bör premium tilldelas en f: Every other year, the award should be presented to a student who has graduated from the advanced horticulture course that same year and who has made significant progress in fruit science and fruit cultivation during their studies at the institute. Every other year, the prize should be awarded to a student graduating from the horticultural school or the commercial horticulture course at the institute who has distinguished themselves through diligence and interest in their studies. In the event that the horticulture program at the institute is reorganized, the board shall have the right to amend the provisions set forth herein regarding the distribution of the prizes among the various courses. Should the horticulture program at Alnarp be discontinued, the board may use the fund to support or encourage Swedish horticulture.
Stiftelsen ska utöva välgörenhet, genom: The Foundation shall engage in charitable activities by providing grants and support for public advocacy, investigative journalism, non-fiction literary projects, and pressing social issues, as well as by promoting research and development, primarily in the fields of construction engineering, energy, indoor environments, and health/medicine. The Foundation may provide grants/support in the areas of healthcare, education, social services, and societal issues related to welfare, economics, technology, and medicine. Examples of the Foundation’s areas of activity include: - Charity: funds for food, clothing, transportation, and activities that enhance well-being for people in nursing homes, those with disabilities, and the sick (primarily children) and their relatives, regardless of whether they are in a care facility or at home. - Grants/support in recognition of outstanding achievement and personal courage, for example in social issues, for journalistic or literary activities, debate books, non-fiction, and opinion-forming. - Grants/support for research, education, and development projects. Priority is given to projects addressing better, more affordable construction that provides health-promoting housing. Projects in construction engineering, energy, indoor environment, health, and medicine are prioritized. - Grants/support for students at colleges and universities in the Nordic countries (commendable theses in undergraduate programs, licentiate and doctoral dissertations). Grants are awarded to individuals.
Av den årliga avkastningen skall 10 % lä: Of the annual return, 10% shall be added to the principal, and the remainder, rounded off each year, shall be awarded as a scholarship for study abroad to the newly graduated landscape architect who has demonstrated the greatest progress in garden architecture.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att avkastni: The purpose of the foundation is to distribute the returns on its capital as educational assistance to visually impaired young people under the age of 20 in Skåne.
Fonden har till uppgift att åt blivande: The purpose of the fund is to provide financial support to prospective forestry engineers during their years of study at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences for courses in forestry engineering or forestry economics, preferably focusing on a Nordic issue. At least one-tenth of the annual return shall be set aside and added to the principal. The remainder shall be distributed in the form of scholarships to regular students at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences. To be eligible for a scholarship, the applicant must meet the following conditions: a) be an active member of the student union; b) have pursued their studies with diligence and success and demonstrated a special interest and sound understanding of the subjects of forest engineering or forest economics; c) have maintained honorable conduct.
fondens avkastning skall under namn av \: The fund’s returns shall, under the name “Aron Westerlund’s Fellowship,” serve as a reward for a man or woman enrolled in the Student Union of the Royal Swedish College of Agriculture who, through good fellowship and honorable conduct, serves as a role model for their peers and who can be expected to perform excellent work in the service of Swedish agriculture. One-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, and the remaining nine-tenths shall be distributed. If the Student Union determines that no one in a given year is eligible to receive the award, the available return or a portion thereof may be used for a purpose of particular importance to the Student Union or added to the principal.
Årligen av avkastningen läggas en tionde: Each year, one-tenth of the returns is allocated to the fund, and the remainder is distributed at the start of the academic year to regular students at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences who have successfully completed their studies and demonstrated a particular interest in either forest management or forest zoology. Ideally, the scholarship should be used to complete a thesis in one of the aforementioned subjects.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest income is distributed annually as one or more payments, provided that the payment amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remaining interest income is added to the principal each year. The Senior Convention shall determine, provided that no premium may exceed 500 kronor, the number and amount of the premiums at each distribution. If the Convention decides in any given year that one or more of the premiums shall not be distributed, the Convention may determine whether the interest income thus retained shall be added to the fund capital or reserved for distribution in a subsequent year. The Convention appoints deserving law students of the Västmanlands-Dala Nation as recipients of the premium.
Vart tredje år utdelas tre femtedelar av: Every three years, three-fifths of the interest earned over three consecutive years is distributed as a bonus. The bonus amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remaining interest income is added annually to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is awarded without prior application at the ceremonial banquet on April 30 by the seniors and juniors present in the year following the last year of the three-year period to a student currently enrolled at Uppsala University and registered with the nation who has worked meritoriously for the nation’s best interests and who has made himself well-liked within the nation.
En tiondel av den årliga avkastningen sk: One-tenth of the annual return shall be added to the principal, and the remainder shall be allocated for the awarding of one or more scholarships. Scholarships are awarded at the end of the spring semester. Scholarships are awarded primarily to regular students at the Forestry College who have demonstrated aptitude for forestry mathematics, with preference given to students born in Västernorrland or Norrbotten counties.
9/10 av räntan utdelas årligen som premi: 9/10 of the interest is distributed annually as a premium, rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. 1/10 of the interest is added to the principal to increase it. The premium is distributed at the ceremonial service on April 30 to a poor, diligent theology student.
Utdelning ur fonden får äga rum, först d: Distributions from the fund may be made only after its capital has grown to at least 1,500 kronor. Once the fund has reached this amount, four-fifths of the fund’s interest for two consecutive years shall be distributed as a premium. The premium amount is rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remaining interest income is added to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is awarded by the Nation’s Senior Convention without prior application at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 of the year following the second year of the two-year period, to a theology student who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester and who has demonstrated exceptional diligence and honorable conduct.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a grant, with the amount rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remaining interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is distributed without prior application at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 to a student who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester, in accordance with the regulations governing the Wallin Premium.

Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed annually as a bonus, with the amount rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remaining interest income is added each year to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is distributed without prior application at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 by secret ballot of the juniors and recentiors present to a junior who is currently enrolled at the university for the semester
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta för tre: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest for three consecutive years is distributed as a premium. The amount is rounded down to the nearest ten kronor. The remaining interest income is added annually to the fund capital to strengthen it. The Nation’s Senior Convention selects as premium recipients students currently enrolled at the university, with preference given to law students, who have demonstrated an interest in the culture and nature of Germany and Italy.
Av fondens ränteavkastning årligen, skal: Half of the fund’s annual interest income shall be distributed in the form of awards, and half shall be added to the principal until the total reaches thirty thousand (30,000:-) kronor. Thereafter, the entire annual interest income shall be distributed in the form of one or more awards. Premiums shall be awarded, without prior application, at the ceremonial assembly on April 30 to any student belonging to the nation and present at the university.
Avkastningen skall utgå som bidrag till: The proceeds shall be used to provide grants to low-income forestry students in Årsunda.
Fyra femtedelar av fondens ränta utdelas: Four-fifths of the fund’s interest is distributed over two consecutive years as a grant, with the amount rounded down to the nearest multiple of five kronor. The remaining interest income, as well as the entire interest income in the third year, is added to the fund’s capital to strengthen it. The premium is distributed without prior application by the ceremonial province on April 30 to a student belonging to the nation and currently enrolled at the university. Preference may be given to those who have devoted their studies to one of the subjects within the mathematics subject group or art history.
Fondens medel må disponeras för stipendi: The Fund’s assets may be used to provide scholarships to young people in the labor movement in Gothenburg for studies in economics and international affairs, as well as for other studies that the Board deems consistent with the Fund’s purpose.
Fondens nettoavkastning utdelas [.] till: The fund’s net return is distributed [.] to students in the Sundsvall school system to assist with their studies or to fund study trips within Sweden or abroad.
Stiftelsens ändamål skall vara att främj: The purpose of the foundation is to promote and support music education for young people. Funds from the foundation shall primarily be awarded to students at the Malmö Academy of Music. The foundation may accept gifts and donations from both individuals and legal entities.
Stiftelsen har till ändamål att vidare u: The purpose of the Foundation is to further develop the independent school in the Bromma parish, which was bequeathed to the Foundation by V.E. Ingelög, M.A., and to manage the assets that Ingelög has placed at the Foundation’s disposal, as well as the funds that may be obtained for the Foundation’s activities from other sources through donations, grants, or other means.
/./ avkastningen skall utdelas såsom sti: /./ The proceeds shall be distributed as scholarships to talented students at the student association.
Ändamålet ska vara att årligen dela ut s: The purpose is to award scholarships annually in the amount of SEK 200,000 to enable study abroad that may benefit a deserving student in, for example, international law and European Union law at the Department of Law, Stockholm University, and the scholarship amount shall follow changes in the base amount pursuant to the National Insurance Act (1962:381). It shall be permissible to use both the income and the foundation’s capital for the payment of scholarships, and students in other subjects with an international focus at the Department of Law shall also be eligible to apply for the scholarships.
Stiftelsens syfte ska vara att lämna bid: The purpose of the Foundation is to provide grants to Swedish citizens who are medical students in the undergraduate medical program at the University of Gothenburg, to be used for the purchase of textbooks and other educational materials necessary for their studies. Funds will be awarded once a year following an application. The application must explain the reasons why the grant is needed. Grants shall, at the discretion of the administrator, be awarded to students for whom the costs of purchasing educational materials are deemed to be a financial burden. Applicants may receive grants multiple times. Grants shall primarily be awarded to multiple applicants annually. Funds shall primarily be distributed from the annual return on the capital; however, the administrator shall have the right to set aside a portion of the return to prevent the foundation’s capital reserves from being eroded by inflation. If, however, the return is insufficient to cover at least one grant per year, the capital may also be utilized for distribution.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja de aka: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote the academic traditions at Uppsala University, and above all to preserve the tradition of maintaining an active flag corps with flag bearers from all student nations and student unions affiliated with Uppsala University. To fulfill the foundation’s purpose, its available funds shall be used by awarding two or more scholarships to individuals who have actively participated in upholding the academic traditions; preferably, the scholarships are intended for flag bearers who have made a contribution to the flag corps. The Grand Scholarship is awarded to standard-bearers who, in addition to active participation, have also distinguished themselves within the standard-bearers’ convention as a good and helpful fellow standard-bearer. The scholarship may be awarded to emeritus standard-bearers who, even after their formal term of office, have actively participated in the Fanborgen (e.g., as substitutes). The Small Scholarship is an incentive scholarship awarded to one (or more) standard-bearers who have demonstrated a need for, e.g., care of their official attire (tailor, dry cleaning, purchase of gloves, shawl, student cap, bow tie, vest, or shoes) or other items necessary for the proper performance of the office. The Large Scholarship may never be held more than once by the same person. The Large and Small Scholarships may never be awarded to standard-bearers representing the same nation or corps on the same occasion or in two consecutive years. Scholarships may not be awarded to current members of the Presidium.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att främja studen: The purpose of the Foundation is to promote the continued musical development of students at the Royal College of Music in Stockholm (KMH) in the fields of classical music and composition. The first scholarship will be awarded in conjunction with the 2021 anniversary. The Foundation shall fulfill its purpose by awarding scholarships to particularly promising and deserving students in programs of study in classical music, composition, and conducting to promote the student’s continued musical development. One (1) scholarship shall be awarded annually. In 2021, the scholarship amount shall be SEK 50,000 (fifty thousand). Every five years, starting in 2026, the scholarship amount shall be increased by ten percent of the current amount, rounded up to the nearest thousand. In 2026, the amount will thus be increased to SEK 55,000, and in 2031, the amount will be increased to SEK 61,000 (55,000 plus 5,500, rounded up to SEK 6,000), and so on. /./ att av dess årliga avkastning, sedan: /./ to use the annual proceeds, after administrative expenses have been covered, to provide financial assistance to needy members of our families residing in Sweden, in accordance with the conditions set forth below. Furthermore, from the returns on the fund, as far as possible annually, in February or March, study grants (scholarships) shall be paid to less well-off family members, both male and female, which may be adjusted according to reasonable need. Scholarships should not exceed 10,000 SEK for the 2006 fiscal year and thereafter be adjusted annually according to the consumer price index, and the recipient must be at least 14 years of age and enrolled in a public school or other equivalent educational institution. However, a higher scholarship of up to 18,000 SEK for the 2006 fiscal year and thereafter adjusted annually according to the consumer price index may be paid to those studying at a university or other institution of higher education. Scholarship recipients, both the former and the latter, are entitled to receive the scholarship annually for the duration of their studies, provided they can provide satisfactory proof that they are making good progress in their studies. It is incumbent upon the bank to review the trustees’ proposals and award the support, in accordance with the donors’ wishes, to those deemed most in need. In this regard, the provisions set forth in paragraph 4 shall otherwise be observed. Should trustees for the families not be duly appointed, or should proposals from the trustees not be received by the bank in a timely manner, we instruct the bank to distribute the grants in the spirit of the will after obtaining the information the bank deems necessary for this purpose. If, after the annual distribution and after the administrative costs for that year have been covered, there is a surplus from the return, this shall be capitalized.
Stiftelsen har till huvudsakligt ändamål: The primary purpose of the Foundation is to provide financial support in the form of scholarships for the preparation of instruction or training for young people who wish to further their education in the field of maritime affairs. Such studies may take place at a maritime school, a maritime officer training school, or within the shipping industry in general. Egendomen Hoberg får icke avyttras utan: The Hoberg estate shall not be sold, but shall always be maintained in the same condition and under the same management as it is at the time of my death. For the operation of the estate, the existing movable property, both interior and exterior furnishings, shall be retained and, as needed, replaced through new acquisitions. Timber harvested on the estate shall preferably be sold standing. Cash funds shall be invested in a secure manner to earn interest. The foundation shall, as long as state subsidies are provided, operate a ferry service on Lake Torrön using the boat included in the estate to the same extent as now and subsequently to the extent deemed appropriate. When there are no longer any relatives of mine entitled to the proceeds of the foundation’s property, the foundation shall be dissolved and the property shall be divided equally between the Municipality of Kalls and the Norwegian Agricultural University. The portion of the foundation’s property that thus accrues to the municipality of Kall shall form a fund, to be administered by the municipal council, the proceeds of which shall be used primarily for the benefit of western Kall and for purposes not otherwise covered by tax revenues. The portion accruing to the Norwegian Agricultural University shall constitute a fund managed jointly by the university’s faculty council and the board of the university’s student union, and the proceeds of the fund shall be used for purposes determined by them.

Stiftelsens ändamål ska vara att främja: The purpose of the Foundation shall be to promote artistic education and development in the fields of art and music. The Foundation shall pursue this purpose by awarding annual grants from the Foundation to talented pupils/students who are in some way affiliated with the Royal College of Music in Stockholm and the Royal Academy of Fine Arts. The Board’s starting point shall be that SEK 3,000,000 may be withdrawn annually from the Foundation’s assets, which shall thereby be made available to cover the Foundation’s administrative costs and for the awarding of scholarships in accordance with the Foundation’s purpose. /./ /./ Only when the total fund capital falls below SEK 80,000,000 shall the annual withdrawal be limited to SEK 2,000,000. If the total fund capital has grown to a level exceeding SEK 130,000,000, the annual withdrawal shall be increased to SEK 4,000,000. Regardless of the capital’s performance, SEK 2,000,000 shall always be distributed. Thus, it is the donor’s express wish that the Scholarship Fund distribute scholarships even if the total capital gradually decreases in value. Theoretically, this could result in the entire capital being completely depleted. In the event of further capital growth, the Foundation shall distribute funds in proportion to the above, meaning, for example, that an additional SEK 1,000,000 shall be distributed if the fund capital has grown to SEK 160,000,000. According to the Foundation’s charter, the Foundation shall promote young, talented individuals in the arts and music by awarding annual scholarships from the Foundation to specially selected students who have distinguished themselves in a manner that makes them suitable recipients of this scholarship. When selecting scholarship recipients, the Board shall attach decisive importance to how the applicant has described in their application how the scholarship amount will be used to promote and develop their talent and ability in the arts and music, including the stated purpose and justification provided therein. The scholarship may also be awarded to an applicant who intends to pursue a project in which others may be involved, provided that a single individual is always responsible for the proposed project. It is also the donor’s intention that the scholarship recipient be able to use the funds to finance increased costs incurred while studying at other music and art institutions in and outside Sweden, provided that the purpose is to develop the individual recipient’s talent in the arts and music. This applies regardless of whether the scholarship recipient is still enrolled at the Royal College of Music/Royal College of Art or if it is in connection with the recipient’s graduation from the respective school.
Stiftelsens ändamål är att belöna studen: The purpose of the Foundation is to recognize students and researchers who have conducted successful research within the Faculty of Educational Sciences at Uppsala University, primarily within the Department of Pedagogy, Didactics, and Educational Studies or within teacher education programs at other parts of the university. In the event that the university’s organizational structure changes, the group of beneficiaries shall be affiliated with the faculty/department that most closely corresponds to those mentioned above. For the purposes of the foundation, the foundation’s available funds shall be used by being distributed as a) scholarships to two students who, through independent projects or theses at the undergraduate or graduate level, demonstrate talent for successful research, and b) a successful researcher who has recently defended a doctoral dissertation (no more than two years prior to the application deadline). The amounts awarded annually should be a) 25,000 Swedish kronor per person and b) 50,000 Swedish kronor. /./ The foundation’s capital as a whole may not be utilized before the end of 2032. When the foundation’s capital no longer covers all parts of the purpose specified in § 3 a) and b) with the amounts stated in § 4, the foundation may distribute the entire remaining foundation capital, as deemed appropriate, to one or more students and/or researchers within the subject area stipulated in §§ 2–3. The scholarship may never be awarded to the same person two years in a row.

The Nation’s Scholarship Committee selects one or more scholarship recipients from among the applicants or others the committee deems deserving. räntan är afsedd att, när fonden vuxit t: The interest is intended, once the fund has grown to a sufficient amount, to be distributed to botanists affiliated with Uppsala University as a grant for travel within Scandinavia for botanical purposes.
